He says Moab’s survivors were “few and feeble,” Egypt was ruled in turn by Assyria, Babylon, Greece and Rome and “never rose to a prominence in the earth,” and “the desert of the sea” turned out to be Persia and the Medes who destroyed Babylon. He says atheists and those who attack the Bible “got to be confronted with these facts.”

I haven’t either. There are few. All right. And the Egyptians never rose to a prominence in the earth, okay, just like God said. And these atheists and these people that attack the Bible, you know, they got to be confronted with these facts. Are you there? Hallelujah. The desert of the sea. Okay, and here’s where I get the desert of the sea. He says the “burden” means divine utterance, and that in the middle of the prophecies about natural cities Isaiah switches to the prophetic day of the Lord, the time before and when He comes. God wants to correct us, and this this flattering gospel of just grace and faith has destroyed the church in America and weakened it tremendously. Are you out there? “You’re dead shall live and they shall arise.” And it says a lot of good stuff. I just took some excerpts out of this, it’s very powerful. “Your dead shall live and they shall arise.” See, these people in the world, they going to live and they will arise. As Christians, are going to live and we’re going to arise. The whole purpose of God is for us to, what, live and arise out of trespasses and sin and live a life for Christ. Can I hear an amen? Now, is there a big thing coming up here according to Isaiah? Yes. And you younger ones have a chance to be in part of this. Luke 7:37-38: And behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at the table in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster flask of fragrant oil, and stood at His feet behind Him weeping; and she began to wash His feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head; and she kissed His feet and anointed them with the fragrant oil.
What does he say a “burden” is in the prophets?

He says “the burden means utterance, divine utterances, prophetic utterances” to natural cities and kingdoms. He says God sometimes hides a second message in them: “that’s how he makes them a mystery.”
Why does he say prophecy switches from nations to the day of the Lord?
He says God will be “speaking directly to like Egypt” and then “all of a sudden he switches.” He says “that’s how he hides things in his scriptures, that’s how he makes them a mystery.”
What does he say “the day of the Lord” means?

He says it is the time when the Lord comes, “the period before he comes,” and “a period of what he’s doing at the time he’s doing it.” He says each generation can experience what God is doing in its day of the Lord.
Does he say man will destroy the world with weapons?

He says that back in the 1950s everyone preached God would use the atomic bomb to destroy the world, and answers “God don’t need man’s help when he is going to do something.” He says this destruction “comes from God and people are going to know it’s from God.”
What does he mean by an “Israelite Christian”?

He says Israel was the northern kingdom that “worship God with things they devised in their own heart,” never had a good king, and served God “the way they thought was appropriate for their mind.” He says a tip-off is the statement “well, I believe,” as if believing justifies everything.
Does he say believers must escape the great day of the Lord?

He says people who don’t know the Bible “think we got to escape this great time of the Lord,” but “he is going to be merciful to us during it, that means we’re not going to be destroyed.” He says “it’s going to pay to serve Jesus in that day.”
Why does he say we must admit we are wrong?
He says “you can believe for righteousness, but until you admit you’re wrong and you repent and turn, you’re not saved.” He cites that with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
What does he say about the pre-tribulation rapture teaching?

He says people tell others they will not make it if they are not saved before the rapture, and that he has dealt with people who tried to commit suicide because of it. He says “that pre-tribulation rapture thing is very destructive.”
Why does he say you do not have to bend the scriptures?
He says “the scriptures are uniform throughout,” so “you don’t have to rubber band scriptures and bend them and stretch them.” He says there are seven things that will happen in that day.
Why does he say the wise men’s star could not be a normal star?

He says the nearest star is the sun and if it were moved closer we would boil, so they could not follow it to a specific house, and it disappeared and reappeared. He says it could have been an angel or “a little sun” God made, and that “it’s a supernatural event.”
What does he say about the word of knowledge?

He says it was added in the late 1940s: people “actually could foretell people’s lives, tell them about themselves accurately,” and God would heal or transform them. He says it brought a powerful presence and worship, with churches praising God for an hour.
What does he say about the 1960s outpouring in the denominations?

He says God poured out His Spirit on Episcopalians, Anglicans, Presbyterians, Lutherans, Methodists and Baptists, and in 1967 on the Catholic Church, and “he didn’t ask the Pope’s permission or anybody’s permission.” He says the Jesus people came along in the 1970s.
Does he say God loves people of every nation?
He says “God loves everybody in the earth. He created them and wants to bring them in,” and lists Eskimos, Mongolians and the people of the islands of the sea. He also says God loves Muslims.
What does he say about ministers in that day?

He says “ministers are going to be nothing” and “we need to learn to be like John the Baptist: we must decrease and he must increase.” He says too many ministers are letting people worship them and put their trust in them.
How does he sum up the gospel?

He says Jesus was born of a virgin, did signs and wonders, preached the kingdom of God, laid down His life, rose from the grave and ascended for the sins of the world, and “if you call on him he will forgive you, cleanse you and empower you to become a son of God.”

p: Pastor David G. Kincer explains the office of a prophet: a prediction, a sign, a message that lines up with the Bible—the real proof—and fulfillment. He warns about false prophets, recalls what he saw in decades of awakening, and shows prophets and teachers at work in Acts, urging believers to continue in the apostles’ doctrine and the more excellent way of love.
Why aren’t all believers prophets or teachers?

1 Corinthians 12:28 ranks apostles, then the office of the prophet, then teachers—but are all prophets or teachers? No; a body that was all eyes or all tongue couldn’t function. If God makes you the little toe, you are as great in his eyes as any apostle. Jesus promised to send prophets and scribes (Matthew 23:34, Luke 11:49).

items.t: Redemption without Restoration is Not Salvation Pt 1
items.d: A heathen king proclaimed Israel’s return; they built the altar, but adversaries and excuses stopped the work. Through Haggai and Zechariah God stirred the remnant: consider your ways, be strong and work.…
items.ser: Redemption Without Restoration Is Not Salvation · 1
tg: Redemption Without Restoration Is Not Salvation
p: A heathen king proclaimed Israel’s return; they built the altar, but adversaries and excuses stopped the work. Through Haggai and Zechariah God stirred the remnant: consider your ways, be strong and work. These are examples for us—we are God’s house.
Restoration—its promise, the problems that stopped it, and six steps, starting with a proclamation.

This session is called restoration. We’re going to see the start of the promise restoration, the problems that stopped the restoration, the source of the problem, and the solution to the problem. And I got a statement up there, “Redemption without restoration is not salvation.” Is it? If Christ purchased me by His blood and could not deliver me from alcohol and drugs and sexual immorality, then salvation is deliverance. He has to restore me back to His image and back to His likeness, back to right. Amen? And He has a restoration process, and we’re going to see it here in these three books. First, we’re going to find six steps to this restoration. How many steps? Six. All right. First, there has to be a proc- proclamation, a declaration to build the temple. Okay? And we have it. Ezra, chapter 1. In the first year of Cyrus, that’s in 539 BC, a heathen king, so that the word of the Lord would be fulfilled by Moses and by Jeremiah and by Daniel, the prophets, God stirred up the spirit of a heathen king of Persia and told that king to make a proclamation that the Lord God of heaven has given me, this heathen king, all the kingdoms of the earth and charged me to build him a house at Jerusalem in Judea.
A heathen king—a super sign that God was moving; then the chiefs rose up to build.

Now, here he’s using a heathen king to make a proclamation of what God is going to do. With every future prophet or future prophecy, I should say, there’s always a sign. Okay? So, these prophets today you know, watch out these people that give themselves a title of a office of a prophet. Who can predict the future and they try and they miss all the time. Prophets don’t miss. You got that? That’s what Deuteronomy says. If it doesn’t come to pass, don’t be afraid of the prophet. They They miss all the time. Anyway, the office of a prophet is someone that can predict the future and it happens, the plans of God. It is different when you say the baptism Holy Ghost is poured out on all flesh and they can prophesy. That’s for edification, exhortation, and comfort. Everybody can do that. All right. Prophets placing into the body of Christ is a step up from that. All right. Now, in Isaiah 44:28, we have the sign. 160 years before Cyrus, a heathen king, was even born. 160 years before, God said by the Isaiah the prophet, “Cyrus is my shepherd and shall perform all of my pleasure, even saying to Jerusalem, you shall be built and to the temple, your foundation shall be laid.” In verse chapter 45:4, “I have named you Cyrus, though you have not known me.” God let them know that it’s going to be a heathen king that did not even believe in God. That’s going to be used of God to do this work. You got it? Now, how many you know that’s a super sign? When God can come to a heathen and do something in his plans, that has to be God. All right? So, there’s a sign. First, there’s a proclamation, then there’s a sign that this thing has come. Now, Daniel chapter 10 verse 1, you remember, in the third year of Cyrus, king of Persia, a thing was revealed unto Daniel. So, where’s Daniel? At when the proclamation of the temple is to be built. He’s in Babylon. He didn’t come with the captives. There’s another Daniel that came listed in the genealogies, but not this Daniel. He still back in Babylon for some reason. We don’t know. Okay? Now, the Ezra chapter 1 verse 5 says, “Then rose up the chiefs of Judah, Benjamin, the priest, and the Levites, with all whose spirits God had raised up.” So, secondly, we have God stirring up, raising up the spirits of people to respond to the proclamation. God gets involved to go and build the house of the Lord. 49,637 to be exact. Left Babylon, and only like 6,000 and some went in. And they come back to Jerusalem, and they supported it with their finances in those verses. And the king of Babylon gave all the vessels that they had brought from the temple, God’s temple, when they destroyed it, gave it back to them, and sent them back to put them back into the temple.

Ezra 1:1-5: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and also put it in writing, saying, Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: All the kingdoms of the earth the LORD God of heaven has given me. And He has commanded me to build Him a house at Jerusalem which is in Judah. Who is among you of all His people? May his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel (He is God), which is in Jerusalem. And whoever is left in any place where he dwells, let the men of his place help him with silver and gold, with goods and livestock, besides the freewill offerings for the house of God which is in Jerusalem. Then the heads of the fathers’ houses of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests and the Levites, with all whose spirits God had moved, arose to go up and build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.
The altar—with weeping and joy together.

So, and uh chapter 3 verse 1, they built the altar. That’s the first thing they built was the altar in the seventh month in the first year. See, Daniel is still back in Babylon. The second thing they did is they built the foundation in the second year, the second month. Okay, and the Bible says that they could hear the noise afar off from those rejoicing and those weeping. Do you remember that verse? Chapter 3, the last verse. They could hear them afar off. The ones that were older were weeping because they had seen the temple before and they were moved deeply in their spirit to see it being be rebuilt. The younger ones were just rejoicing and excited about the temple being built. So, in a church service when God is moving, if there’s weeping and there’s joy, is it okay? Yeah. Depends on where you’re at. Both things can happen. All right. Now, adversaries. Ezra chapter 4 verses 1 through 4. Their adversaries, people of the land, said, “Let us build with you. We want to help you build God’s house after they got back to Jerusalem.” Now, these people of the land that said, “You know, we worship God, your God, like you do.” They were really people that were brought from different nations by the king of Assyria years before. And 2 Kings chapter 17 verse 33 explains what these people were.

Ezra 3:1-3: And when the seventh month had come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered together as one man to Jerusalem. Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his brethren, arose and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the Law of Moses the man of God. Though fear had come upon them because of the people of those countries, they set the altar on its bases; and they offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD, both the morning and evening burnt offerings. Ezra 3:12-13: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of the fathers’ houses, old men who had seen the first temple, wept with a loud voice when the foundation of this temple was laid before their eyes. Yet many shouted aloud for joy, so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people, for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the sound was heard afar off.
Adversaries weakened and troubled them and hired counselors—typical of American Christians who quit.

When these people came, because they worshipped their own gods, God sent beasts among them to destroy them and so they you know, they they got the priest to find out what’s wrong and they found out what the problem was and so they they acknowledge God. See, they went to the temple and they went through the rituals and they went through the ceremonies, but 2 Kings says they feared the Lord and served their own gods in 17:33. And so the the people of God said, “No, you’re not building with us.” Now, how many of you know the people of God had had idols all the time from coming out of Egypt to the captivity and in the captivity. Yeah. Okay. So, here they don’t want these heathen helping build the temple, but they had worshipped idols also. Anyway, so when they were told no, these adversaries, the Bible says in Ezra chapter 4, weakened them, troubled them, hired counselors, legal counselors to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus, who died in 530 BC. So, they had 9 years. They had the source of the proclamation still living, Cyrus the king. They could have went directly to Cyrus the king and shut these people’s mouths. And they didn’t. Now, are we living in a generation where our enemies are troubling us, weakening our hands, hiring legal counselors to stop the promotion of the Bible and Jesus Christ? Isn’t that true? Yeah. What do you think all these things are written for? So, you can learn and know how to respond when these things happen in your generation. Now, verse 24, then ceased the work of the house of God to the second year of Darius the Great in 522 BC king of Persia, 17 years. The temple has gone with just an altar and the foundation, and that’s it. Nothing else done. All right? So, we have the proclamation of the restoration and now we have the sign and the adversity. And then the work ceased. And that’s your typical Christian in America. Oh, it’s true. You know, they want out of drugs or they want something from God, you know, they want to get saved from sin that is destroying their life and they come, “Oh, yeah, I’ll restore and restore.” And then bam. A little opposition you give them the sign, Christ dying on the cross and all that, then a little opposition, bam. They stop in their tracks. How many met those kind of Christians? Yeah. You probably one up. Stop being involved in God’s house. Now, why did they start rebuilding is my next question. Why all of a sudden after 17 years they start rebuilding the house of God? Is that a good question?

Ezra 4:4-5: Then the people of the land tried to discourage the people of Judah. They troubled them in building, and hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
Why aren’t we building God’s house?
Excuses—“the time is not come”; consider your ways: you eat but never have enough.
Why aren’t we building God’s house?

Because if we can answer that question, then we can answer the question for us why we aren’t building the God’s house. Haggai chapter 1 verse 1. Okay? In the second year of Darius, in the first day of the sixth month, Haggai prophesied to Zerubbabel, the civil leader, to Joshua, the high priest, the temple leader, the spiritual leaders. And this is why they started rebuilding. Someone lifted up their voice to encourage, inspire, and to build. And when the word of the Lord began to be spoken, then they got stirred to build the house. Do we need voices today proclaiming the things of God to us? Or do we need more psychology? Now, the second question is why did they stop building in the first place? Why did they stop? At the very beginning of their goal, and this is what I’ve seen in my 40 some years of serving God. I’ve seen them come in. I’ve seen a genuine meeting with God, genuine salvation in all denominations I’ve preached in, and I’ve preached in almost every denomination there is and independent churches. And then a little time goes by and they’re just religious people. Have you seen that? People on fire, and then people dead on a doornail. This is why they stopped rebuilding. This is the source of the problem. Yes, they had adversity. Yes, they had people frustrating them, hiring counselors against them, weakening them, attacking them, but here is the real reason they stopped. Are you ready? Haggai prophesied and says, “This people say the time is not come that the Lord’s house should be built.” They decided it’s not the timing. They had the proclamation, they had the sign, they had a little opposition, and then they decide, “Well, it’s just not the right time to do this.” Hallelujah. You call it excuses. You know, I got a family to raise now. I’m not a teenager anymore. I got to be a responsible worker. I got to be a responsible mother. And I I haven’t got time. When I get older, all these excuses. And we’re not building the house of God in America. We’re going from church to church. When we don’t like a church, we go to another one. But we are not building and involved in building God’s house in America, and this is the reason. We got some excuse. Can I hear an amen? Well, I’m young. I’m going to college and all. Well, so what? You throw God out of your life because you’re going to college learning a job skill? Are you with me? Well, I’m old now. I’m I’m ready for retirement. Show me one person in the Bible that retired from spiritual activity. Give me one. But that’s our mentality. Excuses. Can you say the word excuses? Well, you didn’t say it with very much enthusiasm. Well, I don’t like to what they preach at my church, so I’m just not going. Is that an excuse? That’s an excuse. Is it viable before God? No. You’re supposed to come and contribute to solving the problem. Amen. Now, and so the prophet said, “Is it time for you to live in your own houses and build your own houses while my house is laid waste? You got time to build your own house and you don’t have time to build mine?” Is that a good argument from God? Yeah. I mean, the adversaries didn’t stop them from building their own house. The adversaries didn’t stop them from getting a job and working and and all and and and providing and all that didn’t stop them at all, but boy, no, it’s not the time for God’s house. Boy, God’s got a good argument here, doesn’t he? He says, “Consider your ways. You’ve not have not enough to eat. You clothe yourself, but you’re not warm. You earn wages to put it in bags with holes because I called for a famine, a drought because of mine house that is laid waste and all run into their own houses.” And then he says, “Build my house.” Is he saying that to the Christians of America? Yes. “Build my house.” “I will take pleasure in it. I will be honored and I am with you.” Hallelujah.
Why aren’t we building God’s house?

Haggai 1:2-6: “Thus speaks the LORD of hosts, saying: ‘This people says, “The time has not come, the time that the LORD’s house should be built.” ’ ” Then the word of the LORD came by Haggai the prophet, saying, “Is it time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, and this temple to lie in ruins?” Now therefore, thus says the LORD of hosts: “Consider your ways! “You have sown much, and bring in little; You eat, but do not have enough; You drink, but you are not filled with drink; You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; And he who earns wages, Earns wages to put into a bag with holes.”
He said I am with you and stirred up the remnant; be strong and work.

How many like that statement? “I’m on your side. I’m with you. I’ll add the ingredient that you’re lacking. Just get busy building.” Hallelujah. And from that prophecy the Lord backed it up and stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel, the civil leader, Joshua, the spiritual temple leader, and all the remnant of the people. How many of you know what the remnant of God is? In Revelations it tells us what the remnant are. They that have the testimony of Jesus and keep his commandments. How many of you have the testimony of Jesus? How many of you have a goal to keep his commandments? Yeah. Then you’re the remnant. And he says he stirred up the remnant, the remainder, to get busy on the house of God. And so they came and did the work of the house on the 24th day of the sixth month. It took them 24 days to get organized and get fired up, you know, they had a few revival meetings, I guess, and all that. Come on, Haggai, prophesy a little more. Yeah, come on, let’s have Oh, when you got CHARGED UP OH, OKAY, WE’RE READY. I KNOW Christians THAT’S 24 years and they haven’t moved. Let alone 24 days. Hallelujah. Haggai chapter 2 verses 1 through 4. In the seventh month, the next month, 21st day, Haggai comes to them. They’re working on the building. Hallelujah, they’re all working on the temple and everything. Haggai comes along and says, “Thus saith the Lord, be strong, Zerubbabel. COME ON, BE STRONG. UH GOD HASN’T GIVEN YOU A SPIRIT of fear, but of POWER AND A LOVE AND A STRONG MIND. COME ON, Zerubbabel, be strong.” And he said, “BE STRONG, OH Joshua, TO THE HIGH PRIEST, the spiritual leader. Be strong, all you people of the land, not just the remnant. Maybe you don’t have a goal to keep the commandments of God, but you got the testimony of Jesus.” He said, “All of you, get with the program.” Amen. Be strong. Don’t be weak. Don’t let your adversaries weaken you, frustrate you. Don’t give excuses. He says, “Be strong.” And then that magic word called work. Say it. Work. Work takes effort. You can’t build the house of God sitting at home. It takes effort. You got to get involved. And you can’t build the house of God without tools. So, you what? Need to learn the word. The Bible says, “My word is a hammer.” Some of us need a little bashing. You know, shape us. That’s what they do with a hammer. They shape the metal into something beautiful. Isn’t that right? “My word is a fire. Some of us need baked. You know, we fall apart too easy. We need some firmness in us. The fire will bake you, get some strength in you, and will beautify you. How many you know with the pottery pottery comes out from the fire, it has a sheen to it. It has a beautiful look to it. And I can go on and on. We need the tools. And the word of God is our tools. Acts chapter 2, he says, “And again he says, I am with you.” Acts 2:17, “I will pour out my spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy.” See, Haggai prophesied. He spoke for edification, exhortation, and comfort to the body of Christ. And the body of Christ responded. And here’s where us spirit-filled people really missed it for years. We put so much emphasis on tongues and not on prophecy. Tongues without interpretation does not give anyone understanding. And it divided the church. Because they were so persistent about tongues being the magical sign. When Acts chapter 2 says, “Your sons and your daughters will what?” Prophesy. “Your servants and your maidservants will prophesy. Speak the encouraging living word of God and it will stir people to build themselves and others up in God.” Hallelujah. Didn’t Paul said you could all prophesy one by one? Yeah, he’s not talking about the office of a prophet there. He’s talking about edification, exhortation, and comfort. Hallelujah. Can we do it today? Yes. Now, in the eighth month, in the second year, Darius, in the second year of Darius the Great, this is uh 17 years later.

Haggai 1:13-14: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you, says the LORD.” So the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of the LORD of hosts, their God, Haggai 2:4: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD; ‘and be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work; for I am with you,’ says the LORD of hosts.
A second witness—be not as your fathers who didn’t listen; Daniel’s prayer of repentance.

Came the word of the Lord into Zechariah’s. Out of two or three witnesses, let everything be established. So, here comes Zechariah, man. He comes in on the eighth month in the second year. And he says, “The Lord has been sore displeased with your fathers.” In Zechariah 1:1 through six. He’s displeased with your forefathers. Therefore, say unto them. Who’s them? The remnant, the people, all the people of the land. Say to all the people of the land, “Turn unto me and I will turn to you.” Seek me and I’ll find you. See? Repent unto me and I will turn, repent unto you. Is that a good statement? See? People are saying they’re waiting on God. You know, God’s been waiting on us for a long time. And then he says, “Be not as your fathers, they did not listen to me nor turn from their evil ways.” Is And Israel didn’t. They didn’t listen and they didn’t turn from their evil ways. But my words and my statutes which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? What does he mean by that? God promised through the prophets, Moses, Isaiah, Jeremiah, that they’re going to go into captivity for disobeying God. And they went into captivity. Moses said in Deuteronomy, “In that captivity, if you will repent and turn and admit you were wrong and you’re in captivity because of your sin, then I will forgive and heal and bring you out of captivity. That’s what God spoke through Moses hundreds of years before they went into captivity. And Zechariah is reminding them, “Don’t be like your forefathers and play spiritual games because God held them accountable and brought them into captivity and punished them and corrected them for their sin.” Got it? According to this scripture, they’re nothing. They’re bread for us. The gates of hell cannot prevail against it. First Corinthians 3:9, we are laborers together with God. You are God’s building. Who is God’s building? You are. We are. Yeah. Hebrews 3:6, Christ is a son over his own house. Whose house? We are. See, God is not talking about a natural building. He’s talking about what? 1 Corinthians 10:11: Now all these things happened to them as examples, and they were written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the ages have come. 1 Peter 2:5: you also, as living stones, are being built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

In all denominations he’s preached in.

tg: Redemption Without Restoration Is Not Salvation
p: God proclaimed a sign and backs His word. Adversaries will come, but we must give God our time and overcome excuses. Leviticus 19 calls us to rebuke without hate and respect others. He applies this to abortion, politics and faith, urging Christians to approach sinners as individuals.

And it’s also repeated in Matthew 1:24. Only there he’s not only named Emmanuel, he’s also named Jesus before birth. He stirred up the spirits of the early church to build God’s house. Mark 16:20, they went and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word with signs following. You preach of the word, Jesus will a confirm of the word. You know, preach of the word, there’s no confirmation of the word. Are you there? See what’s lacking in America then? Preaching the word because there’s tremendous things going on all over the earth, both especially in the southern hemisphere. Tremendous things, real genuine stuff. We need to get back to preaching the word. Could that be true? Yeah. Acts 2:46, they continued daily with one accord in the temple, breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart, unity, praising God. And having favor with all the people and the Lord added to the church daily as should such as should be saved. And so we see they were stirred up. They went out and preached and God started building his church. Okay.
Isaiah 7:14: Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: Behold, the virgin shall conceive and bear a Son, and shall call His name Immanuel.

Yes—Rome and religious leaders; keep preaching; later the work ceased; God backs His word.

But 2 Thessalonians 2:3, let no man deceive you. That day shall not come except there come a what? Falling away first. 2 Timothy 4:3. In other words, we want you to tell us what we want to hear. They will turn away their ears from the truth and shall be turned into fables. But watch you in all things. Even during this adversity, you be alert. Endure the afflictions and do the work of a what? Evangelist. See, evangelist is an in gatherer. See, keep preaching, keep prophesying, keep encouraging. Don’t let it get you. This is going to happen. And did it happen? Yeah. The dark ages. 500-,500 years. There’s very little voice about Jesus, the word, and building the church. The the Catholic Church had gone into gross darkness and gross sin. Just horrible. Now, that’s you know, they got to they got to measure up. They they got to accept the fact they botched it up. He died. He had to lay down his life and he rose again. I mean, do we have a sign or what? Yeah. Is it time to build God’s house or is it just time to build our own family? It’s time to build God’s house along with our family. Did Jesus stir up their spirits in the book of Acts in the New Testament church?
A seventh of our time—overcome excuses like sleeping in on Sunday; be wise and strong, not wimps.

Will he stir up our spirit? Yes, he will. He’ll back up his word. But we need to proclaim the word. Adversaries are going to try and weaken you, especially in your own family and your own friends. They’re going to trouble you. They’re our adversaries out there are going to hire counselors against you to frustrate our purposes. And Dan, I mean, Daniel said, “The house shall be built in troubleous times.” Isn’t that right? Isn’t that right? Well, why do we expect something easy? There’s going to be adversity, so let’s just get the building. The work of restoration is going to cease because of our excuses, our reasons, our justifications. We justify why we’re not doing something. Sound familiar? And all God asks for is 17th of our time. By the way, he didn’t ask for everything. Just oneth of your time. And then we overcome. And this is not only in the calendar of God, but it’s in every generation. It’s going to be in your life. When I was first saved, man, I was all fired up. Salvation was real. And then I got filled with the Holy Ghost. And man, that power, that that conviction, that drive inside was just powerful. Then Satan comes along and says, “Nothing really happened. You just made a fool out of yourself. You’re just talking gibberish when you’re talking tongue. And I had to overcome. You know, I work six days a week. Sunday come along. Well, you deserve to lay in bed and sleep in. See all these excuses come. You deserve But we got to overcome our excuses in our individual life in our generation and build the house of God by speaking what? The word of God by the inspiration of the Holy Spirit. Now let me tell you how easy it is. Are you are you ready to hear how easy it is to speak the word of God by the spirit? Are you ready for this? Look how easy it is. Jesus said, “My word is spirit.” So when I speak the word of God, am I speaking by the spirit? We just speak it and God it it’s alive. The spirit will back it up. Remember in Daniel, Daniel emphasized three times that in the last days there would be a wise people, a strong people. Did Haggi say be strong? See, he got it from what God told Daniel. He said these people would do great exploits. They would act with effectiveness. They would turn many to righteousness. They would know God and they would understand the times and understand what to do in the times. Now, what people are we got a goal to be in our last day generation? These wise, strong people or these wimps with excuses? Are you out there, church? See, we got a choice. We can be a contributor to building people’s lives, turning people to righteousness, or we can become religious and have no effect. Leviticus 19:1 17. Listen to this one closely. You shall not hate your brother in your heart, look down on, despise, have bad feelings for them.
How do we treat a sinning neighbor?
Rebuke him without hating; respect seniors and strangers; Christians don’t do tattoos.
How do we treat a sinning neighbor?

But you shall surely rebuke your neighbor. Correct. Okay. The neighbor’s wrong. You what? Correct them. It’s not even your brother, just those around you. Least you incur sin because of him. Least you invite sin or permit sin. See, if you don’t stand up and speak the word of God, which is the spirit, then your absence of speaking is permitting sin in people’s lives and in your community and in your nation. And you cannot win over your adversaries with that kind of attitude, can you? See, in America, we can’t permit sin. We can’t invite sin by being silent. And we can’t hate those who are violating God’s word. You got that? Now, this is tough. You really need the Holy Ghost and a real word of God for this kind of level of growth of Christianity. Hallelujah. Now, let’s continue. Now, I I want to remind you, he’s saying this statement in the midst of these laws about the poor. Take care of the poor by not gathering all your crops in. They can go out and work and gather it in. The poor can get it. Seniors, respect seniors. Stand up. Give older people respect. See, strangers, respect strangers. Well, everybody’s getting them. I’m going to get me one. Now, Christians don’t do tattoos. Hallelujah. Okay, people do that and they have fat haircuts, you know, don’t cut your hair for a certain cause or a certain reason, you know, just just be normal. He’s saying be normal and right judgment. He said, “Judge, right judgment.” And when you do business, have perfect scales. Don’t cheat people and judge what? Right judgment. Make right decisions. Right in the middle of all this, he comes up with now don’t hate these people that are violating it, but don’t allow them to permit sin in the land and by your silence invite sin in the land. They’re going to turn other people to their sin, their crime. You understand that? But you got to do it without despising, hating them, and looking down on them. Why? Because they’re part of the restoration. God wants to what? Restore them. You shall not take vengeance. Oh, I’m going to fix these people. No, you shall not take vengeance. You don’t have vengeance in your heart. Or bear any grudge against the sons of your people, these people that are sinning, harboring bad feelings. You see, you can’t hate Obama. I don’t care if you like him or not in his politics. You’re not allowed as a Christian to hate him.
How do we treat a sinning neighbor?

Leviticus 19:17-18: ‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him. You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the LORD. Leviticus 19:32-34: ‘You shall rise before the gray headed and honor the presence of an old man, and fear your God: I am the LORD. ‘And if a stranger dwells with you in your land, you shall not mistreat him. The stranger who dwells among you shall be to you as one born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God. Correcting without despising—get them to listen to your cause; give understanding.

You understand that? And Christians get mad at me for this, but it’s true. I have to keep a right attitude about this. And I’ll show you why. But you shall love your neighbor as yourself. If you mess up, how do you want them treating you to correct you? You want them to hate you, ban you from the community, lock you in prison for life because you stole a loaf of bread. Are you there? Are you wanting them because of your stand for right to stone you just because you’re standing for right? Or do you want them to listen to your cause? Are you out there now? See, this is maturity. And this is the first and second commandment. All the apostles, I mean, all the prophets, all the law is based on love God and love your neighbor as yourself. Isn’t that right? And right in the middle of all these sins, he makes this commandment. Love these people that are sinning and correct them. So, do we need to speak out in America? Yeah. Who do we need to speak out to? The ones who are violating what is right and the Christians who through lack of understanding are backing up the ones who are violating what’s right because they haven’t taken time to get the understanding. So, we need to what? Give them the understanding so they can be a wise and understanding and strong people. Can I hear an amen? Amen. Does that make sense? Hallelujah. Now, here’s our enemies in our generation. This is our enemies. Homosexuals talk horrible about Jesus and the Bible. The Bible isn’t a book of truth. It’s fairy tales. Jesus is not God. Now, oh yeah. Are you are you getting this? But if we don’t speak up, if we don’t build God’s church, and we don’t do it with the right attitude, that’s exactly where our nation’s headed. Morality restores ruined lives. Morality morality corrects without any hate, without any vengeance. I can’t go around and say, “You’re not a Christian because you’re democratic.” I can’t do that.

Don’t get on TV promoting it. Get back in the closet. I’m hoping I’ve given you something to think on.
How much time does God ask?
Who should you stand up for?
What does he say about liberals?
They talk more and say nothing.
What could happen four years from now.

p: Continuing the series on surviving tragedy, Pastor David G. Kincer shows how Job’s friends came with false accusations and doctrines: that only the guilty suffer, that God doesn’t trust His servants and that no one can be just. Satan, not God, caused Job’s losses; reject the lies but not the friends, and pray for them as Job did.
What must you reject to survive tragedy?
The lies of friends: their false accusations, false doctrines and false solutions. Job was covered with painful boils, marred like Jesus on the cross.

items.d: Pastor David G. Kincer works through Paul’s sermon in Acts 13. The people and rulers of Jerusalem believed in God but didn’t know him or the scriptures, so they killed the body God lived in. God raised him…

p: In this session on present truth, Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that after the falling away God began the restoration of all things foretold in Acts 3. He traces what he says God restored step by step, from the Bible in the common language, Bible morals and justification by faith to believer’s baptism, divine healing, Holy Spirit baptism, unity, the five offices and praise, warns how restored truths were distorted, and says God will restore anyone now.

Not the last days salvation season many false prophets boy we got them antichrist Christian persecution and martyrs the falling away the restoration the refreshing the knowledge increasing Israel becoming a nation wars famines plagues and earthquakes and no one knowing the time they all missed it is proof that the Bible is. What are the foundational doctrines of Christ in Hebrews 6?
He lists repentance from dead works, faith toward God, doctrines of baptisms (water, the Holy Spirit and into the body of Christ), laying on of hands, resurrection of the dead and eternal judgment.
He says there is only one judgment and it is eternal, either in the lake of fire or with Christ in a new heaven and new earth.
What is the Bible definition of faith?
From Hebrews 11:1 he says faith is the substance, the reality, of things hoped for and the evidence, the proof, of things not seen.
He says not in the wisdom of men, your own faith, someone else’s faith or the church, but in the power, the supernatural ability, of God to perform his promises.
Were the Anabaptists against water baptism?
He says they were against infant baptism, not water baptism; they taught you must be water baptized after you repent, not as a baby.
What gets lost when groups divide over doctrine?
He says loving God, loving your neighbor and loving yourself gets lost amid theology.
What are the three kinds of prophecy?

He says edification and exhortation to the body of Christ, which almost anyone can do; the office of a prophet, who predicts and it comes to pass, seldom seen; and personal prophecy confirming a position in the body of Christ.

He says he does not care how many times you think you failed Christ; he will restore you and refresh you, even out of the time you missed.

items.d: Pressure from the world causes spiritual implosion, like a crushed tanker or the 2008 crash. God finished His house in Darius’ sixth year. Restoration must be maintained—grace, faith and repentance—and each…
p: Pressure from the world causes spiritual implosion, like a crushed tanker or the 2008 crash. God finished His house in Darius’ sixth year. Restoration must be maintained—grace, faith and repentance—and each generation must pursue godly character.
Collapse from outside pressure—like a tanker in California or the 2008 real estate crash; the world’s pressure overcomes people.

We are teaching on restoration from Ezra, Haggai and Zechariah. Today’s session, session nine, I have titled implosion. Okay, implosion is a inward collapse resulting from an external pressure that’s higher than the e internal pressure. Okay. It also has the modern day meaning of a complete economic failure. Complete economic collapse or government collapse uh as a result of poor management uh in laws and in finances. And so I have some illustrations on the screen here. This tanker in Raymond, California. Uh they were emptying out ethanol out of the tank by of course a vacuum and the people who were doing it forgot to follow the instructions and they did not open a vent. So when the ethanol got out to a certain measure, the air pressure collapsed that 1 in thick steel. You see, if the inward pressure is not greater than the outward pressure, it will collapse. It will implode. We have uh here I’ll give you an illustration. Let me have Nicole up here. I I need one of the weak-handed ones in the congregation. Okay, now Nicole. Yeah, try to crush that bottle. That can no chance, huh? See, the inward pressure is higher than the outward pressure. Now, if I brought Diamond up here and showed him how to do it, he could bust this. Okay. Now crush that one. Piece of cake. Why? Because the outward pressure now exceeds the inward pressure. Got it? That’s implosion. And that’s what happens to Christians who do not maintain their inward man, their inward spirit. The pressure of the world to sin and to do wrong and to reject God’s things overcomes them finally and they implode. They collapse and they’re worthless and they have to be restored again. Here’s a chart of Bulgaria. Bulgaria in the 1900s, 1990s, they got free from Russia and they implemented some monetary uh choices that caused debt to excel, interest rates to rise, and hyperinflation. And you see the implosion. Okay. Then when they made some adjustments to sensible, secure financial decisions, look how fast it got back to normal. Now, now why didn’t they just do that here? Because government a lot of stupid people are in government and a lot of lobbying a lot of outside sources making bad decisions. Over here in 2008 we have the real estate market in America. Here is the roaring 20s. Here is the depression area went down to here in today’s money. You understand today’s money in 2008 because Republicans and Democrats, liberals and conservatives made in government in Congress some bad financial decisions for the real estate market of America. I have the law that they passed. They are all guilty including the president at the time because he could have vetoed it. So suddenly in 2008 the bottom dropped out of real estate. You see an implosion. Why? Because the outward pressure overcame the inward right decisions to maintain a healthy real estate market. You understand church? Now with that, remember last week we told you that there is a new candlestick presented in Zechariah. It has on each side of it olives where the oil comes from with two golden pipes from each one. We suggested to you that this is Jesus and the Holy Spirit who stand before God. The anointed ones who stand the sons of oil who stand before God. So they have a continuous stream flowing out of them into this bowl or spring which the New Testament says we have in us. All right? But a spring’s no good if it’s not what fed with continuous water. It dries up. So, see, when we break this relationship, this connection with Jesus and the Holy Spirit, we dry up. You can you can say things by faith all you want to, but you’re dry. You have nothing to give out to the lamps. There are seven pipes to seven lamps. Okay? Do you remember that? Hallelujah. Now, we’re going to go to Ezra chapter 6 and be teaching out of Ezra today.
The sixth year of Darius—God did it, not human beings; freed from Satan’s authority.

This house was finished in the sixth year of Darius the king. Okay, they completed the house. Now, remember last week we learned that this is an illustration of the church, the real house God wanted to build. God was never interested in a man-made house except to illustrate what he wanted to do in the spiritual house. Hebrews 9:11, Christ being the high priest of good things to come by greater and more perfect tabernacle not made with hands. Human, no human involvement. And that’s what the candlestick and Zechariah shows us. There’s no human involvement in the man-made house. The priests had to go get the oil. They had to plant the trees, cultivate the fruit, squeeze the oil out of out of the olive and bring it to the tabernacle and keep pouring it in the lamps. In the church, man cannot be involved. It is Jesus and the Holy Spirit that has that continual flow into God’s people and into the church. Amen. Hebrews 9:26, Christ has not entered into the holy places made with hands. Jesus never went into the tabernacle uh that was there at that day. And he had the right to. Of all people, he had the right to, but he couldn’t do it to fulfill scripture. Then people would have worshiped the holy places, the holy of holies again. He went into the heavens, which the Holy of Holies represented, to stand before God, make an intercession for us continually, all the time, not made with hands. You see, human beings have nothing to do with it. That’s the difference between the Catholics and the Protestants is we go straight to Jesus to confess our sins and get him to forgive us. Then the Catholics go to a man called a priest. See, we don’t. A man can’t forgive sins. Only Jesus, the Bible says, can forgive sins. Can I hear an amen? But us Protestants are just as bad as the Catholics when it comes to using this repent thing, knowing we’re going to go and do it again. Think about that one. Which are the figures, the models, the shadows, the illustrations of the true things. But he went into heaven itself. Now remember what we remember that last week. We are that house. We are that church that God wants to build our individual lives and as a group. Now let’s look at the character of those that are building who finished the house. They built it and they finished it. Let’s look at their character. You know what kind of principles did these people have? Well, number one, they came out of captivity. All right? Not everybody came out of captivity when God told them to come out of captivity. Captivity to the king of Babylon. We today are in the captivity to the king king of the kingdom of darkness who is Satan. And we’re supposed to be transported out of the kingdom of darkness into the kingdom of light. Not under the captivity of the authority of Satan. Are you hearing me? See, these people come out of that old government, that old king, that old power, and they came out to the Lord. You see, we can’t just come out. We got to come out to something. And so, they came out to the Lord Jesus to seek him through prayer and praise and worship and the word and fasting and and these things that cause us to find him. All right? And number three, they separated themselves from the filthiness of the heathen. See, that’s what repentance is. See, the nations do sexual immorality. They get intoxicated and drunk. They take drugs. They lie. They steal. They do all these things. They neglect the house of God. But not people that are responding to the call of God to restore his house, whose house you are. Amen. See, that’s the character they had. And if we want full restoration in our life, we’re going to have to get that character, aren’t we? Yeah. It’s for our illustration. Come on. He said, “These were written for our instruction. Otherwise, you’re not going to stay building the house and finishing it. You’re going to give up and quit.” So, the fourth thing they did is they ate the unleavened bread after the house was finished with joy. The feast of unleavened bread. This is maintaining.
Ezra 6:15: Now the temple was finished on the third day of the month of Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
Like a new car, faith needs upkeep; the Passover was a three-part feast—grace, faith and repentance.

You see, if I buy a car, a brand new car, if I do not maintain it, changing the oil, lubing it, you know, putting the right air pressure and the tires and all that, I am going to destroy that car. And when I was in third world countries, I seen tractors, agricultural tractors sitting there given to it by missionary groups in America. The people down there had no understanding of maintaining a mechanical device. And so they just drove the tractor till there was no oil in it. It froze up and then they just let it sit where it was. You understand? See, if we don’t maintain in working order what we have, we’re going to lose it. Now, church, that was good. And a lot of us in the Christian world are frozen. Our engine has stopped producing power because we haven’t maintained our spiritual life. Can I hear an amen? And you’re just waiting for the rapture to come and hope you can hang on. Instead of being an effective force in the church world and in the earth, you’re just a memorial. See, a fossil is a memorial, a remembrance of something that once had life and lost it. Hallelujah. Now it is important to know that unleavened bread feast included just before it the feast of Passover and right after it the feast of first fruits. It’s very important to know that it was a threepart feast from the 14th day of the month, the 15th day of the month, the 16th day of the month, and then seven days after the 15th day of the month and and including the 15th day for seven days unleaven was kept. Well, the Bible says in 1 Corinthians 5 that Jesus is our Passover. So, see, we got to come to Jesus like this morning. We’re going to be taking communion. Why? To remember that he died for us. He rose from the grave, that his blood cleanses from all sin, that he has given us a covenant, that he will put his word in our minds and our heart. We can all know him from the least to the greatest. He will be our God and we will be his people and our sins and iniquities he will be merciful to and remember no more. That’s important. Why? We maintain because we make mistakes, don’t we? So we got to what? We got to lubricate oursel. We got to put oil back into our engine. Then come the feast of unleaven bread. Unleaven bread is was done several days before taking all the leavenan out of the house. Not not just bread that was leaven. Even leavenan couldn’t be in the house. No levan, no yeast. Why? Because yeast infects whatever it is put into that’s what yeast does. You put a little yeast in dough, it leavenvens the whole dough, doesn’t it? Yeah. And that’s sin. So we put away sin. This is why it’s important that the church in America get back to the gospel. Not just grace and faith, but grace and faith and repentance, leaving that sinful world behind, not doing what the heathen do. That’s the call of Christ. Amen. They are brainwashing the church in America, making them think they’re all going to heaven and they’re living in sin. And God is a just God. He can’t allow a habitual sexual immoral person that believes in Jesus to go to heaven and a habitual sexual immoral person who doesn’t believe in Jesus to go to hell. That’s unjust because the sentence is the breaking of the law. And what law did they break? Thou shalt not commit sexual immorality. Believer or non-believer. Can I hear an amen? All right. So then the 16th day comes and that’s the sheath of first fruits. They would take the very first ripe grains out of the field and they would offer them. This was an illustration of Christ rising from the dead. It says there in 1 Corinthians 5 that cleanse yourself of that leavenan that you might be an unleavened person with sincerity and truth not the old leavenan of malice and wickedness. Amen. So, see, we have to do that. And we got to maintain our lives or we’re going to implode.

Ezra 6:19-22: And the descendants of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month. For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves; all of them were ritually clean. And they slaughtered the Passover lambs for all the descendants of the captivity, for their brethren the priests, and for themselves. Then the children of Israel who had returned from the captivity ate together with all who had separated themselves from the filth of the nations of the land in order to seek the LORD God of Israel. And they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days with joy; for the LORD made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
What happened to the old generation?
They died—will you pursue character for a fully restored life?
What happened to the old generation?

Hallelujah. How many are willing to pursue this character to see not only your life totally restored, but others around you? Lord, you see our hands. What’s the matter with the rest of you, man? This is a big big invitation from God. God never makes an invitation and he doesn’t back up. It doesn’t matter what you think about yourself. It’s what God thinks he can do through you. It’s what God knows he can do through you, I should say. Amen. Now 47 years later when we go to Ezra 7:es 1-5 47 to 50 years somewhere around there we find that Ezra some priests and Levites singers and porters and temple servants are still in Babylon. What are they doing in Babylon? Now I know when you read this you ask all these questions. Actually this stuff comes through hours. It comes through hours of preparation. It this isn’t easy stuff to get. I just say that as a joke. 70 years from the time the first captivity come to build the house. 70 years more like 80. Okay. You know, they started 30, 40 years old, 20, they’re they’re gone. So, what are these priests, Levites, singers, and porters doing in Babylon? They are the children of parents who made the wrong choice not to go and leave captivity and get involved in building God’s house. They rejected the message. How many you know parents can be a disaster in a home? Their choices directly affect their children. Directly affect them. But God, he sees these children. He sees Ezra. Okay? He knows what’s going on. Are you with me? Are you getting the picture here? Yeah. Parents, I I submit to you today how you live your life. Your kids are watching everything you do. They’re learning from you. Now, God comes and restores the children of the parents making these bad decisions. See, God cares about them. But guess who didn’t care about them? No record of concern from the restored people 80 years ago. No record of sending missionaries back to Babylon and saying, “Come on out. Come out, man. Things are tough over here, but the house of God is being built to glory and all these things.” They never got a concern for those people back in Babylon, especially the second generation whose parents had rejected the message of God. And folks, that’s the start of implosion. See, they were in the house and they were had the joy and they were keeping the feast and they were worshiping and all that, but they had no concern. And part of the inward pressure that keeps the us from collapsing and imploding is releasing the water that he gives us, the word that he gives us. That’s part of what we got to do. Are you there? You see, the word is so important. But I’m going to prove it to you. You ready for this? See, it isn’t my rolling on the floor as a Pentecostal or shaking because the Holy Ghost is upon me. That that that’s nothing. It isn’t signs and wonders. Okay, I’m going to prove it to you. You ready for this? When they went to get Jesus, the temple leaders sent these guys to get Jesus and arrest him. They went down there and Jesus was preaching. And they came back empty-handed. And when the temple leader says, “Where’s Jesus?” They said, “Never rolled on a floor like a man like this man. Never did we ever see anyone shake in the spirit like this man. Is that what he said? No. He said never spake a man like this man. See the end result is the release of the word that Jesus and the spirit bring to you. Are you there church? I’ll prove it again. Stephen, a man full of faith and power, wasn’t even an apostle. No record of him being apostle. He was a waiter on tables. He did the natural things in the gathering of God’s people there. But the Holy Ghost was upon him. And when he prayed for people, they got healed. They brought him before the Sanhedrin. And when he got done talking, you know, was it his shaking of the spirit? Was it a miracle that caused them to stone him? Or did they stone him because they could not challenge the spirit and wisdom by which he spake? Yeah. See, they didn’t stone him for miracles. They didn’t stone him because he could speak in tongues and prophesy and heal the sick and all this. They stoned him because the word that he spoke by the spirit of God, church, that’s good stuff. And so, we got to get the word and we got to let the what? Word go out of us.
What happened to the old generation?
Haggai 2:3: ‘Who is left among you who saw this temple in its former glory? And how do you see it now? In comparison with it, is this not in your eyes as nothing?

No—human beings have nothing to do with it.

Maintenance—oil changes and lubing—keeps it going.

Come out—the house of God is being built.

items.d: The second generation didn’t help; diligence means hard work, not talk. Ezra prepared his heart to seek, do and teach God’s law. Laws should treat others rightly; Christians should stop blaming and engage…
p: The second generation didn’t help; diligence means hard work, not talk. Ezra prepared his heart to seek, do and teach God’s law. Laws should treat others rightly; Christians should stop blaming and engage, trusting God to turn leaders as He placed Esther for such a time.
What did the second generation fail to do?
Help—what is diligence? Hard work, not talk; a wise man is a man of few words.
What did the second generation fail to do?

Neither did the second generation coming up do anything to help those people. And there’s some other people coming up next week. There’s some other neglected people, but this week we’re dealing with Babylon. All right. Implosion. Now, let’s take a look at what Ezra accomplished in captivity. All right. He’s not He didn’t have a part in building the house of God. Wasn’t in that great move of God 80 years ago, but he made some good decisions. Here’s Ezra. This is what he This is what he did. He was a ready verse 7:6. He was a ready, a quick, skillful, diligent scribe of the words, laws, and statutes of the Lord. Now, how many know what the word diligent means? Hard work. Say it. Hard work. Not just work. Hard, consistent work. Not one of these guys that shows up late and takes five water breaks a day and 12 cigarette breaks and all the rest. No. A diligent person is one that works hard and consistent to uh accomplish what he set out to do. And they get skillful. All right. And they get quick. They can do things quicker. I was so fast when I was a mechanic that I had to send people home. I had to say we’re too busy because I could do break jobs, tuneups, and all this stuff so quick, way beyond the book hours that they would have knocked me over the head knowing that I charged them the book price and did it for about a third of the time. See, but when you keep doing things, you get good, especially when you have mechanical ability. All right, you get the get the picture. Yeah. See, why can’t some people be in their own business? They’re too slow. I have tried to help many of businessmen and they’re just too slow. They shouldn’t be in business. They’d be better off working for somebody because they they’re just not businessminded. Are you with me? And and that’s not a put down. We just got to accept who we are. All right. And a businessman have to be self-disciplined. You can’t there and stand there and chew the fat with customers for 20 minutes every time one comes in. You got to keep that assembly line moving, man. Are you with me? And some of us can’t get past the talk thing. Talk doesn’t get the car fixed. Are you with me? And talk doesn’t solve spiritual confusion. A wise man is a man of few words. Why? He’s in the word. He knows what to say. He says it and he shuts up. If they don’t believe it when he says the thing the first time, he knows they’re not going to believe it. He stands there and gives all these. Are you with me? All right. That he was in the words of God, the scriptures, the laws of God and the statutes. The statues are basically the uh uh shadow laws, the laws and the ceremonies that illustrated the truth to come. It’s used almost over 90% of the time for those kind of laws. There’s no penalty for those laws. You know, you you don’t get stoned if you break them or anything. Laws incorporate civil laws, which you do. p: God shakes heaven, earth and nations—seen in today’s wars. Zerubbabel becomes a signet ring. “In that day” points to the last days and the Branch, Jesus, who builds the house, bears the glory and heals all. God is angry with nations at ease and will comfort Zion.

And I said, “Lord, get them. I’m like the like the apostles, you know, rain down far from heaven, Lord. Show them who’s boss, man. Get these sinners.” But you got to remember that in God’s correction, he’s still after the nations. In Revelations 5:9, you have redeemed us to God by your blood out of every tribe, every tongue, every people, and every nation. So we have to look at the nations as God looks at them.

items.d: Israel prospered through prophecy as elders built. God used heathen kings. Their labor was unclean until they repented and restored the foundation. The altar points to Christ’s cross; our sacrifice is praise…
p: Israel prospered through prophecy as elders built. God used heathen kings. Their labor was unclean until they repented and restored the foundation. The altar points to Christ’s cross; our sacrifice is praise in action, and the feasts are fulfilled in Jesus.
Success through prophecy—elders built and prospered through Haggai and Zechariah.

Today’s session is called restoration prosperity or restoration success through prophecy. This prosperity and this success we’re going to find comes through prophecy. Prophesying, edification, exhortation, and comfort. In Ezra 4, you remember verse 24. The work on the house of God stopped until the second year of Darius, the king of Persia, which was 17 years later. And then you remember that it got started again because the prophets Haggi and Zachchariah prophesied unto the Jews in the name of the Lord God of Israel. They began to they began to speak that edification, exhortation, and comfort. In chapter 6 verse1 14 it tells us that the elders built. Elders should be builders not just titled people. They should be involved in building the house of God. The leaders built and they prospered through the prophesying. See they were successful from the prophecies of Hagi and Zachchariah and they finished the house. Now listen to this. According to the commandment of God, according to the commandment of Cyrus, king of Persia, heathen king that God named before he was born, 160 years before he was born.

Ezra 6:14: So the elders of the Jews built, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the command of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
Yes—Darius and Artaxerxes; God is bigger than their decisions; he recounts the 1990s California school voucher effort.

Darius, a heathen king, and Artaxerxes, the king of Persia. You see, government leaders, the Bible says, is in the hands of the Lord. Their heart, their mind is in the hand of the Lord. Like rivers of water. He can turn it any direction he wanted. And in this scripture, he turned it to use them to cause the restoration of God’s house, the restoration of God’s people. And this is so important because, you know, we got to realize our God is bigger than Washington DC. And we got to realize that our God is bigger than their decisionmaking. Now, let me give you an example of this. Back in the 90s, we were very close in California of passing a voucher system for parents to choose their own school, even private schools. $5,000 would go to any school they wanted. Okay? I was a champion of that voucher thing in the church circles. But my brethren, you know, like CLA, Christian Law Association, and some of these other groups, they were bound and determined that you can’t get anything from government or government will start telling you what to do. And no matter how much I showed them scriptures like this, they were so dogmatic in their ways and they had influence over the churches in California over the pastors and and pastors have influence over their congregation. And Gibbs just looked me right in the eye and he says, “Brother Kincer, I know you are a righteous man. I’ve never met a man like you. items.d: The church’s foundation is Jesus with the apostles and prophets. Foundational doctrines include repentance, faith and three baptisms. “My faith” rhetoric isn’t biblical faith; even demons believe. Blessed are…

James 2:19: You believe that there is one God. You do well. Even the demons believe—and tremble!
Water, into the body as God places you, and the Holy Spirit—tongues aren’t the only initial sign.

Could that be true? Now, baptisms, there’s three baptisms in the Bible. Baptism is a foundational doctrine, three baptisms. Water baptism, which we identify with the death, burial, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. Okay? No longer a serv- a slave of sin, but a slave to righteousness. You can read it right there in Romans 6, great illustration. When we go down into that water, we’re dying with Christ on the cross. When we come out, we’re coming out in his resurrection power. To no longer serve sin, but to serve right to powerful. So, water baptism is not an outward sign of an inward work. It is a principle that God uses to empower our life. Hallelujah. I hate that symbolic stuff. It’s a real thing. The second one is you’re baptized into the body. He places into the body as he sees fit. And if he don’t want you being a preacher, you’re not going to be a preacher. And these healing ministries, you know, we we lift them up and most of them aren’t healing anybody anyway. But we think, “Oh boy, what powerful men and women of God. What No. If God has placed you like Mary, all she did was birth Jesus. We find no miracles done in her life. We find her no no prophesying or anything else. But she birthed Jesus. If you just have been born again by Jesus Christ, and you’re just a person that tithes and comes to church and a great example of the things of God. Listen, no preacher has any higher reward than you do because that’s where God put you. Amen. See, he gives me the drive to study that Bible for 10, 14 hours a day. Most of you would wear out in 30 minutes. It’s a gift. See. And it only works if I keep applying it. If I don’t keep applying it, it dies, Jesus said. That which they had is taken away. I’ll give it to somebody else. Anyway, I’m throwing this out. Baptism into the body of Christ is one of the baptisms. And you can’t just go and take a little chart of well, let’s see, what are my gifts? Throw that stuff out. These things are supernaturally done. Are you there, church? By a supernatural God who decides. If you want to be a doorkeeper, you’ll be a doorkeeper. Your reward is just as good as your pastor’s or anybody else. Because you’re doing what God called you to do. And all of us have got to be a light to the world in the area God’s called us to be in. Then, there’s the baptism of the Holy Spirit. Now, listen. I’ve shared a lot of things about the baptism. I’m filled with the Holy Ghost. I’ve got saved in Assembly of God church. I’ve spoken in tongues and all that. But it was the power of the Holy Ghost that really got my attention. To drive me into the Bible. To check me when I wanted to do something wrong. That Holy Spirit would say, “No. Christians don’t do that.” I didn’t understand beings when I talked it. So, I had no understanding. I just felt it. And I loved the feeling. Don’t get me wrong. But I had that feeling before. Just not in the intensity that came when God filled me with the Holy Spirit and out of my innermost being rivers of life-giving water flowed. And so, I would ask the brethren, “On the day of Pentecost, they spoke in languages. They spoke in 15 different languages. And their own language. They weren’t speaking in tongues of angels. They were They were speaking in languages that were known that day. I said, “They didn’t need any interpretation. The people that heard them speak understood cuz they understood the language. There was no interpreters.” You see how I was born to analyze things? I I was just born that way. And yet, you’re telling me the tongues is the initial sign of the Holy Spirit. And And And And we don’t even interpret tongues in the Assembly of God. They just speak and that’s it. Yeah. Shaka moola, shaka moola, shaka my and then we all wait and and the presence of God’s there and that feels good. But we didn’t know beans what went on. I said the bottom line is on the day of Pentecost they were prophesying. They were prophesying in the languages of the 15 nations that were gathered there in Jerusalem. And those people could understand exactly what they were saying because they understood the language. Are you there? Hallelujah. And for people that don’t like tongues, the Bible says don’t forbid not to what? Speak in tongues. Paul plainly said it. Don’t stop the tongue stuff. And he says you can speak with tongues of men and of angels. It is biblical to speak in an unknown tongue that isn’t an earthly language. It’s biblical. Can I hear an amen? If you don’t like it, that’s too bad. The Bible says it can happen and he gives an order. If there’s no interpretation, don’t talk in the church. And this is a problem I had with the Assembly of God. We had all these tongue tongue tongue and we had no interpretation and I’m a young Christian and I’m wanting to follow the Bible and they got no answers. Does that make sense to you? See, to me that’s just Bible logic. And this slaying in the spirit stuff nowhere in the Bible. Nobody fell backwards and except the people in the garden who were unbelievers. And they got right back up. They didn’t lay on the ground shaking in the garden speaking in tongues or anything. They were unbelievers and got right back up and arrested him. Because of the power of the name I am. When he said I am it just knocked them over. Are you with me? But folks, the baptism of the Holy Ghost is a Bible doctrine. It was promised to come, it did come, and it’s for everyone. Hallelujah. And I highly recommend getting it. Those who hear the word of God and keep it—you’ll stand before Him regardless.

What was it earlier? Yes, identifying with Jesus Christ on that cross by an act of coming to him. See, when you sin and you come to him at that altar, you’re identifying, you’re you’re giving him your sin. Hallelujah. Isn’t that beautiful? Oh, I forgot, resurrection of the dead, which is the second coming. So, the second coming is a what? Foundational baby doctrine. Don’t get all of thinking you’re some spiritual wizard because you got these things about this That’s baby stuff. There is a resurrection, Christ is coming, there will be a resurrection, you’re going to be held accountable, eternal judgment for what you say and do. I don’t care if you believe in him or not, you’re going to stand before him for what you say and do. That’s exactly what Jesus said, isn’t that right? Now, John chapter 8, verse 31, Jesus said to those Jews which believed on him. Okay? Now, these are Jews, people from the Old Testament bloodline. And they believed on Jesus Christ. They weren’t like the other Jews. They trusted him. Now, is this the altar or is this the foundation? This is the altar. They’re coming to Christ. They believe in Christ. Amen? So, Jesus used it. Jesus followed the Old Testament principles. You see, it’s this prophesying truth that’s going to set people free. And in our Pentecostal circle, with thus saith the Lord, and we’d even speak in old English language. Thou shalt, thou art, you know, like God is an old English language God. And that used to drive me nuts. And I don’t know when they use these and thous, man, we thought they were being spiritual. That’s just King James language, old English language. We don’t talk that way today. Luke 11:28, blessed are they, here Jesus said, blessed are they that what? Hear the word. There’s that that prophesying again. The word, the spoken word. And remember, if you’re speaking scriptures, the scriptures are spirit. Isn’t that right? See, there’s no higher level than just speaking the scriptures.
