items.d: The second temple looked like nothing, yet God said be strong—I am with you. A personal story of a father’s correction shows God’s correction is love. The silver and gold are His, and the latter…
p: The second temple looked like nothing, yet God said be strong—I am with you. A personal story of a father’s correction shows God’s correction is love. The silver and gold are His, and the latter house—believers as living stones, with Jesus as our glory—will be greater.
The new house seemed as nothing compared to the old—but God said be strong, I am with you; the remnant keeps His commandments.

Uh, we’re talking about restoration out of Ezra, Haggai, and Zechariah. Today, we’re going to be talking about the quality of restoration. It doesn’t do much good to restore something if we don’t restore it back in the quality that would it was originally designed for. Yes. And so, we’re going to look at the quality of restoration this morning. In the second chapter, we’re going to find that 1 month later after they started building the temple, building the foundation, Zechariah comes again and speaks to Zerubbabel, the civil leader, Joshua, the spiritual leader, and the remnant of the people. And he tells them to be strong for God is with them. Now, isn’t that a good message? You know. Be strong. I’m with you. Stop acting like wimps, church. Be strong, God is saying. I am with you. Um Then he goes on to list these people he’s talking to, and one of them is the remnant. The remnant in the Revelations 12:17, remember I brought this to you before, is the seed of the woman in the wilderness. Okay, that had the testimony of Jesus and obeyed his commandments. See, that’s the remnant. The remnant isn’t just people that believe in God. You see? The remnant are those that not only believe, but they have the testimony of Jesus and they keep his commandments. How many of you want to be a remnant, not just a believer? Yeah. And the Bible says the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy. See, the Bible explains all this stuff. If we would dare read it instead of all these other books. So, are you a remnant? Hallelujah. Thirdly, he says in this first few verses, verse three to be exact, “Who is left among you who saw this temple in the former glory? How do you see it now? It’s a comparison as nothing in your eyes.” And down in verse five, he says, “According to the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, my spirit remains among you. Do not fear.” Now, you got to remember, they come out of Egypt with idols. They had idols in Egypt. In the wilderness, they had idols. In the wilderness, they committed sexual immorality. They murdered innocent people. In Canaan land, they took their idols. And yet God says, “As I covenanted with you, my spirit remains among you.” They got drunk.

Haggai 2:3-5: ‘Who is left among you who saw this temple in its former glory? And how do you see it now? In comparison with it, is this not in your eyes as nothing? Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD; ‘and be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work; for I am with you,’ says the LORD of hosts. ‘According to the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, so My Spirit remains among you; do not fear!’ Revelation 12:17: And the dragon was enraged with the woman, and he went to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep the commandments of God and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
How he disobeyed his dad, got picked up by police, fled a gang through traffic, and his silent father’s correction—we should be ashamed and repent.

They got greedy. They broke every commandment. They neglected God’s house. They took his name and did detestable things in his name. And yet God said, “Like I covenant with you, my spirit, my presence is with you.” His presence is not his approval. Could that be an accurate statement? Just because you feel God’s presence does not mean he approves you. And I am shocked in all churches, especially spirit-filled churches, that the presence of God can come and there’s no embarrassment for our sins. I told you a story last week when I violated my dad’s wishes and the law when the police got me, took me in jail, my dad come to get me. I was embarrassed when my dad walked through that door. I was embarrassed when those policemen says, “Is this your son?” “Yes, that’s my son.” I was embarrassed. Why? Cuz I had violated his standards of morality. I had violated the laws of the state and the community. And I don’t see people getting embarrassed and ashamed of what they’re doing. And yet they like the presence of the God and they really like feeling and believing that he’s approving them. Are you hearing me? Now, let me switch this around. Sometime later, I’m walking down the street. It’s at night. And there’s five guys picking on a young man and his girlfriend. So, I run across the street to help she looked like a She wasn’t a weird girl. She looked like a normal everyday girl. So, I went over there to help. I didn’t know what they were going to do to this girl or anything. I went over there to help, you know. And as quick as I got across the street, and I was ready to help this couple, about 15 more come out of the park. I go, “Wow.” You know there’s a time to retreat? Yeah. They can say, “You’re just a coward.” No, there’s time to retreat. And suddenly I realized I am in a I These guys were Mommas. They were gangs in my community. These were the Mommas. Later I found out that this guy, this young boy with his girlfriend, was a brother of a high-ranking Stiletto gang member. Well, the Stilettos lived to the east of me, the Mommas lived to the north of me, and I’m in the middle of this thing. And so there’s a movie theater right there, and we we’re you know, when you don’t want to tangle, you start talking. So, we’re giving a lot of verbalized machoness that means nothing. And we move on across the street, and there’s the theater there, and I went right into the theater, went right by the guy taking up tickets. I I went in and sat down, and I watched the movie. And after the movie’s over, I came out. I thought everything had blown away. I go across the street, go across the next big street, and I’m headed toward house. I get right in the middle of the block, and around the corner comes about 15 of these Mommas. With bricks, clubs, knives. I mean, they’re ready for action. I said to myself, “Self, this isn’t good.” I look to my right, there is nothing but houses there and high fences and I was a pretty good jumper. If they’d have been low fences, I would have considered exiting that way. But these fences were too high. I looked behind me and 15 more are coming around the other corner with clubs and knives and bricks and whatever. I go, “Boy, this is really not good.” I looked to my left and there’s a busy street. Cars are just whizzing by. I can’t get run over by a car. So, I sit there and I look for stick. I look for something to pick up to defend myself. Nothing’s around. And uh they’re getting closer and closer. Finally, they’re right there, but as they just got to me, they made the mistake of starting to talk. You know, when you want like the good, the bad, and the ugly. The guy says, “If you’re going to shoot, shoot. Don’t wait.” Bam. You remember that scene? Yeah, if you’re going to do something, do it. Don’t wait. There was a opening in the traffic. I had noticed that there were apartments across the street. Their electronic door was held open and I took across that street, up that apartment, into that door, and shut it. So, these guys dispersed after a while. I stayed in there and these apartment people are telling me get out of there. You can’t be here. I said, “Make me.” I would rather face the apartment people than those guys out on the street. Toss me out, man. I’m I’m hanging right here. Anyway, they left and I went out of the apartment. I went back to a restaurant that I knew of right beside the movie and I called my dad and I said, “Dad, you need to come and get me.” Uh you know, there’s some guys out here wanting to beat me up and it’s not looking good. I need you to come and get me. Man, when he pulled up in front of that restaurant, I wasn’t embarrassed at all. I was happy. I was thankful. I had a smile on my face. Good to see you, Dad. So, there is a time when we need to be embarrassed about our conduct and let God change us. You know, when my dad drove me home from that police station, he didn’t say a word. I already knew. I already knew the rules of the home. I already knew what I had to do. I had to get rid of this friend that I did stupid things with. He went out of my life. I knew I didn’t even ask for the car. I knew the car wasn’t available. I didn’t even ask to go to movies or any place. I just knew that’s over. And when enough time went by, then Dad said, “You want to take the car and get it filled up with gas?” You know, after enough time went by and he saw there was repentance and he saw there was a change. Church, just because you’re filled with the Holy Ghost and you experience the presence of God or you feel the presence of God in some meeting doesn’t mean God’s approving you at all.
Is a God who never corrects worth having?
No—He’s worthless; God shakes the heavens and nations.
Is a God who never corrects worth having?

And somewhere we should be embarrassed, ashamed of our lifestyle, and repent, and take God’s discipline. Could that be true? Hallelujah. His presence is going to stick with you. Why? He loves you. He wants to win you. He’s going to fight for you till the day you die. Don’t misunderstand that for his approval of you. Thank God my dad had enough a godly standards in him to confront his son and correct his son. Amen. Now, what kind of God do we serve who won’t correct us? He’s worthless. A God that won’t correct me, he’ll just, you know, love me no matter what I do. He’s worthless because things I’m going to do are going to destroy my life and it’s going to hurt others. And a lot of people have a worthless Jesus. And it isn’t that Jesus is worthless, it’s their outlook on him. Her response their response to him, the way they see him, it’s worthless. Because they won’t allow Jesus to change their life. Hallelujah. So, that’s one of the main things we need to learn. God’s spirit is with us. But when he comes, there should be embarrassing times and there should be happy times. When he delivers us, when he sets us free, we should be happy. We should be willing to thank him publicly. Hallelujah. Now, verse six. Thus says the Lord of hosts, once more, it is a little while, it’s going to actually be several hundred years, I will shake heaven and earth, the sea and the dry land, and I will shake all nations, and they shall come to the desire of all nations, and I will fill this temple with glory, says the Lord. The silver is mine and the gold is mine. The glory of this latter temple will be greater than the former. Now, in Hebrews, the Hebrew author of Hebrews used this scripture to “God is shaking the nations.” He’s shaking people. So, only that which can’t be shaken will remain. Now, what does that mean to us? Well, you go to a apple tree and the fruits on it, there’s a branch hanging over, the fruits on it, some of that fruit is overripe, it’s starting to rot, it’s heavier, and it doesn’t have the life in the stem to hang on. You shake that limb and the no good things fall off. You see? So, that only the good remains. Are you there? Now, you will notice that here in this verse, Haggai changes his prophetic level. Before he was teaching edification, prophesying and edification, exhortation, and comfort. He um suddenly switches to the office of a prophet predicting the future. That’s a big difference. You can never be wrong when you embrace that realm, you can never be wrong. Isn’t that right? It better happen. And he’s talking about the latter house. He’s talking about this temple, the natural temple being better than the former, and it never happened. You say, “Well, how do you know?” Well, I can tell you. In the former temple, the glory cloud of God came down. God’s presence came down. Didn’t do it in the latter temple, the natural temple. You see? In the early temple, God rained fire from heaven and consumed the altar and came down and filled that place. Didn’t happen in the second temple. You see? Now, he’s obviously speaking of the real temple that Christ is going to come to build, which is going to be a few hundred years later. It says in a little while. See, we misunderstand the scriptures and it says a little while, we think, “Man, pow!” God is an attorney and then a little while could be a thousand years. It could be a four Here, it’s like 400 and some years or something, you know. It’s It’s a long To us, that’s a long time. That’s not a little while. Actually, it’s over 400 years. Malachi hadn’t prophesied yet. So, are you with me? Now, the desire of all nations will come. And I will fill this temple with glory.
Is a God who never corrects worth having?

Haggai 2:6-7: “For thus says the LORD of hosts: ‘Once more (it is a little while) I will shake heaven and earth, the sea and dry land; and I will shake all nations, and they shall come to the Desire of All Nations, and I will fill this temple with glory,’ says the LORD of hosts.
Whose is the silver and gold?
God’s—He looks at you despite your mess; the glory of the latter house shall be greater.
Whose is the silver and gold?

The silver is mine and the gold is mine. I know, I was a young minister, I preached that, you know, God, you know, he owns all the gold and silver and, you know, he’s got the money to do what he wants to do. He didn’t even talking about money there. I, as a young minister, I, you know, he’s talking about the desire of the nations, the valuable of the nation. God sees us as his valuable treasure. You see? And he wants the valuable one, the ones that will be the remnant, the ones will not only take the testimony of Jesus, but they will keep his commandments. That’s the valuable ones to him. Are you there? See, that ought to make you really feel good. God looks at you in spite of the mess you’re in as a valuable thing in this world. Hallelujah. Now, he said the glory of this latter temple will be greater than the former. And I just told you in the first temple in 2 Chronicles when they worshipped and praised him, the glory of God filled the temple. The the cloud, a visible presence filled the temple. His glory is his presence. You see? But his glory is also the people that respond to him. Do you got that? See, that’s his honor. Do we want his presence? Absolutely. And he says the glory, the presence of God is going to be greater in the latter house than the former. Now, this is powerful stuff. Okay? Now, we’re going to go over to the New Testament. All right? In Matthew 16:18, now remember, in Acts twice he said God doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands. So, he never was interested in a natural building, was he? The Crystal Cathedral, as great as it looked, God isn’t even interested in it. The Mormon Temple up there in Salt Lake City, God doesn’t care about temples made with hands. He’s not impressed with all that glass in the cathedral and all them valuable things in the Mormon Temple or any Catholic church or any Protestant church.
Whose is the silver and gold?

Haggai 2:8-9: ‘The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine,’ says the LORD of hosts. ‘The glory of this latter temple shall be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of hosts. ‘And in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of hosts.”
Us—living stones; Jesus is full of grace and truth and will tell you to straighten up.

He’s impressed with you. If we would decorate our life like we want our temples in the throughout the world decorate. Man, God would really be happy. You get the message? We put all that money into the mortar instead of the message to the people. So, in Matthew 16:18, Jesus said, “I will build my church.” See, he’s not He said, “I’m not going to build a natural temple. I’m going to build a church. I’m going to build people.” And the gates of hell can’t prevail against these people. Folks, he is raising up a people. Unlike Israel who failed and failed and failed, he’s raising up a people who are going to conquer the gates of hell. Amen? That’s our description. Over there in 1 Peter, uh we find uh or yeah, 1 Peter 2:5, he says, “You are living stones built up a spiritual house.” See, he plainly says, “We are that house.” That latter house that he’s building is people. Can I hear an amen? See, he’s interested in you, folks. And Haggai prophesied it hundreds of years before, and it came to pass. Now, in John 1:1 and verse 14, “In the beginning was the word. The word was with God, and the word was God. And the word became flesh and dwelt amongst us.” That’s Jesus. See, Jesus is God. And they’re plural. Over in Genesis, he said, “Let us make man in our” I’m plural. You say, “How can something be plural and one?” I mean, well, he’s God. He’s God. He has no limitations. He said, “We beheld his glory as the glory of the only begotten Son of God full of grace and truth.” Now, Jesus comes, he said, “in the midst of the praising congregation or where two or three of you are gathered together, I will be in the midst.” So, when his presence comes, what do we experience? Grace and truth. What is Christ’s glory? Grace and truth. See, he’s going to follow the scriptures. He’s going to do what is truth, speak what is truth, and grace is that divine enablement. How many could use a little divine enablement? You see, you need to know this stuff. When his presence comes, he comes to enable you. And then truth. God will never, the Holy Ghost will never, the presence of Jesus will never go against his word. And when you say things in the name of the Holy Ghost or the spirit of God on you or whatever your excuse is, and it violates the word, you’re just out of order. He never He His His presence is grace and truth. He’s going to come and he’s going to tell you the truth. You need to straighten up this area, boy. Am I right? You know about I understand. I understand. He got Like my dad, he didn’t have to say a word. Just looking at him, I knew. I already knew the rules of the house. I knew the results if I violated them. And the presence of my dad just like that, brought it. I was embarrassed and that’s what we should be. Instead of hardening our heart saying, “I don’t see what’s wrong with this.” We should be embarrassed when Jesus comes. Amen. And glad when he delivers us.

1 Peter 2:5: you also, as living stones, are being built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ. John 1:14: And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth.
Jesus—the same blood cleanses us; a church is not one man but leaders and contributors.

Now, so he’s the glory. When his presence come, he’s our glory, folks, and he is the fulfillment of this that the glory of the latter house will be greater than the former. But it doesn’t stop there. Remember in Ephesians 2 or Ephesians 5 right around verse 27. He says, “Husbands love your wife as Christ loved the church and gave himself for it.” See, Christ not only died on the cross for the sinners of the world. You need to listen to this. Most Christians do not understand the cross. Jesus just did not die on the cross for the sinners of the world. Right here in Ephesians, he says he died on the cross for his church. He gave himself for his church. These valuable, desirable, remnant people that have the testimony of Christ and a heart to keep his commandments. So, when we mess up the same blood cleanses us as it does the sinner who just started. Amen. Thank God. So, as a Christian, what? I can grow. I don’t have to quit because I mess up. That same blood cleanses me. He died for me, a believer that makes mistakes. And don’t have to stay in those mistakes. That blood will cleanse and deliver me, a believer. Hallelujah. It’s powerful. And he’s going to present, listen to this, in that verse. He says that he’s going to present the church, his bride, glorious, honorable, without spot or wrinkle or any such thing. Is that what it says? Yeah. Does he have the power to do that? Can he actually perform it or is that just talk? He is a performer. And you remember that when people say he can come any minute. This church isn’t glorious yet. In Ephesians 2, you remember he’s talking about the many-membered body of Christ and how we’re to come into his measure and his stature. See. He placed in the church apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, teachers to equip the saints to do the work of the ministry. And then he says this, we grow in the body, we grow by every joint supplying, by every one doing their part. See, it’s not a one-man A church is not the pastor and the guru. It’s we need leaders. See, as it was in Haggai and Zechariah and Ezra. He spoke to the civil leader, he talked to the spiritual leaders, he spoke to the remnant and told them all to be what? Strong. I’m with you. Build. And see, Paul in Ephesians knew that. He knew that and then he tells us that we’re going to grow into the stature of Christ. The fullness of the stature of Christ as we the leaders and the body members work and do their part, we’re going to grow into this glorious church. That’s why it’s imperative that we assemble together, that we edify and build one another, and we grow. Well, I thought that was hot stuff. You say, you don’t just go to church to attend. You come to church to be a part. You come to church to be changed. It’s a place of change. It’s a place of participation. And God will enable you. Hallelujah. So, it’s everybody’s responsibility to learn the word, share the word, be a light, contribute.
What should the church stop acting like?
What did Israel do before captivity?
Got greedy and broke every commandment.
What did his dad say driving home?
What fruit example does he use?
What did he preach as a young minister?
The silver is mine and the gold is mine.
Do you just go to church to attend?

items.d: A falling away precedes Christ’s return, but He remains in heaven until the restoration of all things. Truths like repentance, baptism and the Holy Ghost were restored through movements such as Azusa Street…
p: A falling away precedes Christ’s return, but He remains in heaven until the restoration of all things. Truths like repentance, baptism and the Holy Ghost were restored through movements such as Azusa Street and the Jesus people. Change your thinking and invite times of refreshing—He is coming for a glorious church.
A falling away—and history’s compromises; repent and confess, no penance needed.

Also, you remember we taught you that before Christ comes, there’s going to be a falling away. You remember that? And we showed you that that falling away took place between 500 AD and 1500 AD. The dark ages, the Catholic Church, and they have to take responsibility for this. I don’t I don’t water it down at all. They’re the ones that propagated all this nonsense. People could sin and still go to heaven. You know, they could buy money or they could do some kind of pendants or whatever. Uh the the the the Catholic Church had got into horrible corruption. You know, you could go fight the holy war down in Jerusalem and you could go to heaven. That’s nothing. That’s a Muslim teaching. Are you there? And for those of you who don’t understand, those Europeans did not go down there in what we call a holy war. They were trying to meet the Muslims on their turf so they wouldn’t come and invade Europe. Th those those people that that twist history to make you think that these Christians were bad people because of the crusade. They they’re not reading it. You read it. Those nobles and stuff in Europe took it because the Muslims were trying to take over the world. So they went down there. Now the Catholic Church helped because they said, “Well, if you go down there and fight, you know, you’ll go to heaven.” Well, that’s stupid. That’s not Bible. So, what did Martin Luther do in 1517 or 1519? I forget the date. Somewhere right there. He said, “No way. This is nonsense.” He says, “The just shall live by faith. You repent from your sins. You live by faith in Christ. You turn from those sins. You confess them, and you’ll be saved. You don’t have to do penance. You don’t have to do nothing. It’s all in the power of the blood of Christ. And so the all these remember Hebrews 6, the foundational laws. You’re looking at me like you don’t. Well, anyway, Hebrews 6 gives us the foundational laws. Repentance toward God. See, we actually repent from our sins and we turn towards God’s righteousness. We turn and that’s what Luther was saying. Said we lost that. So that truth was restored. Are you with me? In Acts, chapter 3, 21. Let me get this through to you. Restoration. There was a falling away and there’s a restoration.
2 Thessalonians 2:3: Let no one deceive you by any means; for that Day will not come unless the falling away comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of perdition,
Retained in heaven until the restoration of all things—coming for a glorious, restored church, not a rapture.

Acts 3:21. Jesus will be retained in the heavens. He’s going to stay in the heavens. He’s not coming back until what? The restoration of how many things? All things. What’s keeping Christ in heaven right now? There’s not a full restoration yet. Now, any idiot can read that verse and I mean, it’s plain. There’s Jesus is staying in heaven until the restoration of all things spoken by all the prophets since the world began. And that’s why he can’t come any minute. Things have not been restored. And I just read Greg Lori come out with a new book and and he said the only thing lacking oh the next event in God’s calendar is the rapture. I go, man, you guys are missing this thing. He’s a much bigger God than that. We got billions of people that haven’t heard of Christ. The billions that are still in sin and you’re just wanting a rapture. We got a church that’s in disarray. We’re divided. We We got nonsense being preached in the church. It’s not a glorious church. And you’re saying the next event is the rapture when Jesus cannot come until the restoration of all things spoken by the prophets. Amen. Now, you should be able to feel that. That’s burning truth. And instead of looking for God to do a a a miraculous last day visitation on earth, they’re just looking for a rapture to get us out in our condition. He’s coming back for a glorious church, a restored church. Folks, that’s what the scriptures say. Are you with me? But, you know, numbheaded Christians go to numb-headed churches where numb-headed pastors preach a numb-headed word and we’re all numbheads. And we feel good about oursel. We do. You know music has a spirit. Do you know that it always isn’t the spirit of God? And just because you feel some presence in a church doesn’t mean you’re feeling his presence at all. Good music can bring a presence. Yes. So, you know, we bring in the best musicians and all that and we have what we call a real great worship service when it’s nothing but a music service and we feel good because of the music and we haven’t touched God at all. And how do you know you haven’t touched God? Because there’s no embarrassment. There is no deliverance. He didn’t pull up to deliver you like my dad did and set you free from that predicament you’re in. He didn’t come in and embarrass you and say, “Man, you’re wrong. You got to change this thing and I got to discipline you for it.” I’m telling you, church, this is the message that is coming. There’s another move of God coming. God’s not done with things. He ain’t rapturing anybody. There is a visitation of God coming on this earth. And he’s going to fulfill these prophecies or else he’s a worthless God. Why do we serve a God that all he can do is snatch us out of this earth? Can’t empower us to be a voice in it. That’s a worthless God. But you don’t read in the Bible we got a worthless God. WE GOT A POWERFUL GOD THAT EMPOWERS HIS people and he fulfills what he says he will do. True. Amen. Amen. Hallelujah. So anyway, part of the restoration was repentance from dead works, faith toward God. Martin Luther brought it, the Lutheran. Then the Presbyterians rose up.
Acts 3:21: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God has spoken by the mouth of all His holy prophets since the world began.
Repentance, baptism, Holy Ghost—a former Calvinist changed through prayer; tongues and prophecy at Azusa Street.

We always got these these offspring people that’s not in the restoration. They embrace Calvinism. Who says you’re predestined to go to heaven or you’re predestined to go to hell. And no matter how you live, if you’re predestined, you’re going to go to heaven anyway. That is biblical nonsense. You don’t find Calvin in the Bible. So throw Calvin out. Let’s get the Apostle Paul back. Let’s get Peter back. Can I hear an amen? Then the Baptists come along in6008. I believe the they stood up and said, “Hey, not only do we need to repent, not only do we need faith toward God, but we need it and then we need to get baptized.” None of this baby baptism is working. The scriptures don’t show baby baptism. When we come to the knowledge of our sin and we repent and we turn toward God, then we get baptized and we get submerged. None of this sprinkling stuff. Amen. So now you have the restoration of repentance, faith, and water baptism. Are you there? Then the Methodists come along with sanctification. In other words, there’s a focus on Bible morality. We got to live right. We can’t just be saved and go to heaven. We got to live right. We got to be a light to the world. Can you say amen to that? Amen. In the Then late 1800s, AB Simpson, a Presbyterian, a uh used to be a Presbyterian. God got a hold of used to be a Calvinist. A woman invited him to her home to pray for her son that was in a coma and dying. The the boy was dying, you know, and she just invited AB Simpson in, the pastor of the Presbyterian church to come in and he wasn’t a pastor of Presbyterian at that time, his own church. And so he went in and he laid hands on the boy and and and prayed, you know, and he said, “I turned to leave and the boy got come up out of the coma.” I mean, you can read it. It’s it’s right in church history. And the boy was healed just like that, instantaneously. And he said, “I left.” And he said, “This thing was on my mind. That boy was healed.” He was shocked. Isn’t that a a good attitude? You’re kind of shocked. You’re not naming it and claiming it. Oh, wow. This worked. So, anyway, some other people had had testimonies of divine healing. So he started searching the scriptures and he found in the scriptures that divine healing, supernatural healing is part of the covenant God made with the in the new covenant. So he started praying for the sick and he had a heart disorder himself that later got healed. See he had trouble all of his adult life with the heart and God healed him. And so here we have the restoration of laying on of hands for healing. Remember laying on of hands. Hallelujah. Then we come up to 1900 in Texas in uh Kansas. Some people were seeking for the baptism of the Holy Ghost and somebody spoke in tongues. One person did as far as I can remember. And then the news got back. Anyway, LA heard about it. They sent somebody back there to bring somebody to LA to talk about this. So, this black pastor, William Seymour, came to LA who hadn’t even got the baptism of the Holy Ghost, but he was teaching it because he was in that group. And uh to make a long story short, God visited what we call the Azusa Street Revival in 1906. Okay? And they spoke in tongues. And it was a black pastor with women leaders in the church and white leaders in the church. I tell you for one year there was unity there. That mean on the on the day of Pentecost one of the signs of the baptism of the Holy Ghost was unity. They were in one accord before the Holy Ghost came and they were in one accord after the Holy Ghost came and they praised God with one accord in the temple daily. Unity they had it are you there and a lot of people are so upset about this tongue talking I don’t know why it’s Bible it’s there you know they did speak in tongues you know let let me just give you a brief history of Acts on the day of Pentecost they spoke in tongues and they were in unity in Acts 4 uh the place was shaken and they spoke the word of God with boldness. It says they were filled with the Holy Ghost and they spoke the word of God with boldness. No tongues. Now, nobody has a problem with that one, but they sure have a problem with this tongue thing. Then Philip goes down to Samaria and preaches the gospel. The city was filled with joy. Miracles are going on but no Holy Ghost till the apostles came down and laid their hands on him. Here it is the laying on of hands again for the impartation of the Holy Ghost. Impartation, not healing but impartation. Okay. Then you got Cornelius. The Holy Ghost fell on him and they spoke in tongues. You got the church of Ephesus. Paul went there. There were about uh 15 or 20 people. Not many I can’t just a handful of people. Paul prayed for them laying on of hands. They spoke in tongues and prophesied. But let me tell you what, you know, we’re all hung up on this prophecy and tongue thing. When Jesus said, “Go and tear in Jerusalem and you shall be endued with tongues from on high.” Is that what he said? No. What did he say? What? Power. Yeah. Jesus after he ascended told the apostles, “You will be. Filled with into filled with. Power.” Power. It’s a baptism of it’s a baptism of yes. And some of the expressions of that power is prophecy and tongues. And there should be interpretation if we’re in the church service.

Acts 2:38: Then Peter said to them, “Repent, and let every one of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins; and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit. Acts 19:6: And when Paul had laid hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke with tongues and prophesied.
Division over divorce and race; Seymour’s marriage; the charismatic movement and Jesus people in the 60s.

Are you there? But but and and this is what happened on Azusa Street. That revival really only lasted about a year. And do you know why it only lasted a year? I mean, people were getting healed. People were getting filled with the Holy Ghost. The church never had any more than 50 to 60 members. But every day there was 1,00 to,500 people there coming and going. Pre preachers from all over the world were coming to find out what was happening there. And then they took it back. See, they just took it back wherever they were were. But the leaders in the church divided. They went and started their own church a few blocks away. Another one went and started another own church a few blocks away. Does that sound like a glorious church? You know what? They divided over divorce. You can’t divorce. If you get divorced, you got to stay single. And literally women in the church who got saved and they got married as a teenager. The guy ran off and left them. They got remarried, had two kids, especially one testimony. And she had to divorce that man with two kids so she could fulfill their doctrine. That’s insane. And this is supposed to be a Holy Ghost. A p this a baptism of power. And then you got the Jesus only coming in. Durham, no plurality, Jesus only. And then I and I and I just just nonsense. And what really was a move of God dissipated by 1908. He married a black lady. Seymour did. He was a black pastor one eye. And uh that wife of his manipulated him into getting rid of all the white leaders and just having black leaders. So next thing you know, it’s just back to a black church and nobody’s coming. You see, black people can be prejudiced, too. And folks, we’re supposed to be filled with power. It’s still the baptism of power. Do we need power? Yes. What is the ministry of the Holy Ghost, by the way? Do you even know the ministry of the Holy Ghost? Yes. He’ll convicts us of sin. He convicts us of righteousness. Convict means convinces. And the judgment to come. Listen, when I was a sinner sitting out there, that’s what got me saved, man. He convinced me that there’s a right way. He convinced me I was doing it the wrong way. And he convinced me I was going to go to hell, and I didn’t want to go to hell. You see, and he leads us into all truth. How much truth? See, that’s the ministry. When you say you’re filled with the Holy Ghost and power and you don’t read your Bible and and and you’re not concerned about changing your life, I have to challenge your baptism of the Holy Ghost. I don’t care if you’re shakamula or not. See, there’s a difference between the baptism of tongues, baptism of prophecy, and the baptism of power. Tongues and prophecy comes because of the baptism of power. Yes. Not vice versa. Did that help? Cuz see, we want like this morning, we want God to come. We want him to touch us, but we want it to be real. And we want to respond in a manner that’s decent, mannerly, and in order like the Bible says, so that people can learn and be edified. Hallelujah. Okay, that leads us to 1900, 1906. Welsh revival came at that time too. 1900, 1906, 1948, late 40s, God moved again, brought in the baptism into the body of Christ. Billy Graham and some of these evangelists came out of that visitation of God. The revival churches came out of that visitation of God. Praise and worship, they saw the Revelation of it. And uh laying on of hands for blessing. Uh, I left out the second coming. The Adventists in the early 1800s really focused in on the second coming. They focused in on it so much they said he was coming in 1844. Now remember the second coming is the resurrection and eternal judgment. Right of the basic foundations. So the big disappointment. Miller and all his followers, including all kinds of churches, were there waiting for the rapture to take place, and it didn’t happen. They’d sold their property. They quit their jobs. They were ready to go, and it never happened. I told you in every move of God, there’s this distraction. See, they didn’t understand that God had to restore all things. He hadn’t even restored. Now people had spoken in tongues before Azusa Street. I hope you know that in Russia they did and and uh throughout America uh different people seeking God had spoken in tongues before but it was it was uh focused in on on Azusa Street. And then in 1968 and I lived through this one. I was a boy through the 48 and I got to see all this and hear all this in the 50s. I tell you, America was a godly a a God-focused nation. And it was in the 50s, right after that 48 revival that our Congress said, “Put on our money and God we trust.” It was after that 48 visitation of God. Are you there? And I got to live as a young boy through that period. I love it. The 60s destroyed it. But in 1968, the seculars had come in and they were attacking everything. Abortion, Bible, out of the schools, prayer out of the schools and all that. So in 1968, God came and and I’ll tell you, us Pentecostals thought we were the select of the elect. Now they can tell you what they want, but I I was in the churches and we thought that all these other denominations and all people going to have to come to us for this Revelation of the baptism of the Holy Ghost. Hallelujah. So what does God do? 1968 he comes and just pours it out on the Catholics, Lutheran, Presbyterians, Episcopalian. Didn’t ask anybody anything. Just did it. They didn’t even know what was happening to them. And they made the same mistakes that the Pentecostals made in 1900. Identical mistakes. They called themselves the charismatic movement. How many of you heard the word of the charismatics? Okay, it’s nothing but Pentecostals with a new name. All right, but God did it. The Catholic Church was so threatened by them that they agreed to let these Pentecostals meet in a separate room in the temple in the Catholic church to keep him from leaving because Catholics were leaving when they got filled with the spirit to go find out what was going on. Are you there? Now, you can read this. This is history. I’m not lying to you, but I live through this. And immediately the Jesus people came on the scene. These hippies, gosh, they didn’t wash their clothes. A lot of them they never goodness, you know, they wore feathers. Uh they were a bunch of weirdos, let me tell you. Peace. And the Jesus people were also spiritfilled people. They were filled with the spirit. They went into spiritfilled churches and all, but they did a lot of weird things, too. And who does God send a hillbilly from Kentucky to minister to? Hippies? Me. A hillbilly from Kentucky ministering to hillbilly uh to these hippies. And that lasted till the 90s. And since the 90s we have declined attendance in churches including the Catholics is only 25% of Christians including Catholics go to church and the percentage of Christians in America has gone from 86% in the year 2000 to 70ome percent in present day.
What you believe affects behavior—change your thinking; invite the Holy Ghost; times of refreshing.

We’re declining. And as somebody said, even those that say they’re Christians is up. So we’re still in Acts chapter 3. Let’s jump up to verse 19, the restoration of all things in verse 21. And before he said it, he said this, repent. Change your thinking. The word repent here, there’s two words for repent in the Bible. One is turn. This one is change your thinking. That mean some a lot of us need to change our thinking. Yeah. The battle’s for the mind, folks. What you believe in your mind is going to affect your behavior. So we need to change our thinking. The other repent you know be sorry for your sins and then other repent is turn. The word converted here is turn. Repent. Change your thinking. Turn back. Turn to God. Turn to right. See repent and be converted till the times of refreshing shall come. Times of what? The presence of the Lord. Oh my gosh. Listen, what is my greatest opportunity of really repenting and turning is when I can get into a church where they worship God. They believe in the presence of God. They believe in the Holy Ghost. And they invite him in. One of one of the songs that us Pentecostals sang a lot is Holy Spirit. You are welcome in this place. Why? We invite him in. When you sing about him, he comes. And when he comes, he can refresh you. And he can cause you to repent, change your thinking, turn your life around. And he promised times of refreshing. And that’s what we saw. Martin Luther, the first awakening, the second awakening, the third awakening, the fourth awakening, which was in the 60s and to the 90s. You see, we saw God doing what he said he would do. Are you with me? Times of refreshing. Are you glad that God has in his calendar times of refreshing,. Folks? We need it. It’s imperative for a lot of us to really change our life and change our thinking is for God’s presence to get a hold of us. And make us feel bad and ashamed about how we’re thinking and acting so he can change how we’re thinking and acting. Hallelujah. Times of refreshing shall come. And this is the quality of restoration I showed you in Ephesians. He wants for us to grow into the measure of the stature of Christ.
Acts 3:19: Repent therefore and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, so that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord,
A glorious church without spot or wrinkle.

He is coming for a glorious church without spot or wrinkle or any such thing. And he’s not coming back until he attains that goal. And he has the power to do it, folks. So is there times of refreshing coming to the world in the future? Does God have to rapture us out or can he do what he said he could do? How many want to be a part of that? Yeah. You remember in Daniel in that end days there will be a wise and understanding people. Remember that. A people that will bring many to the Lord. A people that are strong. This is what Haggi and them are talking about. The glory of the latter house. We haven’t touched, listen to me, the glory of the early church. Yes, we have a few healings here and there, and yes, we’ve had visitations, but God is out to fulfill his word. Folks, you get what you seek for. If you want to be that kind of people, you seek for it. Hag prophesied it, folks. We got a ways to go to be like the early church. How many of you agree with that?
Ephesians 5:27: that He might present her to Himself a glorious church, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without blemish.
Do you have to do penance?

items.d: Zechariah’s golden candlestick reveals restoration’s dominant factor: not might or power but God’s Spirit. Leaders bring forth the headstone, Jesus. Believers go beyond first principles, add virtue to virtue…
p: Zechariah’s golden candlestick reveals restoration’s dominant factor: not might or power but God’s Spirit. Leaders bring forth the headstone, Jesus. Believers go beyond first principles, add virtue to virtue through God’s promises, and walk in love, without which nothing profits.
A candlestick all of gold with a bowl like a spring and seven lamps.

In Zechariah, we will be in Zechariah chapter 4. Zechariah saw a candlestick all of gold. Okay, this is what he saw. The candlestick all of gold with a bowl on top of it. There’s the bowl right there. That word bowl also means fountain or spring. Now, I grew up in Kentucky as a country boy, a mountain boy, and we had springs. And when that water would come out of the ground, it would kind of wear off in years or so forth, and there would be a little area where you could literally bend over and put your mouth down there and drink, uh, a little bowl, a little reservoir where the water come out of the ground right in front of it, and then it would roll down. And so, this bowl is a spring. And, and you’ll see why later. And there are seven lamps on top of the candlestick. There’s the seven lamps, individual lamps. And there’s seven pipes from the bowl to the candlestick. Okay? And two olive trees has been put in by your versions of the Bible. But it doesn’t necessarily mean trees. It’s used as olives or trees. It can be. It’s used either way. It’s very interchangeable. There’s two olive trees. So, we have the trees here for you you who want a tree. For people like me, I want my olives. Okay? Why do I want the olive? Because that’s where the oil comes from. See, the oil comes from the olive. All right. Now, up on the right and left side of the bowl, this fountain, this spring, is where the two olive trees or olives are. So, I spoke to the angel, “What are these things, my Lord?” And the angel spoke back, “You don’t know. You don’t know what this stuff is, church. Do you know what he’s talking about? Do you feel like Zachariah? And then and then God, you know what this means? Like what’s with you? And of course, Zechariah says, “No, I don’t know.” Now, a lot of people are going to go to this with their little juvenile baby approach to the word of God, and they’re going to do a little concordance search, and they’re going to hook it up with the two olive trees and Revelations, the two witnesses.

Zechariah 4:2-3: And he said to me, “What do you see?” So I said, “I am looking, and there is a lampstand of solid gold with a bowl on top of it, and on the stand seven lamps with seven pipes to the seven lamps. Two olive trees are by it, one at the right of the bowl and the other at its left.”
Not by might nor power but by My Spirit—not natural abilities; abroad the dead are being raised.

They’re going to hook it up, and they’re going to come up with a concoction of different stories. When I got on the internet, I couldn’t believe how many versions of this there is. But I want to tell you something. The angel is going to tell him what these things are. Are you ready for it? And it is this simple. The meaning of the seven lamps, the candlestick, the seven pipes, the bowl, and the two olives. Are you ready? Here it is. This is the word of the Lord. That’s the word of the Lord. A picture of a candlestick, a bowl, and two olives. Yep. That’s what the angel says. This is the word of the Lord. The word of the Lord of host. Who is the Lord of hosts? Jesus Christ. This is the word of the Lord of hosts. The word of Jesus to Zerubbable. Who is Zerubbable? The silver leader that is building the house of God. Joshua is the spiritual leader. Building the house of God. United. They are building the house of God with the people of God doing the work right very now I tell you you’ll really gain something if you listen today now and here’s the meaning not by might and this word might is used as ability see I God don’t care about your music ability He doesn’t care about your singing ability. He doesn’t care about your speaking ability. He doesn’t care about your organization abilities. He don’t need them. America’s church has got it all wrong. It’s not by natural abilities. It’s not by wealth. You know, people that have money think they can just buy people into the kingdom. I tried to tell people in past days, you can’t do that. They got to be born again. They got to be placed in by God himself. You cannot bribe people into the kingdom. It won’t last. They wouldn’t listen. It didn’t last. And neither did they. Now, isn’t this good so far? And you can’t do it by the power of an army, the might of an army. The Muslims are wrong when they put bombs on people and go in and blow up people trying to promote the the Muslim religion. No, God doesn’t need our armies. And it’s not by power. The word powers there just means strictly human strength. You know, name it, claim it, believe it, get it. If I repeat it enough, it will happen. Those Pentecostals are bad for that. In America, not in South America, Africa, and Asia. 64 million are coming to Christ every year in those nations. 64 million. God is moving. The next awakening has already begun. And America and Europe is not part of it. I’m serious. They’re raising the dead over there. Literally corpses, not afterlife experience or after death. I’m talking about people were dead and they prayed and God rose them up, raised them back up. I’m talking about serious physical healings. I’m talking about drug addicts getting delivered by the power of God, not a 12step procedure. Alcoholics. I’m talking about homosexuals turning their life around, not they’re born that way and can’t be changed. I’m talking about the power of God. They teach kingdom power over there. God’s moving. How many want to be a part of that? God, I’m in America. Don’t don’t don’t punish me for being in America. I’m ready for this. Come on. It’s not by these things, but by my what? That’s what all that means. Seven lamps on the candlestick, seven pipes, the bowl, and the two olives. He’s telling you this is done. This house that is built is going to be built by the spirit of God. End of subject. Amen. Now, isn’t that clear and easy to understand? Yeah. You don’t need no Hebrew thing or anything else. You just need to listen to what God’s saying. Now watch. He’s not stopped here. He’s building this house by the spirit. Who are you, oh great mountain before Zerubbable, you will become a plain? Okay. Jesus said, “If you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you say to that mountain, be removed and be cast in the sea, and it shall be done unto you.” Now listen.
Zechariah 4:6: So he answered and said to me: “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: ‘Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit,’ Says the LORD of hosts.
The headstone—Jesus—with shouts of grace; leave the first principles and go on.

And us Pentecostals and I was in a Pentecostal circles, man. I went out to Salac Mountain to show my faith and I said, “Salabac Mountain, get into the sea.” And that mountain just stayed right there. I go, “Lord, there’s something wrong here, man. They’re telling me if I name it, claim it, speak it, do it, get it, and all this stuff, ain’t it ain’t working.” You know, Jesus walked on water and and and Peter walked on water.
