Don’t ever let anyone trick you into believing this nonsense out of emotion, sympathy. Well, I want the world to go to heaven, so I’m going to believe it. That ain’t going to get them into heaven. Jesus will get them into heaven. Amen. Hallelujah. How many would like all three abiding in you? Do you notice the key here? Keep my words. The Holy Ghost is going to what? [clears throat] Open the word to you. Drive you to the word. And that word is going to bring you to a place as you respond to it where God himself and Jesus himself abides in you. Do you understand why it’s important to understand there is a triune God not three gods there or one God trying to express himself in three areas so you can understand and obtain things. Do you understand that? Yeah. There’s people that want to say that there isn’t a trinity.
John 14:6: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
Yes—the Trinity explains what God teaches; the dead boy story shows the word works.

You know, their trinity is not in the Bible, but it really does explain what God is trying to teach us about the Godhead. And did Stephen see two people when he saw when he looked up in heaven? Did he see two people? Yeah, he saw Jesus standing at the right hand of the Father. Amen. And you know it because he’s got the nail scars in his hands, the split in his sides, the thorn scars in his head. You’ll know who he is when you get up there because it’s the God part that died for us. Are you there? Now, he’s offered us an eternal stream that flows straightly from heaven into us. And why people want to argue about the Holy Ghost is just beyond me. I I just, you know, even if us Pentecostals made mistakes with it, why would we throw out a powerful inheritance in God because someone messed up? Did Judas mess up with salvation? Did he lose his salvation? Yeah. Do we stop believing in salvation? Okay, don’t throw it out because somebody says they get saved and they really get saved and then they go back and and then then we want to, you know, certain areas of the church want to say, “Well, it’s they never really believed in the first place.” That’s just like these Pentecostal divine healers that when it doesn’t work, they say, “Well, your faith, you know, you just don’t have the faith.” Always put the blame back on the person. God’s word works. Can I hear an amen? And let me tell you, what kind of faith did that dead boy have of that widow that brought him back to life when Jesus rose him from the dead? He’s dead. He ain’t got no faith at all. And what faith did the woman have? Zero. See, God doesn’t need our help. He can do powerful things if we will just let him flow. Can I hear an amen? Bible morality, the goal of Jesus and the Holy Ghost.
Should you give up on yourself?
What does he call the congregation?
Did He have a right to the holy of holies?
If Allah were real, where would he direct people?
Is the word trinity in the Bible?

items.d: God wants His church to be a powerful display. Priests minister to God and serve His house. Satan accused Joshua the high priest, but God rebuked him, removed Joshua’s filthy garments and set a mitre on his…
p: God wants His church to be a powerful display. Priests minister to God and serve His house. Satan accused Joshua the high priest, but God rebuked him, removed Joshua’s filthy garments and set a mitre on his head: Holiness to the Lord.
A public show that makes people want something—unlike a fading tattoo; Christmas trees spread worldwide.

So, now display as you know is a public show, a public exhibition to cause people to want something and do whatever necessary it is to possess it. That’s what a display does. Angelina Jolie and Lena Headey. She played in the 300 movie and the Terminator and so forth and everybody knows Angelina Jolie. See, they got these tattoos. When celebrities or athletes or somebody famous does something America wants to follow it. And as painful as it is to get a tattoo and as costly as it is to get a tattoo and as fading as that tattoo is in 20 years it looks bad because you don’t look so good anymore. You’re fat, you’re drooping the tattoo fades away and let me tell you it cost you a lot of money to get rid of it. It’s costly to get rid of it, it’s costly to get it. That’s the way sin is. It cost you your life to get it the pleasures of sin and then it cost you to get out of it, your pride. But you see, when they put on a public display for a car or TV or whatever they do that so that they create a desire in you to do whatever it takes to get it. Now, God in this session is going to show us his powerful miraculous display of restoration that will cause people to want restoration. Does that sound good? Zechariah 3:1. He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord. And Satan standing at his right hand to resist him. Now you see this Christmas tree over here on the left? And then the Christmas tree on the right? The Christmas tree on the left is neat because when you bring it into the house, it smells it, you know, it looks good. You got greenery, especially if you live up north where it’s cold and the snowy and all the rest and the smell is just beautiful. But, you know, it’s okay. You know, it gets a little bit attention, but it’s okay. But you decorate. You clothe that Christmas tree with decorations. You especially put presents under that tree. Everybody in the world wants one. In Africa where they don’t even have fir trees, they have Christmas trees. They do whatever they can to get one. Why? Because of the display. And especially the gifts underneath is the big drawing card. And God has something in his plan to draw people under him. Now, Joshua is the high priest. So, let’s look at the ministry of a high priest. I got a picture here of a high priest. Second Chronicles 29:11. Hezekiah said to the Levites, “My son, be not now negligent. The Lord the Lord Jesus has chosen you to stand before him.” Number one. The ministry of the priest is to stand before God. Now, stand has two meanings here. Stand means to dwell or abide before the Lord. But, it also means to stand up. Stand up against any opposition. Stand up against any adversity. Stand up for the Lord. Hallelujah. And that’s the priest’s first responsibility. Then, he says, “Number two, it’s your responsibility to serve him.” You see? “To serve him.” And the word serve here is a household servant. A household worker.
To stand for the Lord and serve His house—lifting hands and dancing like David is ministering to Him; stand for God even against the congregation.

And so, a priest is to not only stand up for the Lord, but to serve his house. Isn’t that good? Now, thirdly, and I have it read here because it’s going to repeat down here. “Number three, to minister to him.” It’s the same word. These asterisks means it’s the same word. To minister. Now, we’re not just serving his household, but here we serve him. We minister to him. Well, how do I minister to the Lord? “Thy loving kindness is greater than life.” Psalm said. “My lips shall praise thee.” Or I “My mouth shall praise thee. I will lift up my hands in thy name.” See, we, when we lift our hand, when we use our mouth to praise him, we are ministering to him. Forget the household now. We are doing it directly to him. When we pray, we’re ministering to him. See? When we fast, it’s a ministry unto him. When we give our tithes, it’s a ministry unto him for him to use that money to extend his kingdom. See, we don’t give our tithes to a church, we give it to him. And it happens to go through some group and the Bible says, “No, those Don’t send your money to any Tom, Dick, and Harry around.” And watch these charities. They’re a big rip-off most of them. You give your money to a church that can feed you that is also taking the gospel message out for others. Can I hear an amen? You see, when I worship, I’m ministering unto him. You see? When I lift my hands, when I dance, I’m ministering unto him. David danced before the Lord. He didn’t dance before the Israel. He was dancing before Israel, but he didn’t do it for Israel to see. He did it unto the Lord. Cartwheels. David did cartwheels before the Lord. He was so glad. And number four, to burn incense. Let my prayers come before thee as incense. See, my house is to be a house of prayer for all nations. See, the church should be prayers. I don’t understand Christians that sit there during prayer time and have nothing to talk to a to God about? That is your ministry. And believe me, you got a lot to talk to him about. And get away from your little give me this and give me that prayers. It’s like David, search my heart, O God. Know my thoughts today. Try me, O savior. Know my thoughts, I pray. See if there be any wicked way in me. Cleanse me from every sin and set me free. That’s what David prayed. Now, number 69, not going back to number two, the household servant, ministering to God’s house, God’s people, to stand before the congregation. To stand means what? To abide, to dwell. If you don’t go to church, how can you fulfill this? These Christians out there, over 70% of them do not attend church. They do not assemble. And number two, you stand for God in front of the congregation. Even though a congregation wants to go another way, you stand for God and His way. A minister must stand for God. He must stand for God’s truth, regardless of what the crowd does. Could that be an amen? Do we have very many of those in America that you know of? See, what does God bring messages like this? To get us back to the right road. Now, you got to understand that all were meant to be priest when God brought Israel out of Egypt. Everyone was supposed to be a priest. This is the third month that they came out of Israel. And God spoke these words in Exodus 19:5, before a year later, almost a year later, before He said Levite, the tribe of Levi will be priests. First, He wanted how many? All people to be priests, and we have it right here in Exodus 19:5. If you obey my voice and keep my covenant, you will be a peculiar, special, valuable treasure under me, above all people, and you shall be to me a kingdom of what? Priests. The whole kingdom was supposed to be priest. But they rejected it. Remember? God called them up to the mountain. They said, “Oh, no. Oh, no. We’re not going up there. Let Moses go up.” So, God then chose the tribe of Levi. Are you there, church? Now, you just heard something today that you’re not going to hear anywhere else. That very thing right there. We are so focused on some minister, some pastor, some pope, some priest to do everything for us. We have not we don’t have any idea that we can come into our God ourself, call on him, and he will answer us. Hallelujah. 1 Peter 2:5, same thing in the new covenant. The old covenant, they wanted them all be priest, they rejected it. The new covenant. 1 Peter 2:5, you as living stones are built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood to offer up spiritual sacrifices. What are those spiritual sacrifices? Praise, worship, prayer, fasting, getting into the word. Those are spiritual sacrifices. Isn’t that right? They’re not secular sacrifices. It’s not doing without meat on Friday. It’s not buying a Volkswagen instead of a Rolls-Royce Silver Shadow. I’m going to make a secular sac- No, these are spiritual sacrifices, things that ignite the spiritual world. And how many Americans will come into God’s house with Thanksgiving in their heart, come into God’s house with praise, come into God’s house with the fruit of the lips of praise and worship unto him. No, they come in pump me up. Inspire me. Tell me how good I am and how rich I’m going to be. Am I right? Yes. See, we are when we got saved, he made us a priest to minister unto him. I don’t have to please anybody but him and when I please him, I should please people that want to please him. And people that don’t want to please him are going to be displeased with me, but that’s their problem. It’s not mine. Could that be an amen? It goes on to say, “You are a royal priesthood priesthood, a chosen generation, a special people.” Repeating Exodus 19. See, he’s called us all to be priests to minister unto him and to minister to his household. Can I hear an amen? We want Billy Graham to do our evangelizing. We want Oral Roberts to do our physical healing. You know, we want Robert Schuller to get our minds straight. When we are supposed to be people that minister unto him, possess him, and minister to the church everything that they need. Hallelujah. Revelations 5:20, God has made us unto our God kings and priests and we shall reign when we get raptured. This rapture theory is one of the horriblest doctrines that the church has ever had. It neutralizes the power that God has destined for his church to have here on earth. We shall reign when? Now, in this present time that says in Romans. See? And here it says, we shall reign on earth. Through him. Through his death, he makes us rulers. Hello, rulers over what? Sin, of course. Lies, deception. We’re rulers over the kingdom of darkness.
Satan, the accuser of the brethren—the Lord rebukes him.

The lust of the flesh. Amen, church? Now, this is Bible. This is God’s promise. Verse two of Zechariah 3. And the Lord said to Satan, the Lord rebuke you. O Satan, even the Lord that has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you. Now, we got to understand he is prophesying in the office of a prophet telling what’s going to happen in the future. 1 Peter 5:8. Your adversary, the Devil, is a roaring lion walks about seeking whom he may devour. Who is resisting us? The same Satan that resisted Joshua the priest back there is resisting us. He’s opposing us. Isn’t that what the scripture says? Yeah. But, I want to tell you the Devil, our accuser, has been rebuked just like Jesus rebuked the Devil rendered him powerless over Joshua, so Jesus has rebuked Satan over our lives. There’s no such thing as Christians being demon possessed, for instance. That goes on in these Pentecostal ridiculous extreme nonsense. If Jesus is the strong man of the house, who can oppose him? Nobody. A demon and Jesus can’t live in the same house. It’s just impossible. Can I hear an amen? But as Pentecostals, we get great flattery out of pretending we got power that’s delivering things that aren’t even there. Now, that’s a good place for an amen. I don’t know if you’ve been around these circles, but I have. Hallelujah. Revelation 12:10, the accuser of our brethren is is cast down who accused him before God day and night. He’s always accusing you. He comes and accuses you when you first get saved. He come to me and says, “Nothing really happened. You know, you didn’t get saved, you know, because there wasn’t much change. I did feel the presence of God. There was a change in my life, but it was that initial baby change.” How many of you experienced that? Yeah, and there was still some flaws in my life, and so he comes and he accuses me. But see, Jesus is going to fix my flaws. He doesn’t tell me that. He just said, “See, you’re you’re a phony. You’re a hypocrite.” See, he accuses. And he’s accusing you before God. He’s up there saying, “You know, that guy needs to go to hell. He needs to be my citizen, not the citizen of your kingdom. Look what he’s doing.” But he’s been what? Cast down. Say it. Cast down. Revelations 12 I mean, Hebrews 2:14, through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, and that is who? The Devil. See, when Christ died on the cross and we embrace that sacrifice of his death on the cross, Satan from that time forth is neutralized. Except he can test us to see where we’re at. See, God uses us as testing tools, so we know where we’re at. Isn’t that why you test something to know? I mean, I you know. You know, this uh TV will last 5 years. We’ve tested it, proven it, we guarantee it 5 years. And so they test it to what? Show what quality it is. And if it doesn’t pass the test, they fix it. And that’s what God does. When you go through a test, he’s just revealing something that needs to be fixed in you, and he’ll come and fix it. Hallelujah. So you pass that test. Is not this the brand that was plucked out of the fire? He’s talking about Joshua being a poker or an instrument that moves coals of fire and in in the fire. Joshua was plucked out of what? The fire. We’re plucked out of the fire. Jude chapter 1 verse 22, and some have compassion, making a separation. Okay? This is like uh when I witnessed to a 76-year-old man, he didn’t drink, he didn’t smoke, he didn’t chew, he didn’t run with people that do, and uh he didn’t go out and his wife. He was really a moral man, but he did not believe in Christ. See, he didn’t have a tragic monkey on his back. The only thing he lacked was believing in Christ, and he couldn’t believe in Christ because of Christians. And so I called him up one day, and I said, he was a family member, and I said, “Listen, I’m not coming over for family stuff. I want to come over to lead you to Jesus Christ, to tell you about Jesus Christ. And if you don’t want me to come over, then fine. Just tell me no.” And he says, “Come on over.” He says, “If you can answer three questions, I will accept Christ.” And one of those questions was, “Why are Christians so uh bigoted that Jesus is the only way? That’s you know, if you don’t do it their way, it’s no way.” It’s a good question, isn’t it? Because Christians are bigoted. They do the same thing many of them that the sinner’s doing, but because they believe in Jesus, they got some paradise in heaven. And because people don’t believe in Jesus, they’re going to hell. And all doing the same thing. He couldn’t get past that. And so I answered his question. I answered all three. And he he did. He let me tell him the gospel message and accepted Christ that day. See, that’s a move of compassion. Other people are not so. They are entangled with uh addictions of sex, alcohol, drugs, you know, they got some real serious problems, violence, and anger. And so we pluck them out of the fire. The fire of hell. There’s two kinds of fire, the fire of hell where we’re going to go if we don’t repent and change our life, isn’t that right? And then there’s fire of trouble. Remember the three Hebrew children? They went into the furnace of fire, the furnace of affliction. And the prophet used it later out of the furnace of much affliction I have chosen thee. That’s them troubles, those those difficulties we go through in life. God will get you through the difficulties. The tribulations, the problems. You will go you will encounter them. But he’s going to pull you out of them. He’s going to get you through them. Amen? Hallelujah. So we are all priests and we’re all capable of ministering to our God. Now, this priest happened to have some filthy garments.

Zechariah 3:1-2: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the Angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right hand to oppose him. And the LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! The LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Is this not a brand plucked from the fire?” Revelation 12:10: Then I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, “Now salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of His Christ have come, for the accuser of our brethren, who accused them before our God day and night, has been cast down.
Filthy garments—God’s presence is there to change him, not to approve him.

Joshua was clothed with filthy defiled garments. If you touch anything defiled, you are what? Defiled in the Old Testament. Isn’t that right? He’s wearing defiled clothes. So, is he defiled? Yeah, he’s got some flaws in his life and here we’re going to see the restoration from flaws. And this is what I was telling you at the beginning that when I got saved, yes, Satan, my accuser, tried to get me not to serve God, make me feel bad about who I was and would point out my problems, but he didn’t say God had a plan to restore and conquer my problems, overcome them, deliver me from them. Amen? He doesn’t tell you the whole story. He’s a big liar. And so, we see here that this high priest, the priest standing before God, he’s got on defiled garments. He’s standing before the angel. Angels can be Jesus themselves. Okay? And the Bible uses the word angel. It’s the presence of God. It’s the display of a presence of God. All right? So, he’s in the holy place or the holy of holies where only high priest could go. And Satan’s there resisting him. And he’s got on dirty garments and the Bible says if you come into that holy place without the proper garments, what happens? You’re dead. That’s why they have bells on the garments. So, if you drop dead, there’s no bells ringing. So, they would take a stick with a hook on it, reach in, grab you, and slide you out cuz if they went in, what would happen? They would die. Hallelujah. Yeah. That’s why the bells were there on those priestly garments. So, they know he’s still alive, folks. He’s still alive. Uh, now He spoke to those standing before Joshua. Now, listen, there’s somebody else that comes into the picture. There are some people in the holy of holies that are not high priests. Wow. And only the high priest could go into the holy of holies. Joshua’s in there with defiled garments. He should be dead. Folks, this is a excellent illustration of God. And he told those who were standing before him, those who weren’t supposed to be in there, but they were in there because they didn’t have defiled garments. They went in like God offered at the beginning for all to come in. Not just the minister, not just the pastor, not just the evangelist. Everybody comes in. And these people are there without defiled garments. And God tells the ones that are there to take his garments. They are the ones who help him change his garments. Whew. Folks, are you there? See, we need each other and we need people. There’s always a core in good churches of people that are undefiled. They live for God, they minister to God, they and they’re the ones that can help you get your life in order. Now, Joshua can be in his presence with a flaw in his life. It doesn’t mean that Joshua was approved by God. But his presence is there to what? Change him. Now, the people can minister to Joshua. Now, you got the priest being ministered to. By these people that are undefiled. Is it possible that a minister, a pastor can have a flaw in their life? Yeah. And still be a genuine follower of God. Yeah. And whose responsibility is it to help change that? Those in the church that are undefiled in that area. You see how important Bible morality is? I have caused your iniquity to pass from you. Now, God says they’re helping, but I’m the one that’s going to cleanse it. Hallelujah. We can share the gospel with them. We can share the presence of God with them. We can love them, but it takes Jesus to supernaturally remove that flaw. I will clothe you with change of garments. Let them. Who’s them? Those standing where they shouldn’t be. Those undefiled. Let them set a fair mitre on his head. And so they, those standing, set a mitre and the new garments. The mitre had a statement on it. See the picture up there that priest? That miter is a cap. See that cap and that gold plate in front?

Zechariah 3:3-4: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the Angel. Then He answered and spoke to those who stood before Him, saying, “Take away the filthy garments from him.” And to him He said, “See, I have removed your iniquity from you, and I will clothe you with rich robes.”
What was put on his head?
A clean mitre—Holiness to the Lord.
What was put on his head?

What does it say on that plate? Holiness to the Lord. Holiness to the Lord. See, now he’s what? Holy. You see, the people ministered to him. Jesus came and delivered him. Now he can wear the cap. Holiness to the Lord. Isn’t that powerful? You see how we need each other? You see how your presence in the congregation is vitally important? And your life for Christ overcoming areas is vitally important. Because if scripture says that you can offer hope to people when you have experienced that hope yourself. Hallelujah. In other words, if Christ worked it out in you, he can work it out in them.
What was put on his head?

Zechariah 3:5: And I said, “Let them put a clean turban on his head.” So they put a clean turban on his head, and they put the clothes on him. And the Angel of the LORD stood by. Exodus 28:36: “You shall also make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it, like the engraving of a signet: HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
Where do they have Christmas trees without fir trees?
Can we come to God ourselves?
Has he been in these circles?
How long will the TV last?
So they know he’s still alive.

items.d: Believers receive two garments: power from on high and righteousness. Clean hands and hearts put us at odds with the wicked. Joshua’s companions were men wondered at, a sign of the Branch. The stone with seven…
p: Believers receive two garments: power from on high and righteousness. Clean hands and hearts put us at odds with the wicked. Joshua’s companions were men wondered at, a sign of the Branch. The stone with seven eyes points to the Lamb, who removes iniquity in one day.
Power from on high and righteousness—the bride granted fine linen.

There’s two garments given to us. Luke 24:49, tarry in the city of Jerusalem until you be endued or clothed with power from on high. What’s he spoke speaking of there? The Holy Ghost, the outpouring, the infilling of the Holy Spirit. I don’t know why there’s such a big argument about this. It is definitely Bible. It is so clear in the Bible. This this Holy Ghost Being filled with the Holy Spirit is so clear in the Bible. That’s one of the garments. See, and what kind of clothing is it? Is it a clothing of tongues? No. Is it a clothing of prophecy? No. Tongues and prophecy comes can come when he close you. Is it a clothing of miracles for physical healing? No. What is it a clothing of? Say the word. Power. Say the word. Power. Why do we get distracted when he describes it twice in Acts one also that it is a baptism of what? Spiritual Power. Supernatural ability and tongues come along with it. Why do we get mad at people that speak in tongues? You know, only one out of three people in Pentecostal churches speak in tongues. That’s a fact. I grew up in Pentecostal churches. And a lot of those that think they’re speaking in tongues are nothing but panamining. They’re not speaking from the source of the spirit at all. They’re just mimicking what somebody else did. And the difference is the power behind it. I’ll never forget, I was standing in the church one day and there’s a new believer by me and this woman, a visitor, spoke in tongues. And this new believer says, “What is she doing?” And I says, “She’s pretending to speak in tongues.” The new believer looks at me and goes, “I’ll have to trust you on that one.” But see, when you have it, you know the difference. Ain’t that right? Yes. See, when you own a Cadillac, you know the difference when it seems someone driving driving up in a Buick and saying, “It’s a Cadillac.” You know what a Cadillac is? Hallelujah. Revelations 19:7, the second garment, the marriage of the lamb has come and his wife has made herself ready. Who is his wife? The church, the bride. Okay. To her the church was granted that she should be arrayed clothed in fine linen, clean and white. For fine linen is the righteousness of the saint. He clothe us with power and he clothe us with righteousness. That’s the garments. And when we defile ourselves by doing something unrighteous, we have defiled garments on. Jesus has to change the flaw. Now folks, that’s good stuff. Can I still experience the presence of God? Absolutely. Why? Because he wants to touch that area. Now listen to this. Clean garments, new garments, defeat Satan and his followers. James 4:7, submit to God. All right. When I submit to God, what naturally happens? I resist the Devil. When I’m following God, I’m at war with the Devil. I’m attacking the Devil. I’m opposing the Devil in the kingdom of darkness when I submit to God. And he will flee from you. See, when I draw to God, the Devil has to run because why? He can’t be in his presence. The only way Satan can be in God’s presence that’s God invites him like he did with Job. Are you there? Now, this is hot stuff. Draw an eye to God and he will what? Draw an eye to you. So, when I draw an eye to God, I’m resisting the Devil.

Luke 24:49: Behold, I send the Promise of My Father upon you; but tarry in the city of Jerusalem until you are endued with power from on high.” Revelation 19:8: And to her it was granted to be arrayed in fine linen, clean and bright, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.
Cleanse hands and heart; forsaking the law praises the wicked, keeping it contends with them.

Clean your hands and your heart, you sinners. My heart is my mind and my emotions. When I get into the word and I start listening like Peter said to things that are of a good report, the things that are profitable, I am cleansing my mind. When I get into the word, I cleanse my hands. Those are those acts of sin, acts of intoxication, those sinful things that I do. That’s my behavior. My body is carrying it out. And so when I cleanse my mind and my lifestyle, I what? Resist the Devil and overcome him. And God said, “I will bruise Satan under your feet after 70 years.”. No. What? Shortly. He said, “It don’t take much time for me to get Satan under your feet and defeated.” Can I hear an amen? Amen. So when these people give a testimony, well, Satan’s following me and probably say it. Man, what kind of God you serving? He gives us victory over Satan isn’t following me. Jesus is following me. Hallelujah. Proverbs 24:8, “They that forsake the law praise the wicked.” When Christians disobey the word. When they sin, what are they doing? Giving honor to the kingdom of darkness and giving honor to the followers who follow the kingdom of darkness. See, when I get on Monday Night Football and get a six-ack of beer and invite my friends over and we curse and drink and get high and and do all these things or I get uh we go to a party where there’s been drinking from a tube and you know we got naked girls all over the place and sex is free and all that and I call myself a Christian. It doesn’t work. When I forsake the law, I praise. I give honor to the wicked. I’m saying it’s okay. I’m approving them. So if my lifestyle is approving it, how can I give the gospel message to bring them out of sin? Amen. But such as keep the law, contend with them. Why not be bumfuzzled by wickedness?

Who do you ask to save you?

items.d: After the glory of the resurrection, God sent His word to the nations; whoever touches His people touches the apple of His eye. When He dwells among us we sing. He inherits a people who freely serve Him, hears…
p: After the glory of the resurrection, God sent His word to the nations; whoever touches His people touches the apple of His eye. When He dwells among us we sing. He inherits a people who freely serve Him, hears their cry, delivers them, and delights in them as they grow.
Death, burial and resurrection—after it He sent me to the nations; whoever touches you touches the apple of His eye.

The Lord of hosts says after the glory. Now, what was the glory? Death, burial, and resurrection. Yeah, Thompson’s got it. He’s listening to me. Okay, after the glory, he sent me unto the nation. Which spoil you, they capture you. You are the valuable possession of God, and the nations they do everything they can to distract you from serving your God. For he that touches you touches the apple of his eye. Man, how many know you protect your eye? Anything come close to it, that eye blinks, and you Yeah, that Yeah, and that’s God says, “You’re the apple of my eye. I’m going to do everything in my power to keep you from being harmed.” And anybody that touches you are touching the sensitive part of my personality, my person. And that’s my people. Now, look at this. He sent me to the nations. I will shake my hand upon them. Who’s them? The nations. Okay, watch this. Watch the power of God. And they shall be a spoil. Who’s they? The nations. Who is the spoil here? See, taken captive in war. The nations. Those that had us captive are now won to Christ by the very people that they once had captive. See, the reverse of the captivity. Do you guys see that? Now, this is a powerful promise. Let me give you an illustration of this. How many of you have ever read the book Through Gates of Splendor? Rest of you consider yourself illiterate. You need to read some of these books. Gates of Splendor, Peace Child, Lords of the Earth, some of these up-to-date stories about what God has done. Gates of Splendor tells us about a story of a man by the name of Jim Elliot who flew an airplane into South America to an a a a remote place to reach a tribe of people down there. Okay? And four guys went with him. They landed there in a place and and they put up trinkets and all this to get the people to come and then finally they make contact and all that and to make a long story short, this tribe killed all five of them.

Zechariah 2:8-9: For thus says the LORD of hosts: “He sent Me after glory, to the nations which plunder you; for he who touches you touches the apple of His eye. For surely I will shake My hand against them, and they shall become spoil for their servants. Then you will know that the LORD of hosts has sent Me.
A headline event of God’s power—there are many up-to-date stories.

They all died. It made the headlines. I mean, I’m a This is in 1955. And it made the headlines in the newspaper. I remember reading it as a kid. Well, Jim Elliot’s wife, Elizabeth, two years later goes down to South America herself. She goes into this tribe. And what she found out could have saved the lives of these men if they were knew. How many of you know the Bible says my people are destroyed for lack of knowledge? This is a very small tribe. There was only about nine men in the tribe to begin with. Full-grown men. And they killed five of our missionaries because they wouldn’t defend themselves, you see. They come to preach the gospel to them. But this is what she learned. She learned that those men killed them because they felt those men threatened their tribe, and they had to do everything they could to protect their tribe, their people. But a woman was no threat. And so she went right in. They welcomed her she lived with them. She translated the Bible into their language over a period of years. The tribe came to Christ, and these men that had killed these missionaries and her husband were brought to Christ. And the man that had killed her husband was brought to the United States, given a testimony of the whole thing. There’s a follow-up book on it, a couple of them. It’s an outstanding story, but you see those that spoiled the Christian missionaries wound up being the spoil of the wife of that Christian missionary. Hallelujah. That’s the power of God. See, there’s a lot of up-to-date stories on this. So the servants is us, where we were once spoils of the nations, now we’re serving the nations and taking them as spoil. Hallelujah. Powerful. And see, Zechariah saw all this right along with the other prophets. And I know most of you when you read these prophets, you don’t know beans of what you’re talking about. Now, when you read it, you’re going to get some understanding. Could that be an amen? Now, Proverbs 2:8, ask of me and I will give you the what? Nations for your inheritance and the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession. We ask for so little. This is a big ask. And see, to do that, I’ve got to avail myself to be a part and let God use me and I don’t know. I can’t just go, “Well, you know, like, you know, I got I got uh Michael Vick wants to be a football player, but he doesn’t want to practice and you know, I you know, he just wants to be a football player, you know, he wants the Eagles to win and and so forth and all that, but he doesn’t put any activity into it. I mean, you know, you’re going to lose. In other words, we can’t just pray. We got to become part of the team. Amen? Hallelujah. That was promised to Jesus, by the way, from the Father. How many of you know when the Father promises the Son something, he’s going to back it up?
How do we acquire God’s presence?
Sing and rejoice—when He dwells among us we praise.
How do we acquire God’s presence?

Yes. Now, acquiring God’s presence and its results. This is what I told them in the Bible study. We need the presence of God. We don’t come to Bible studies and we don’t assemble together for social reasons. We come, we need His presence and we need His word. And if we don’t have that, we don’t have anything. You see? His presence is not His approval, by the way. I keep telling you that. It is His affirmation. It is Him proving Himself that He’s real, He’s alive. It isn’t Him saying, “You’re you’re okay now. I’m here, so you’re approved. You’re You got the the USDA stamp of approval.” No. You may have some bad things in your life. He comes to say, “I back up my word. Now, listen to me, son. Me and you together, we can change your life.” Amen? Sing and rejoice, oh daughter of Zion. Why is it that all Protestant denominations sing in their church? Because it’s written in the book. You see, they sing. Why? It brings His presence. Now, He does come. I’ve been there in these denominational churches. I’ve told you, I’ve spoken in every one of them. Preached in them. They don’t know what to do when He comes. Hallelujah. We need to know what to do when He comes. We need to know how to release Him. And let Him edify and build and comfort the church of the living God. Rejoice and sing. How many of you know when you’re delivered from captivity, the first impulse is to what? Rejoice, yeah. When Second World War was over, what did we see going on throughout the world? Rejoice and sing. And man, that oh, yeah. Hallelujah. When those Jews got liberated from the concentration camp, they kissed the feet of those soldiers. They were so appreciative. And they thanked them and they praised them. And God says He’ll deliver us out of captivity. And when we do, we should what? Sing and rejoice. And who’s Zion? The church. And there’s that female part again. I’m just being honest with you. This church knows better. We know how to pray in the spirit. We know how to pray with intensity and meaning and we don’t. We know how to worship in spirit and in truth and we don’t. We settle for the form. We got to back We got to butt back up. Am I talking to the right people? Why? Praise is part of the principles that will bring his presence that will change people’s lives. Hallelujah. Ah. When he comes and dwells, when we feel his presence, what are we supposed to do? Sing and praise. Okay. Yes. And let him speak. That’s where prophecy comes in and and spiritual prayers and let him speak. Let him do his work. Many nations shall be joined to the Lord in that day. What’s the result of us responding to God? Many people will be joined to the Lord, not to a church, not to a denomination, but to who? The Lord. How many know that’s that will work? When you’re joined to the Lord, that works. And they shall be my people in that day. Do you remember what in that day means? In the end day, at the appointed time, the time from Christ came to the time that he is coming back again. So, are we in that season? Yes. I will dwell in the midst of you and you shall know that the Lord of hosts has sent me unto you. When? When you I dwell in your midst and I’m joining nations. I’m bringing people out of sin. I’m bringing them out of captivity. You’re going to know. Now, in closing, the last part of this chapter is God’s portion and his absolute power. Absolute power again is him independently having the power to do what he said he would do.
How do we acquire God’s presence?

Zechariah 2:10-11: “Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion! It’s unchangeable and it’s unlimited. That’s absolute. The Lord shall inherit who? Judah. Who’s Judah in the prophetic Old Testament? The church. Man, you you guys are getting smart, I tell you. Woo. A in the class. A in the class. His portion. So, who is God’s portion? The church, the people. I shall again choose Jerusalem, the church. You mess up, I’ll restore you. Don’t stay Don’t stay backslidden. You get down on yourself and you think you’re unworthy. He said, “I’ll restore you. I’ll come to my church again.” Isn’t that powerful? Yes. Yeah. How many of you ever needed as a Christian restoration? Yeah. He keeps his word, folks. We don’t have to quit and give up. He will choose us again. He chose us once. He’ll choose us what? Again. So, Judah, Daniel’s people was also out of Judah was people written in the book like Daniel. The church. Now, people ask me, “Well, why did God create the world?” Well, because he wants you. You’re his portion. You are what he gets out of the world of people that will choose freely to serve him and love him and spend eternity with him. That’s why he did all this. For you. He wanted to fill heaven with people, a created people, that would choose to love him. Freely choose. Hallelujah. And you know, you can choose not to, right? That’s what he gets out of this. Now, watch this. Deuteronomy 32:9, “The Lord’s portion is his people.” Exodus 19:5, “If you obey my voice indeed and keep my covenant, then you shall be a valued what?” Treasure. “unto me above all people.” So, what’s our responsibility? Obey and keep his covenant. Amen. We do have a responsibility. These people that say it’s not by works, they’re lying to you. It’s not by shadow law works and stuff. So you got to be careful. Hallelujah. Now watch this. “Be silent, O flesh, before the Lord, for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.” In the Psalms, God gives us a a great description of what he will do to save you. I love it. I love it. Now, God isn’t like this, but he knows you understand what he’s going to say here. When you ask God to deliver you, this is what God’s response is. You ready? Psalms 18:6-8. Number one, “In my distress, I called upon the Lord and cried unto my God.” Number one, see, I I go to who? I go to Jesus and I cry out and I pray to him. But the Lord was my stay. He was my support. You resisted me, you blamed me, you put me down, but listen, I didn’t move a 1 in because my support comes from Jesus Christ. I love the description of how he describes what he would do when we pray to him. This is powerful. How many like this? Man, I really love to see that fire coming out of his mouth and that smoke coming out of his nose, he’s mad. Psalm 18:6-19: In my distress I called upon the LORD, And cried out to my God; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry came before Him, even to His ears. Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations of the hills also quaked and were shaken, Because He was angry. Smoke went up from His nostrils, And devouring fire from His mouth; Coals were kindled by it. He bowed the heavens also, and came down With darkness under His feet. And He rode upon a cherub, and flew; He flew upon the wings of the wind. He made darkness His secret place; His canopy around Him was dark waters And thick clouds of the skies. From the brightness before Him, His thick clouds passed with hailstones and coals of fire. The LORD thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered His voice, Hailstones and coals of fire. You see, too many Christians are patting themselves on the back because they’re not sexually immoral, they’re not killing anybody, and God says, “That’s good. That’s really good.” But, you need to operate these other principles that bring the power.

Psalm 18:19: He also brought me out into a broad place; He delivered me because He delighted in me. Matthew 6:16: “Moreover, when you fast, do not be like the hypocrites, with a sad countenance. For they disfigure their faces that they may appear to men to be fasting. Assuredly, I say to you, they have their reward.
What is the first impulse after deliverance?
Not if you give yourself time.
He gets mad at the oppressor.
