Well, today, no one was prophesying, no one was speaking that only 25% of Catholics would be going to church in 2013. No one back there 50, 40, 30, 20 years ago. You see, the Catholic people are getting upset about their church allowing these homosexuals to come in and abuse their children, abuse their youth, and so forth. And so, they’re voting by staying away. Protestants, only 27% have been going for about 20 years. They got their little home Bible studies going and all that and they’re voting because of all the junk and the corruption in the Protestant church. Am I right? The only problem is when I looked into the home the home Bible study movement, they got the same problems as the denominational does. And we need to get rid of these problems and get back to the book. Can I hear an amen? Many of Americans youth, the news says today, vote liberal and they reject God’s promises of increase.
What happens to young people who grow up in church?

He says over 40 years of records show about 75% of young people whose parents take them to church fall away when they leave home, but in strong Christian homes with Christian schools about 75% stay with their faith. He says 50% of those who fell away come back, and “God is bigger than the statistics.”
What happens to young people who grow up in church?

They reject God’s word. But I submit to you, I’ve been keeping records for 40 years, over 40 years. And it’s been this way in every generation. 75% of the young people whose parents take them to church, okay? Fall away when they leave the house and go to college, go to school. The universities turn them all around and all that opportunity to sin is there. It’s always been that way. But let me tell you something. I also found that in strong Christian homes where they put their kids in a Christian school that 75% of them stay with their faith. Are you there? So in the midst of the bad news, there’s what? Good news. I also kept statistics that these that fell away, 50% of them come back somewhere down the road when they’ve been trained up in the way they should go. Somewhere they come to their senses like the prodigal in the pig pen, they come back and that puts the percentages in our favor. Are you there? So, don’t get so riled up about these statistics. God is bigger than the statistics and he has a message in the midst of the statistics that he is touching lives and gathering in people to him. Can I hear an amen? Hallelujah.
What happens to young people who grow up in church?

Proverbs 22:6: Train up a child in the way he should go, And when he is old he will not depart from it. Luke 15:17: “But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
Is God still reaching the unbeliever? (Jeremiah 3:17, Revelation 7:9)

He says “All nations, all Gentiles will be gathered to Jerusalem, the throne of the Lord,” and that Gentile means someone who doesn’t believe in God the Creator, so God is still reaching the unbeliever in the middle of judgment. He says “you got to preach the whole counsel of God,” the bad news and the good news, balanced. He cites Revelation 7:9, a great multitude “that no man could number.”
Is God still reaching the unbeliever? (Jeremiah 3:17, Revelation 7:9)

And that’s what we want him to do in this generation. Is that correct? Absolutely. All nations, all Gentiles will be gathered to Jerusalem, the throne of the Lord. All the Gentiles, he didn’t leave out the unbeliever. Gentile is someone that doesn’t believe in God, the creator. They believe in God’s, but they don’t believe in God the creator. They don’t believe in Jesus. Okay? That’s what the word nation is almost every time in your Bible. It’s Gentile. It’s those that don’t believe in God. That makes it easy to understand. So, is God in the middle of this judgment upon his people, judgment upon the wicked? Is he still reaching out to the unbeliever, the wicked sinner? Absolutely. And that’s what us Christians got to understand. You can’t get so wrapped up in the bad news that you forget there’s good news. In spite of God’s judgment, in spite of God’s vengeance, he is still married and he is still bringing people to Zion, his people. And he is still reaching out to the unbeliever and bringing them in. Wow. And you got to preach the whole counsel of God. If you’re going to preach the bad news, you got to preach the good news. If you’re going to preach the good news, you got to preach the bad news. It’s got to be balanced. Can I hear an amen? When we need to repent, we need to repent. Many of Americans, youth and Americans right now are voting liberal. They reject God’s promises of increase. They reject the Gentiles coming to God. They reject the message that believers are no more following their own ways and we’re just caving in and giving in to the news media around us. Now continuing, we go over to Revelation 7:9 and it says, “A great multitude that no man could number of all nations, all the Gentiles, all the kindreds, all the ethnic groups, all the people and all the languages stood before the throne and before the lamb clothed with white robes.” How many people when this thing is over is before Jesus Christ?
Is God still reaching the unbeliever? (Jeremiah 3:17, Revelation 7:9)

Jeremiah 3:17: “At that time Jerusalem shall be called The Throne of the LORD, and all the nations shall be gathered to it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem. No more shall they follow the dictates of their evil hearts. Revelation 7:9: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no one could number, of all nations, tribes, peoples, and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, with palm branches in their hands,
Is the church big and powerful in God’s eyes?

He says Revelation shows an innumerable company of people, and “The church is big. The church is powerful. The church is strong in God’s eyes.” He says end-time preachers miss that “the Lord of the harvest is bringing in the harvest” of both His people who act like Sodom and those without Him. He cites Jeremiah 3, “no more shall they follow the dictates of their evil hearts.”
Is the church big and powerful in God’s eyes?

A number that cannot what? Be numbered. Jeremiah is talking about something God is doing in the earth. John over in Revelation is talking about the accomplishment of it. And it’s an innumerable company of people. Christianity is big in God’s eyes. Christianity is powerful in God’s eyes. The church is big. The church is powerful. The church is strong in God’s eyes. And he’s going to bring our eyes up to his eyes. He’s going to bring our knowledge up to his knowledge and he’s going to bring the performance of his word up to where it is going to come to pass. And this is what the end time preachers are missing. That there is a visitation the end time. In spite of the bad news, there is some tremendous news that God the Lord of the harvest is bringing in the harvest. Both of his people who act like Sodom and those who are acting like Sodom and without him. Ah church, Jeremiah is hot stuff here. And this is the part that should get you excited to keep on serving God and keep preaching the gospel and let God change America. And listen to this. Jeremiah, going back to Jeremiah 3, no more shall they follow the dictates of their evil hearts. Wow. Now, is God going to do something or not? Yes. I mean, this is God talking so strongly that he says, “Man, I’m not only bringing the Gentiles in and my people who were wicked in, but no more are they going to follow their own opinions, their own standard of morality.
Is the church big and powerful in God’s eyes?

Luke 10:2: Then He said to them, “The harvest truly is great, but the laborers are few; therefore pray the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into His harvest. Jeremiah 3:17: “At that time Jerusalem shall be called The Throne of the LORD, and all the nations shall be gathered to it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem. No more shall they follow the dictates of their evil hearts.
Can God change America, and what is “the land of the north”? (Jeremiah 3:18)

He says God accomplished what He said in Jeremiah’s day, in Jesus’ day and in the apostles’ days, so “can he do that in the days of America? Absolutely.” He cites Jeremiah 3:18 and says “the land of the north” in the prophets is Bible terminology for opposition that invades God’s people. He says groups that oppose the Bible are “coming from the north,” and when the enemy comes in like a flood, the Lord will raise up a standard, “Bible morality.”
Can God change America, and what is “the land of the north”? (Jeremiah 3:18)

They’re going to follow me and my Bible morality. And he did it. When Jesus came, he did it. Multitudes followed him. When the apostles went out, the Bible says they turned the world upside down with the message of repentance. God accomplished what he said. And if he can accomplish it back in Jeremiah’s day, if he can accomplish in Jesus days, if he can accomplish in the apostles days, can he do that in the days of America? Absolutely. That’s the power of Jesus Christ. Again in verse 18, in those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel. They shall come together. The house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel. And they shall come together out of the land of the north. The land of inherit to the land of inheritance. The land of the north throughout Ezekiel, throughout Jeremiah, throughout Daniel is referring to the opposition in the natural coming down and invading Judah and having war with his people. Started with Assyria. It says Assyria came out of the north when they really came out of the east. It said Babylon came out of the north when Babylon was directly east. You’re looking at me like, “Huh? Duh.” Yeah, you need to you need to examine these things. In Daniel, we know that Rome and Greece were from the north. He says they were from the north and finally they get somebody north. But see, it’s a Bible terminology of opposition. So when the homosexual activists, the atheist, the humanist, the religious, and all these groups that oppose the Bible, they are coming from the north. Why? Because they are opposing God’s people. They’re opposing Jesus. They’re opposing the word. And when the enemy comes in like a flood, the Lord will what? Raise up a standard against him. And that standard is Bible morality. Amen. They’re going to come out of the land of the north. So these people, Judah and Israel, these part of God’s people are what? Opposers of the very God and the very Bible that they believe in. Are you there? Now, how does that work for us today? Well, let me give you a little of kinser imagination today.
Can God change America, and what is “the land of the north”? (Jeremiah 3:18)

Jeremiah 3:18: “In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given as an inheritance to your fathers. Isaiah 59:19: So shall they fear The name of the LORD from the west, And His glory from the rising of the sun; When the enemy comes in like a flood, The Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.
What is his illustration of Israel and Judah in America today?

He imagines Israel as the liberal side of the Bible in America and Judah as the conservative side, saying Israel rejected the Scriptures and made its own way of worship while Judah had God’s way but broke the moral laws. He says Christians in America today also “know the right way” but sin, and that God says He will bring them out of that opposition to Himself.
What is his illustration of Israel and Judah in America today?

All right. I very seldom say this is me but today this is me. Let me give you a little illustration of this. Let’s imagine that Israel is the liberal side of the Bible in America today and Judah is the conservative side. Okay, you got it? Two groups both believe in God. But see, Israel, they rejected the scriptures and said there was other sources to reason and logically make decisions and they created other gods and other ways of worshiping God. Does that sound like the liberals in America today? Absolutely. You see, they rejected the atonement that was coming, just like the liberals in America today. They made their own form of worship and taught the people a different way of worship than God’s way. Isn’t that what liberals do today? The liberal churches. Israel not only broke the moral laws, adultery, stealing, and all them civil laws, but they had their own way and wrong way to worship God and serve Jesus. Okay? Judah, they had the right way. They had God’s way, but they sinned. They broke the moral laws of the Bible. Are you there? Isn’t that the way a lot of us Christians are in America today? Yes, we know the right way, but we commit adultery, homosexuality, incest, stealing, you know, we won’t work. We’re lazy bums. Are you there? And so, we’re in opposition to Jesus and his word. And he said, I’m going to bring them out of that opposition. I’m gonna bring them to myself. Folks, that is powerful.
Is there hope for backsliding Americans and Christians? (Jeremiah 3:22, Isaiah 2:2)

He asks whether there is hope for Americans, believers who don’t obey, and the liberal church, and answers “Absolutely,” citing Jeremiah 3:22, “I will heal your backslidings.” He says salvation is not found in “the hills and the multitude of mountains” but in the Lord, and cites Isaiah 2:2 and Micah 4, where the mountain of the Lord’s house is the church. He says Israel’s high places were worship outside the temple, and deliverance “isn’t in these religions. It is in you.”
Is there hope for backsliding Americans and Christians? (Jeremiah 3:22, Isaiah 2:2)

Is there hope for Americans today? Hope for Christians that believe and don’t obey? Hope for the liberal church that had really messed up everything. Can they be saved by the power of Christ, his blood, and resurrection? Absolutely. Jeremiah 3:22, “Return. Repent you backsiding children. I will heal your backslidings.” Does Jesus have the power to heal, not just forgive our backsidings? Yes. Can he heal them? Can he restore us, make us whole again? Absolutely. He can deliver us from the disease of sin. Now listen to this. Jeremiah suddenly goes to the first person of the people through the Holy Spirit. He starts talking from the first person of the people and he says indeed we will come to you the Lord our God. Now see he’s talking about the people now saying this we will come to you the Lord our God. Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills and the multitude of mountains. Truly in the Lord our God is the salvation, the deliverance, the healing of Israel. Now you got to understand what the hills and the mountains are to get this. Isaiah 2:2, Micah 4 is very important verses for the church in this hour and in this day. Very important verses. Okay. And this is what he says. It shall come to pass in the last days. When is this going to come to pass? Are we living in the last days? Have we been living in the last days since Jesus died and started building his church? Absolutely. Okay. In the last days, the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains. Now, what is the who’s the Lord’s house? The church. Okay. It be established in the top of the mountains and exalted above the hills and all Gentiles shall flow into it. All many people shall go and say, “Come, let us go to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways. We will walk in his paths. For out of Zion, the church shall go forth what? The law and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem, the church.” Now, see, this is our problem. Israel had high places up on the hills and the mountains all over Judah and Israel. You got that? They had these high places. These places where they went to do their little thing to worship God when only worship was supposed to be where? In the temple. The sacrifices, the gathering together was to be where? In the temple. Not on the hills and the high places in the mountains. We will come to you. They said we will come to you. For deliverance isn’t in the mountains. It isn’t in these religions. It is in you. Amen. And who is the Lord, by the way? Jesus.
Is there hope for backsliding Americans and Christians? (Jeremiah 3:22, Isaiah 2:2)

Jeremiah 3:22: “Return, you backsliding children, And I will heal your backslidings.” “Indeed we do come to You, For You are the LORD our God. Jeremiah 3:23: Truly, in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, And from the multitude of mountains; Truly, in the LORD our God Is the salvation of Israel. Isaiah 2:2-3: Now it shall come to pass in the latter days That the mountain of the LORD’s house Shall be established on the top of the mountains, And shall be exalted above the hills; And all nations shall flow to it. Many people shall come and say, “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, To the house of the God of Jacob; He will teach us His ways, And we shall walk in His paths.” For out of Zion shall go forth the law, And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem. Micah 4:1-2: Now it shall come to pass in the latter days That the mountain of the LORD’s house Shall be established on the top of the mountains, And shall be exalted above the hills; And peoples shall flow to it. Many nations shall come and say, “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, To the house of the God of Jacob; He will teach us His ways, And we shall walk in His paths.” For out of Zion the law shall go forth, And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
Will every knee bow? (Micah 4:5, Philippians 2:10, Romans 14:11)

He cites Micah 4:5, “we will walk in the name of the Lord our God forever and ever,” and says the name people hate is Jesus. He cites Philippians 2:10 and Romans 14:11, “Every knee shall bow to me.” He says at the judgment throne you will be “confessing you were wrong,” and asks, “Wouldn’t it be better to do that now?”
Will every knee bow? (Micah 4:5, Philippians 2:10, Romans 14:11)

Now Micah 4:5 goes on to say this. All people will walk everyone in the name of his God. But we will walk in the name of the Lord our God forever and ever. And what is his name? Say it like you mean it. Yes. What do they hate out there? Jesus. You can say God all day long, but you say Jesus, you get them riled up. And that’s the exact name God has given us in Philippians 2:10. At the name of Jesus, every knee will bow. If Jesus is your Lord, I guarantee you, you will bow. If Jesus is your king, I guarantee you he will bow because that is a biblical expression of a recognition of a power by bowing. Romans 14:11, it is written, “Every knee shall bow to me.” Whether you like it, one of these days, you’re going to bow. You might have missed out on it on earth, but boy, when you get to heaven and you stand before him, you’re going to bow. Ain’t no cockiness. Then you’re going to humble yourself immediately. Bowed down on the ground. When you see his majesty, when you see his glory, when you see his authority, you are puny. You’re nothing. And you’re going to bow. And every tongue shall confess. If we confess our sins, he’s what? Faithful and just to forgive us our sins. What do you think you’re going to be doing when you stand before the judgment throne? Defending your choices? No. You’re going to be admitting, confessing you were wrong. Wouldn’t it be better to do that now? Amen. You say, “I’m wrong, Lord.” Jesus is the one we’re [unclear] into. Jesus is the one that can deliver us. Jesus is the one that can save America. Jesus is the one that can change my life today.
Will every knee bow? (Micah 4:5, Philippians 2:10, Romans 14:11)

Micah 4:5: For all people walk each in the name of his god, But we will walk in the name of the LORD our God Forever and ever. Philippians 2:10: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, and of those on earth, and of those under the earth, Romans 14:11: For it is written: “As I live, says the LORD, Every knee shall bow to Me, And every tongue shall confess to God.” 1 John 1:9: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
When does he say Jeremiah was speaking?
He says Jeremiah spoke less than 30 years before the captivity, with the Egyptian, Assyrian and Babylonian nations at war around Judah, and Israel already carried away captive.
What does he say the false prophets told Judah?
He says they spoke that “nothing’s going to happen to Judah,” even with wars and sin all around. He asks whether that sounds like America today.
Who does he say is the wife of Christ?
He says “The church,” citing 2 Corinthians 11:2, and that God reminds even a disciplined people, “you’re my bride.”
Is Christ coming back for a baby church?
He asks, “is he coming back for a baby church or a mature bride church?” He says the church will be a mature, righteous bride dressed in white linen when Christ comes.
What is his illustration from King David?

He says David’s first wife was married off to another man by her father, and after David became king he went and got his bride back. He says Jesus likewise takes us from the “bad husband” by His blood and the power of His resurrection.
Why does he say some Christians lack knowledge?
He says some don’t go to Sunday school or Bible studies “and they don’t open their book through the week.” He says they have time for everything but studying the Bible.
How does he say God writes His word in us?
He says it is the new covenant promise that God would inscribe it in our minds and hearts, but asks “how can he inscribe when we’re not hearing it, listening to it, reading it, and studying it?”
Does he say young people who fall away come back?
He says 50% of those who fell away come back “like the prodigal in the pig pen,” which “puts the percentages in our favor.”
He says Gentile is someone who doesn’t believe in God the Creator or in Jesus. He says the word nation in your Bible is almost every time Gentile: “It’s those that don’t believe in God.”
Must we preach both the bad news and the good news?
He says “If you’re going to preach the bad news, you got to preach the good news. If you’re going to preach the good news, you got to preach the bad news.” He says, “It’s got to be balanced.”
What does he say we will be doing at the judgment throne?
He says we will not be defending our choices: “You’re going to be admitting, confessing you were wrong.” He says it would be better to do that now.

p: Pastor David G. Kincer turns to solutions after teaching that nations get the governments they deserve. Christians must be strong, judge sin rightly, and set goals. Abraham didn’t only pray; he armed his servants and rescued Lot. Nothing restrains the Lord, so begin by becoming Jesus’ friend and raising righteous leaders who glory in knowing God.

items.d: God will favor His church, yet some won’t repent. A few faithful men transformed Babylon. Christ will come and must reign until all enemies, including death, are subdued. Paul’s logic on suffering and baptism…
p: God will favor His church, yet some won’t repent. A few faithful men transformed Babylon. Christ will come and must reign until all enemies, including death, are subdued. Paul’s logic on suffering and baptism for the dead shows the resurrection’s reality—so avoid corrupting company and awake to righteousness.

p: 1 Corinthians 12–14 is vital. Only the Spirit enables us to call Jesus Lord. The same Spirit works through diverse gifts, services and operations—from maintenance to miracles—in every believer. Wisdom and knowledge come with growth, and we must know which spirit we’re of.
They concern spiritual things—“gifts” is in italics; God wants things manifested in His church.

The next three chapters of First Corinthians is so vital to Christians. It is so important that I cannot stress enough how you need to understand these next three chapters. And today we’re going to be looking at the subject of spiritual expressions. Spiritual is non-carnal. Spiritual has nothing to do with humans. It is separate from humans. Humans are limited in what they can do. But the spirit is not limited. 1 Corinthians 12, he’s going to talk about spiritual manifestations. Okay, spiritual expressions. Verse one. Now, concerning spiritual gifts, you notice the word gift is an italics. That means it’s not in the verse. It was added to the verse. And this is one of the things that us Pentecostals made a big mistake about for decades. That word gift there is not there. They added it trying to help us understand. And so people just preached it like it was that’s the way it was. But it’s not. A better word would be manifestations or expressions as you will see later. [clears. He says, “I don’t throat] want you to be ignorant of spiritual things.” You see, and God doesn’t want us to be ignorant of spiritual things. You know, getting saved is just the beginning of things. God has things for his church, to be active in his church, to be manifested in his church that we need to get out of our eternal life mentality and get in to this part. Amen. Now, and he also says in verse two, you know that you were Gentiles carried away unto these dumb idols even as you were led. Okay? He says, I don’t want you to be ignorant of spiritual things, but I want to remind you that before you came to Christ, you were spiritually dumb. So don’t think too highly of yourself. It is amazing how people get saved and all of a sudden they think they got the wisdom of the spiritual world. And Paul is really deflating them here. You know, the Bible says when you follow idols that can’t how don’t have eyes to see, ears to hear, a mouth to speak, and they they don’t have feet to walk. [clears throat] He says they that follow them become what? Just like them. And so he says, “You dumbbells followed those dumb idols. So don’t think you’re so smart concerning spiritual things. How many can raise your hands and boy that’s me. See that’s the first thing I need to understand spiritual things. And Paul is really emphasizing this. He said you thought you were being led into spiritual things. You ever you know as Pentecostals are always saying well I was led by the spirit and we do some of the dumbest things led by the spirit. Corinthians, Paul is saying, “You are ignorant and you are dumb concerning spiritual things, and I don’t want you to be ignorant anymore.” So, he’s talking to the right guy.

Now, how can Satan be Jesus’s brother when Jesus created everything? Huh? You see, that’s not the spirit talking. And if it’s not the spirit talking, then we got a problem. I don’t need it. And I don’t need people giving me their opinions. I need God. And his Amen. Spirit revealing things to me. Can I hear an amen? [clears. He says, “No man throat] can say that Jesus is Lord, the supreme authority, the supreme power but by the Holy Ghost.” You see, now [clears we go to Matthew. Throat] Give you an example of this. Matthew 16:15. Jesus [clears throat] asked those around him, “Who am I?” Okay. Peter said, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.” Now watch this. Jesus said, “Flesh and blood has not revealed it unto you, Peter, but my father which is in heaven.” You didn’t say this on your own. You got this directly from the Revelation of the spirit of God, God himself. That’s why you can say it. Do you understand that, church? Hallelujah. See, we need the spirit involved in everything. Does Paul have your attention? Let me give you another example. Luke 6:46. They come to him and said, “Lord, Lord.” He says, “Why do you call me Lord, Lord, and what? Do not the things I say.” If you were saying that by the spirit of God in you, you would be backing it up by obeying me, but you’re saying I’m Lord, and it’s just your human mind saying it. Romans 10:9, if you shall confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus Christ and believe in your heart that God has raised him from the dead, you will be what? Saved. Now, I and all of my salvation soul winners, we basically use this scripture. Why? If we can get them to say Jesus is Lord when they invite Christ into their life, it’s quick to see if they’ve been born again or not. See, because the spirit’s going to give them the authority, the the motive to say it. Are you with me? And that’s the test of being born again. See, Jesus said, “You got to be born again.” Born of what? The spirit. See, even in salvation, that spirit’s got to be involved. And this is the problem in many Christians in America. They have a bad birthing. The spirit wasn’t involved in their birthing. I mean, Paul knows what he’s talking about. You can’t just get water baptized and get a baptism or certificate and just put your roll on the church. That doesn’t mean you’ve been born again at all. You’re born again when that spirit comes and he lifts that load of sin and you’re free from that guilt. And you know that night that that I gave my heart to God, I knew I was a different person. Something was going on in me that wasn’t going on before. I didn’t know at the time it was the Holy Ghost, [clears throat] but I knew it wasn’t me. Now, now he’s going to go into three spiritual areas with differences in each area. Verse four, how many areas? Three. And every area has diversities, has different things going on, varieties in them. God is a God of variety.

1 Corinthians 12:3: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking by the Spirit of God calls Jesus accursed, and no one can say that Jesus is Lord except by the Holy Spirit. Matthew 16:15-17: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Simon Peter answered and said, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.” Jesus answered and said to him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar-Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but My Father who is in heaven. Luke 6:46: “But why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ and not do the things which I say?
The same Spirit works in many abilities and helps—serving the Lord, from maintenance to lawns; few officers, many soldiers.

Okay. So, first he says there are diversities of gifts, assistance, uh abilities, helps, aids, and it’s the same spirit that does this. So, if I have a gift of the spirit and the spirit is non-human, it’s supernatural. I have what? Supernatural gift. I have a supernatural ability beyond my human. Do you get that? See, I can’t think in my human mind this stuff. It has to be the Holy Ghost doing it. So far so good. That’s one area. The second area there are diversities of service but the same Lord. Who am I serving? The Lord. I pledge allegiance to the lamb. We’ve been singing it till it’s coming out of your ears. Why? We need to make him Lord of our life and do what he says. Hallelujah. Now, what’s the word service? Ministry. Just doing. Uh Haley was in here this morning serving in the kitchen, chopping up vegetables. That’s one area. Somebody else was vacuuming the carpet and stuff. See, that’s service. Duh. That’s spiritual. Yeah. First comes the natural, then the spiritual. If you don’t have a heart for God’s natural house, you’ll never get a heart for his spiritual house. If you don’t care of where you come to church or not or whether church is clean or or you know anything going on, you will never have a heart and a cure for the spiritual her church, the spiritual house, the people, because first comes the natural. Do you understand? That’s why when I was a young Christian, I said, ‘ God, whatever you want me to do, I’m I’m willing to do it. I’m going to make you Lord of my life. And the first thing that he says, just do what the pastor asked you to do. I’ve shared this with you before. I go to church and I told the pastor, you know, do you need help around here? He said, oh yes, I need to go down and tear down this building and bring the lumber so we can build rooms in the basement. Man, I thought for sure he’s going to ask me to preach. At that point in my life, that’s what I thought. Oh man, he’s he’s seen my hunger for God. He going to ask me to preach. Didn’t didn’t ask me to preach at all. Thank God. I’d have failed and it was natural things and I did it and it was a lot of ushering as a needs to be done in the house of God. It’s serving, you know, taking care of the books, doing the accounting. There’s all kinds of thing, the maintenance, the lawns. There’s all kinds of things that’s serving. And it is spiritual manifestation, expression because you’re doing it from the motivation of the spirit. And honestly, church, we need more of that kind of ministry than we need quote unquote the big men of God because it takes a lot of natural things to get things done in a church. But most churches, people just come, put in their time, punch their clock, and leave. They never ask to be involved. They never ask to help. And if they are asked to help, they’re too busy for one reason or another. And so they miss out on serving. Hallelujah. I’m going to prove it to you. [clears throat] Luke 10:40. Martha was cumbered about by much serving, ministering. Now, what was she doing? Those of us who know the story, she was cooking, cleaning, washing clothes, taking care of Jesus and his disciples. She wasn’t preaching, prophesying, speaking in tongues, or anything. She was just doing what needed to be done to keep these guys fed, cleaned, and groomed, and whatever. Are you there? Now in I’m sorry I clicked it but Acts six the apostle said we will give oursel to what? Prayer and the ministry of the word. See that’s another area. See right now I am ministering. I am serving you by giving you the word of God. How many generals in an army? Very few. One or two. Huh? Depend. Yeah. And how many soldiers? Thousands. You get my point? We don’t need a lot of super saints. We need a lot of regular recruits doing their job. Amen. And knowing they are important, knowing they are v vital to winning the war. [clears throat] Operations, there are diversities of operations. Operations means effects, results, the outcome. It’s only used twice in the Bible and both are in this chapter and it’s used down there in verse 12, [clears throat] the working of miracles, the results of miracles, supernatural things. When Jesus calmed the storm, the result was the storm was calm. When Jesus uh walked on water, the result was he the water supported him.

1 Corinthians 12:4-6: There are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit. There are differences of ministries, but the same Lord. And there are diversities of activities, but it is the same God who works all in all. Luke 10:40: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she approached Him and said, “Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Therefore tell her to help me.”
Effects beyond the nine gifts—Peter freed by an angel while the church prayed; the sorcerer struck blind.

You see, there are effects [clears and all we ever throat] talk about is nine gifts of the spirit in here in the Pentecostal areas. But it is the same God which works all in all. Now you notice the trinity is listed in these verses. Did you notice that? The spirit, the son Jesus, and God. In verse 11, Paul said Jesus is under submission to God and the man is under submission to Christ. Here’s some effects. People wanted to get under Peter’s shadow. Now, why do you think they wanted to just let his shadow touch them? Because there was some kind of an effect. I mean, ain’t nobody chasing me down to get in my shadow. Now, see these this is above these little spiritual gifts we’re talking about. This is powerful stuff. You remember Peter was asleep in prison. They’re going to cut his head off the next day. He’s asleep and he’s so comfortable sleeping sleeping. The angel came in, opened the gates, opened the doors, made all this noise, and had to wake him up. If most of you were going to die tomorrow, you wouldn’t be sleeping. You’d be calling to 24-hour hotline. You’d be calling, you know, JB Farball to pray for you. I mean, man, you’d be pacing the floor. Oh, what an old Lord. Lord, this isn’t fair. This isn’t fair. My goodness, you promised to bless me and here I’m going to die tomorrow. But see, he had the effectiveness of God in him. That peace of God that passes understanding and he just went to sleep. Isn’t that powerful? The church was praying for him. By the way, they were doing what they’re supposed to do. And the angel came and let him go. And when Peter came to the house and said, “Hey, I’m Peter. You know, I’m out of jail.” They said, “No, no, you’re in jail. You’re in prison.” He said, “No, no, it’s me. It’s really me.” Now, they’re praying for him to get out. They’re praying for in deliverance and they ain’t got enough faith to believe it’s him. And the point of that is you don’t need a lot of faith. Just obey. You may doubt it. Just just pray. And the effect of that church praying brought the angel and delivered Peter. So see, prayer is important. What we did this morning is very important. You may be embarrassed about it. It may be against your upbringing, but let me tell you, that stuff is vital for the spirit to move in people’s lives and do the work that he needs to do. Well, don’t embarrass me. God’s going to embarrass you. If prayer is is your embarrassment, then you’re going to be embarrassed because he ain’t going to do things outside of his laws. See, God has laws and he follows them. See, we think he changes them for us. He doesn’t. He follows his own laws. Paul’s praise opened the prison doors. Here’s Paul in prison. And he’s down there praising God and worshiping God. Hallelujah. Praise God. And the prison shook. The doors were open and all the captives were set free. See here, prayer and praise brought what? An effect, an operation, an outcome. And it’s not a gift. It is a result of obeying God. And then God gave them a tremendous outcome. Do we need effects in the church? Do we need operations in the church? Beside the gifts, do we need the operations? Absolutely. Hallelujah. And we keep doing what we did this morning, we’ll get back to having a spiritfilled le church. I guarantee you. And people’s lives will be changed. They’ll either run from God or they’ll run to God. There’s only two choices. And people that aren’t here for God, they will run. If they’re here, like I told the youth Friday night, if you’re here for your hot dog and your soda and to socialize, you’re here for the wrong reason. And if our services on Friday are geared for socializing only and all that, we are missing it. Okay? When I led youth, I wasn’t there to please youth. I was there to change youth and the services were geared for change. Hallelujah. While it was geared for youth, you know, the Bible says, “They that hate him will flee before him.” You see, when they’re running from Jesus, don’t feel bad when they don’t like what you do. See, when Jesus shows up, there’s people that don’t really want him to be real. Cuz he’s going to ask them to do things that are embarrassing to them against what they want to do. And the sorcerer was made blind. Remember Jesus said, “God smite you with blindness.” The sorcerer was made blind. There’s no gift of making people blind in the Bible. That was a result of the operations of God. See, Paul had availed himself. And because he availed himself, then God used him when he needed to use him. You got it? Now, this seventh verse is very important. But the manifestation, the expression, the demonstration of the spirit. Now he’s summing up just what he said. There are three areas of manifestation. Gifts, operations, and serving. And he says all three of these expressions of the spirit is given to how many people?

Acts 12:5-11: Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church. And when Herod was about to bring him out, that night Peter was sleeping, bound with two chains between two soldiers; and the guards before the door were keeping the prison. Now behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the prison; and he struck Peter on the side and raised him up, saying, “Arise quickly!” And his chains fell off his hands. Then the angel said to him, “Gird yourself and tie on your sandals”; and so he did. And he said to him, “Put on your garment and follow me.” So he went out and followed him, and did not know that what was done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision. When they were past the first and the second guard posts, they came to the iron gate that leads to the city, which opened to them of its own accord; and they went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him. And when Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I know for certain that the Lord has sent His angel, and has delivered me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the Jewish people.” Acts 13:11: And now, indeed, the hand of the Lord is upon you, and you shall be blind, not seeing the sun for a time.” And immediately a dark mist fell on him, and he went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
Every man—not just famous ministers; word of wisdom (Stephen) and word of knowledge.

Every man. But I need Oral Roberts to be my prayer guy. I need Billy Graham. I need No, every person can have these manifestations when God is manifesting. But we’ve been taught ever since I was in the church world that the man of God or the woman of God, the pastor, the evangelist got to do it. And Paul says we can all experience the manifestations of the spirit. Can I hear an amen? Yeah. Give God a clap offering. He didn’t bring you into the kingdom to make you a wimp. He brought you into kingdom to give you an inheritance that people aren’t preaching for to that you can have. Now verse eight, he says to one of all the people, see he’s talking to the Corinthians, all of you can do it. To one is given by the spirit. Who’s it given by? The spirit. You can’t fabricate these things. You can’t emotionally conjure them up. They have to be initiated and worked by the spirit. And us Pentecostals need to get that through our head. Can I hear an amen? To another of the same sort. The white anothers are the same sort. The yala anothers are a different sort, a different kind. You got to understand that. Very important. I didn’t understand this for years. To another of the same kind, the word of knowledge by the same spirit. Now, let me give you an example of the word of wisdom and the word of knowledge. And it’s really going to go against everything you’ve been taught in Pentecost. But I go by the Bible. Steven was a long-winded preacher like I was. And at the end of his message, I mean, he went to Abraham and showed how Abraham was mistreated. He went to uh Joseph, how he was mistreated. He went to uh Israel going into Egypt and how they were mistreated. And Israel coming out of Egypt and how they mistreated God. And all the way to Solomon in his temple and Solomon fell away, you know, with having so many wives, they led him astray and all that. After he gives this big long record of the history of the Jewish people, then he says this is the point. They were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which Steven spoke. See, he had a word of what? Wisdom. And what he was telling them at the end is you resist the Holy Ghost just like the forefathers resisted the Holy Ghost. You resist the Holy Ghost just like Joseph’s brothers did and mistreated him. You resist the Holy Ghost just like the people around Abraham did and mistreated him. You resist the Holy Ghost just like Israel in the wilderness. You resisting the Holy Ghost just like those people did. Now, that’s a word of wisdom. And he got his point across and they just loved it and got converted that day, right? No. You think a word of wisdom is going to bring you flattery all the time? They stoned him. They killed him. They didn’t want to be told they were resisting God. They were resisting the Holy Ghost. They want to be told that boy, they’re people of faith. They’re God’s chosen people. Is a lot of American Christians the same way. Yeah. They just want to be told they’re going to heaven. They want to be told they are Christians and they resist the Holy Ghost. That’s the word of wisdom. Now, let’s look at a word of knowledge. Luke 177. Here’s [clears throat] John the Baptist. And it says that John the Baptist prophesying over John the Baptist that he’s going to give know the knowledge of what? Salvation unto his people by the what? Remission of sin. Now this had not been revealed before but it was in the Old Testament. And John came with that fresh Revelation but it was the knowledge of the Old Testament. It was the knowledge of what God was going to do. Amen. And so when I’m sharing with people to win them to Christ, I’m giving them the word of knowledge. When I’m sharing people about the baptism of the Holy Ghost, I’m giving them the word of knowledge. These are things I know from God opening the word up to me and it’s backed up by the Bible. That’s knowledge. Me telling Mr. Barnes that he’s got a hole in his heart is not a word of knowledge. You know, when I was a young Christian, every every believer was running around in Pentecostal areas looking through you, man. Oh, I see you. You’re not good. You got man, you got faults in your life. Boy, God’s going to judge you. Everybody, and that turns the other churches off because they know better. Are you there? And even today in these circles, you got these quote unquote spiritual, oh, God gave me a word for you about God. What’s wrong with God coming to them? Amen. He says all of us could have these things. Hallelujah. Now to another of a different kind, a different area, [clears faith, gifts throat] of healing, plural gifts, another the working of miracles, and another prophecy. Now, these are all under the same kind of spirit. They’re all the same spirit, but a different expression of the Holy Spirit. Got it? Now, we I’ll get into the discerning of spirits. Now, listen. I I’ I’ve been in Pentecost ever since I got saved. Okay? I got saved in Assembly God Church. I’m a tongue-talking Pentecostal. I mean, man, I am authentic. Like Paul said about being a Pharisee, man. I am authentic Pentecostal. And I would hear people saying, “God gave me all nine gifts.” And of course, I read my Bible right off the bat. I mean, in one year, I told you I knew more than the people in the congregation knew because I studied and read. They didn’t know beans.

1 Corinthians 12:7-8: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to each one for the profit of all: for to one is given the word of wisdom through the Spirit, to another the word of knowledge through the same Spirit, Acts 7:51-58: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, so do you. Which of the prophets did your fathers not persecute? And they killed those who foretold the coming of the Just One, of whom you now have become the betrayers and murderers, who have received the law by the direction of angels and have not kept it.” When they heard these things they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth. But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, gazed into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God, and said, “Look! I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!” Then they cried out with a loud voice, stopped their ears, and ran at him with one accord; and they cast him out of the city and stoned him. And the witnesses laid down their clothes at the feet of a young man named Saul.
Does God hand out gifts freely?
Show growth first; there are three spirits—man’s, Satan’s and God’s—know what spirit you’re of.
Does God hand out gifts freely?

They just sat there and listened to the preacher every day. And I learned. And number one, I knew God doesn’t go around giving gifts to noviceses because I read over there where Paul says, “Don’t give these things to noviceses. They’ll be lifted up with pride.” They got to go through the growing process, the training thing before God’s going to give you anything. Could that be an amen? And here they are. They’re saved one month and the next month they got all nine gifts. And I go, “Yeah, what Bible you reading? What ghost do you?” God isn’t going to give him one gift. He’s going to give them the gift of Christ and the gift of the Holy Ghost to lead them into all truth. And these real substance things, he is not going to give them to because they can use them to destroy people. Hallelujah. You know, you got to show some growth before you’re going to get wisdom and knowledge and prophecy. You got to show some maturity. God’s not going to dis distribute. And and even in these circles today, these people go, “I got to work. God showed me.” Ah, why do we got to hype up everything? Because we feel real spiritual. We feel real special. We feel powerful when we think we’re hearing from God. Are you there? Discerning of spirits is judging, making a decision. Okay. A distinction from the spirits. Now, how many spirits are there? How many spirits are there? Three. Man, you you’re a wise congregation. Wise. There’s the spirit of man. There’s the spirit of Satan, evil spirits, and there is the spirit of God. And discerning spirits is just knowing what source the spirit is. Okay? An example, Luke 9:55, [clears throat] you know not what manner of spirit you are. Why did Jesus say that? Because they wanted to call down far from heaven and destroy these people that didn’t want Jesus coming into the town. So they knew in the Old Testament that Elijah called far down from heaven and destroyed the soldiers coming to get him. So they said, “Lord, let’s call down fire.” They were using the scripture in the wrong way. And Jesus said, “What? You don’t know what spirit you’re on. That’s not the Holy Spirit. That’s your spirit. You got this thing all wrong. I come to save life, not kill people. I’m not out to kill people. I’m out to save people. That’s what he said next. Do you get it? Hallelujah. Acts 19:15. The evil spirit. These these seven sons of Cphus as they saw Paul casting out demons. And here’s a guy with an evil spirit like Saul had. King Saul had. He was angry, you know, did hurtful things. Evil spirit means a harmful spirit. And so they tried to cast out this spirit using the methods Paul used. And this evilspirited man like King Saul said, “Jesus [clears throat] I know and Paul I know, but who in the world are you guys?” And he pounced on them, beat them up, took their clothes off, and chased them out of the house naked. See, they did not have discerning of spirits. But that was a harmful spirit. I know some people with a harmful spirit. And it’s not demon possession. They are viciously angry. They hurt people without even thinking about it. And that’s not the human spirit. That’s not God’s spirit. That is a harmful spirit source and you need to get rid of it. Can I hear an amen? Hallelujah. Now, in the Pentecostals, you got discerning your spirit. You know, you can see through people and you can’t see beans. Come on. You haven’t even straightened out your own life. How you going to get the the 2x4 out of your brother’s life when when you got a tree in your own life? Amen. And so when we when we do these things by the flesh and the spirit is not ignited and we look like fools and we ask for criticism. We invite it and then we don’t even have answers for them. We just go, “Well, you know, they’re just not filled with the Holy Ghost. They don’t understand.” Geez. You have to have the Holy Spirit, the initial spirit of God when he comes before you’re even born again. Isn’t that right? We just saw that. Are you there? So, they do have the Holy Spirit. They just haven’t been baptized in that power of the Holy Ghost yet. But that doesn’t mean that they don’t have some power, does it? Are you there? I’ve seen a lot of people that don’t profess to have the baptism of the Holy Ghost have more power from that initial spirit than these people that claim to have the baptism of the Holy Ghost. And it showed in their life.
Does God hand out gifts freely?

Luke 9:55: But He turned and rebuked them, and said, “You do not know what manner of spirit you are of. Acts 19:15: And the evil spirit answered and said, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are you?”
Where did his parents take him?
What did he know the night he gave his heart?
I pledge allegiance to the Lamb.

items.d: Tongues and prophecy must come from the Spirit, in proportion to the word. God places each member—apostles, prophets, teachers, helps, governments—and not all have the same role. Covet the best gifts and let…
p: Tongues and prophecy must come from the Spirit, in proportion to the word. God places each member—apostles, prophets, teachers, helps, governments—and not all have the same role. Covet the best gifts and let the Holy Ghost nudge you into contributing.
What about diverse kinds of tongues?
Different kinds—but self-initiated babble isn’t the Spirit; gifts build the church.
What about diverse kinds of tongues?

And to another of a different kind. This is a different level. Diverse kinds of tongues. How many kinds of tongues? Different kinds. Okay. There’s three mentioned in the Bible. The unknown tongue, which could be the angel’s tongue. Then there’s tongues of angels. And then there’s tongues of this earth. You didn’t know the language, but the Holy Ghost used you to speak the language because he wanted to convict the sinner that’s there. Tongues are for the unbeliever. And when tongues are done right, I tell you, I’ve been it’s powerful. Even if there’s no interpretation, you can feel the power of God fill the air when they’re speaking in that heavenly language. We may not understand what they’re saying, but that presence of God backs it up. And when they’re not speaking, ain’t no presence backing up anything. It’s just shaka moola moola moola mo. I’m on a tongue talk. It’s myself that’s speaking. Nothing. It’s why it isn’t initiated by the Holy Ghost and it isn’t have an effect by the Holy Ghost. It’s just a worthless time in the service. But when the interpretation comes, then it’s really powerful. Hallelujah. So there’s nine expressions of gifts, services, and effects. Okay. Here’s another list of gifts in Romans 12:6. Heaven then gifts differing. Here it is. The variety differing according to the grace that is given to us whether prophecy let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith.
What about diverse kinds of tongues?
1 Corinthians 12:10: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of tongues, to another the interpretation of tongues.
How do we prophesy and serve?
In proportion to faith and the word; if you serve, serve; teach, don’t just read a book; give with simplicity, show mercy with cheerfulness.
How do we prophesy and serve?

So we know these are not offices that these are gifts these are manifestations that build the church up because it depends on something you’ve done you’ve grown. You have understanding. You sought God. And when you have the offices of prophet, his faith has nothing to do with it. When Isaiah prophesied of Christ coming, God didn’t ask him, “Do you believe this?” God just said, “Say this.” Got it? That’s the office of a prophet. These other areas of prophecy is totally different. So we know the proportion is the amount, the percent, the quantity of your faith and faith comes by hearing the word. So it’s in proportion to what you know of the word. This is not the office of a prophet. A prophet doesn’t have to know beans about the word and God just speaks through them and they’re never wrong. So this is quite a lower place of prophecy. You understand that church? And then according to the proportion of our faith ministry, well, if you’re going to serve, serve. Don’t stand there and talk about it. Serve. Can I hear an amen? And wait on our is not in the scripture. In the King James, it’s going to say wait on hour. It’s not there. You’re not waiting on anything. The manifestation of the spirit is there. And if you’re going to serve, get to serving. And if you don’t want to serve, just say, “I’m a taker, man. I’m a taker.” It’s like my dog at home. That dog’s worthless. Doesn’t give the family anything. Just takes the food. I have to pick up the poop. My boys don’t even pick up the Gosh almighty. Their dog. I Ah, it’s just a taker. I have to brush the dumb thing. I mean, who’s the smart one here? The dog. Yeah. And I keep looking at him. I SAY, “YOU’RE A TAKER.” How many going to stop being a taker? That means you’re going to be a server. Find something to do and get to doing it. You don’t have to brag about it. Just do it. He that teaches on teaching. Okay? If you’re going to teach, teach. And don’t get a book, open it, and read page by page out of it, and call that teaching. You should know what’s in that book. items.t: Stupid and Twisted on the Edge
items.d: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from 2 Peter 3:16 and 2 Peter 2 about “untaught” and “unstable” people who twist the scriptures. He lists doctrines he says are twisted, including once saved…
p: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from 2 Peter 3:16 and 2 Peter 2 about “untaught” and “unstable” people who twist the scriptures. He lists doctrines he says are twisted, including once saved always saved, the prosperity doctrine, purgatory and infant baptism, discusses who interprets scripture, and says believers should be like the Bereans and search the Bible daily.
What does it mean to twist the scriptures? (2 Peter 3:16, 2 Timothy 2:18)

He says 2 Peter 3:16 speaks of the “untaught and unstable” who twist the scriptures to their own destruction, and “twist means to distort, to explain falsely, to misinterpret.” He gives the early church teaching that the resurrection was already past (2 Timothy 2:18) as an example, and says “once saved always saved” is a distortion that is “not in the Bible anywhere.”
