items.t: What Does the Baptism of the Holy Spirit Have to Do with This?
items.d: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer calls the baptism of the Holy Ghost the third promise that brings us into the divine nature, a baptism of power he says is for today. Using Luke 24, Acts 1 and 2, Ezekiel…
p: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer calls the baptism of the Holy Ghost the third promise that brings us into the divine nature, a baptism of power he says is for today. Using Luke 24, Acts 1 and 2, Ezekiel 36 and John 14, he says the Comforter is Jesus coming back in spirit, and that this promise is for all flesh with no respect of persons. He then separates the gifts of the Spirit from the fruit and shares an experience about tongues.
Is the baptism of the Holy Spirit for today?

He says the baptism of the Holy Ghost is the promise of the Father, a baptism of power or spiritual ability, and that Peter said the promise is to you, your children and all who are afar off. He says there is no dispensation where it started and stopped, and that dispensationalism is man-made.
Is the baptism of the Holy Spirit for today?

So today we’re going to look at the third promise that God promised to help bring us into the divine nature and it is the baptism of the Holy Ghost. Baptism of the Holy Spirit. We argue about it. We fight over it. We divide over the doctrine of the baptism of the Holy Ghost. And that just should not be. And today I hope that you will get the word of truth in you and get rid of the quarreling, get rid of the division and get the ghost. He’s very important and I’m going to show you who the ghost is today clearly. All right. Luke 24:49. I send the promise of my father upon you. See here it is the promise. Remember the exceedingly great and precious promises by that by these we may be partakers of the divine nature. Here he plainly says, “I send the promise of my father upon you. Wait in Jerusalem until you be clothed with power from on high.” So the Holy Spirit baptism is a baptism of power. Spiritual ability. Spiritual ability. Say that. Spiritual ability. Spiritual ability. Yes. Supernatural ability. Ability that comes from God. All right. Acts 1 verse four and five. So Jesus comes after he rose from the dead, appears to his apostles, and he was assembled together with them. Jesus commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise. There it is again. Wait for the promise of the father. Which he said, “You have heard of me.” Not only did the Father tell you, but I’m told you. For John baptized with water, but you shall be baptized with the what? Holy Ghost not many days from now. And that was 10 days. 10 days later after he ascended. And so the baptism of the Holy Ghost is being clothed with power. It is the promise of the father, one of the exceedingly great and precious promises to bring us into the divine nature. Acts 2:38. After the Holy Ghost was poured out, Peter said, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.” So the prerequisite for being filled and baptized with the Holy Ghost is to repent from your sins and get water baptized. And he says, “Everyone that repents from their sins and gets water baptized shall,” and the word shall there is nothing can stop it from happening. For the promise, there’s that word again, the promise is unto you, to your children, and all that are afar off, as many as the Lord our God shall call. So, here’s that promise again. Now, the fundamentalists and the Pentecostals and the charismatics and the Lutherans and the Methodists, we’re all in a big fight whether the baptism of the Holy Ghost is for today or not. The fundamentalists, they got these dispensations, their dispensationalist and and so they have a dispensation where miracles and baptism of the Holy Ghost only happened back in the early church. There is no doctrine in the Bible about dispensationalism. It’s man-made. All right? I’m just going to tell you bluntly right here tells us plainly that the promise is not only to those apostles but to or those 120 that was in the upper room, but to their children and to all a far off. How many you know we’re a far off? Yeah. To all as many as the Lord shall call. So there is no dispensation where the Holy Ghost started and stopped. And the fundamentalists are wrong here. They say it’s not for today. And they you just get the Holy Ghost when you’re baptized in water.
Is the baptism of the Holy Spirit for today?

Luke 24:49: Behold, I send the Promise of My Father upon you; but tarry in the city of Jerusalem until you are endued with power from on high.” Acts 1:4-5: And being assembled together with them, He commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to wait for the Promise of the Father, “which,” He said, “you have heard from Me; for John truly baptized with water, but you shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days from now.” Acts 2:38-39: Then Peter said to them, “Repent, and let every one of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins; and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit. For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are afar off, as many as the Lord our God will call.”
What does the promise of the Spirit include, according to Galatians 3 and Ezekiel 36?

He says the blessing of Abraham came through Jesus, and that we might also receive the promise of the Spirit, which is part of the divine nature. He reads Ezekiel 36:26-27 that God will put a new spirit within us and cause us to walk in his statutes, which he says means God’s own Spirit will be an active force in us.
What does the promise of the Spirit include, according to Galatians 3 and Ezekiel 36?

That’s a lie, too. And I can show you in the Bible. And I have showed you the baptism of the Holy Ghost is a an experience in God of power. And we we’re going to see something here. All right. So, aren’t you glad that this promise is to us a far off? We need power. How many need power, supernatural spiritual power in your life? We do, folks. We can’t serve God on our own brain power and own willpower. We need his power. All right. Now, let’s continue here. Galatians 3:14. The blessing of Abraham might come upon the Gentiles through Jesus Christ. Now, there’s two things here. The blessing of Abraham. Acts 3:25 tells us that the blessing of a blessing of Abraham was fulfilled when God raised up Jesus to bless you by turning every one of you from your sins. See, see in Abraham all the earth shall be blessed. How did he do that? By raising up Jesus. And Jesus turned us from our sins. But there’s another part to this. That we might receive the promise. There it is again. The promise of the what? Spirit. That Holy Spirit. Exceedingly great and precious promises that bring us into being partakers of the divine nature. Now, our ears and our eyes and our mind should be alert right now because God is promising something tremendous. What does the baptism of Holy Ghost have to do with the divine nature? Now, if it does have to do with the divine nature, we need to quit arguing about it. We need to quit dividing over it. We need to quit fighting about it. And we need to participate of it. Could that be an amen? Cuz the divine nature is a big deal. All right. Are you with me so far? Ezekiel 36. We’re going to go back to the Old Testament’s promise. I gave you the New Testament promises. Now, here’s the Old Testament promises. Ezekiel 36:26. I will put a new spirit within you. I will put a new spirit within you. Man, I could use that. And then he tells us exactly what the new spirit is. And where’s the spirit going to be put? Within us. Not out here. Not that omnipotent presence that people feel but inside. I’m going to put it inside you within you. And then he tells us exactly who the new spirit is. I will put my spirit. How many you know the Bible says God is spirit and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and truth. You see? So when God says I’m going to pour out my spirit, what’s he saying? I’m going to pour out myself. I am a spirit. See, this trinity is word is great, but it still helps us think God is three different persons. And yet, it it really is a good word to explain the three parts of God, but we lose sight that he’s still one God. And we’re going to help you straighten that out today. I will put my spirit within you. So that new spirit is his spirit and cause you. This word cause, I’m going to trigger you. I’m going to affect you. I’m going to move you. I’m going to be an active force in you. I needed that as a young Christian. I needed an active force within me. I need it as an old Christian too, but especially that vulnerable new Christian walk. You need a drive within you. And I’m going to move you to walk in my statutes and my judgments, keeping my commandments and keeping I’m going to cause you. It’s not you just trying to discipline yourself to obey. I’m going to cause you.
What does the promise of the Spirit include, according to Galatians 3 and Ezekiel 36?

Galatians 3:14: that the blessing of Abraham might come upon the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith. Acts 3:25-26: You are sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘And in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.’ To you first, God, having raised up His Servant Jesus, sent Him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your iniquities.” Ezekiel 36:26-27: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh and give you a heart of flesh. I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes, and you will keep My judgments and do them. John 4:24: God is Spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth.”
What does the Spirit do about uncleanness and famine in Ezekiel 36?

He says that in the new covenant God will deliver us from our uncleanness and put no famine on us, and that the famine he means is spiritual, a famine of hearing the word of the Lord as in Amos 8:11. He says the Holy Ghost will keep revealing the word to us.
What does the Spirit do about uncleanness and famine in Ezekiel 36?

I’m going to move you. I’m going to affect you in such a way you’re going to keep my word. Hallelujah. Yeah. It’s a good place for a good clap offering. See, God says he’s going to be a participator in this Christian walk. He says, “You will be my people and I will be your God.” If you know the new covenant, that’s part of the new covenant found in Hebrews 6 and 8 found in Jeremiah. So this new covenant is we’re going to walk in his statutes. This new covenant is we’re going to do it by the power of the spirit of God that he is going to baptize us with. I will deliver you from all your uncleanness. How many of you Christians found out you still needed things to be cleansed from after you got saved? I’ll raise both hands. That really frustrated me at first because from the pulpit, man, if I came to Christ, my problems were over, man. Just skate through life, no problem. I mean, that’s the way they implied that it was. And I got saved. And I didn’t know I had so many problems. I didn’t know I had so many wrongs in me until the light shined on me. And I needed changing in many different areas. But he said he’ll cleanse us from all of them when he puts that spirit in us. That that fire of the Holy Ghost burns it out. I will multiply the grain and bring no famine upon you. Now, here is the Everybody’s always talking about the sign of the Holy Ghost. There’s all kinds of signs of the Holy Ghost. Here we have 1 2 3 four of them. Ain’t that right? Because the promise is the Holy Ghost would cause me to do these things. I will multiply the grain and bring no famine upon you. Now, we know he’s not talking about natural famine. And I’ll tell you why. Now, when I was a young preacher, yeah, I preach, oh, yeah, God’s going to take care of you financially. No, he’s talking about spiritual things still. And I’m going to prove it to you, okay? The early church had a soup line. Acts chapter 6, Stephen was one of the administrators of that soupline. There were poor people in the church and they only served soup to the church and they only served soup to the people in the church who didn’t have family to help them. If you know your Bible and they only serve soup to the people in the church that were widows if they were 60 years old and up. Otherwise, those widows should be out working and taking care of themselves and that that widow was involved in the house of God. Just reminding you of things I’ve preached before. All right. We also know that Apollos prophesied that a famine would come. Now, if God’s going to put no famine upon us, and Apollos prophesied of a famine to come, that makes him a false prophet. Except, the famine came and they had to send help to the church where that famine hit. You see, so he’s talking about spiritual things. What he’s saying is in Amos it says, “I’m going to send a famine among you, not of hungry for bread, where you want bread or food, nor a thirst for water, but I’m going to send a famine in Amos 8:11 of hearing the words of the Lord.” Now, God says, “When you get this, Holy Ghost, you will not be in a word famine. I will keep revealing the word to you. Wow. So, see, I need this Holy Ghost. I need to quit arguing about it, fighting about it, and I need to get it because it’s going to bring me into the divine nature. And I want to be like Jesus.
What does the Spirit do about uncleanness and famine in Ezekiel 36?

Ezekiel 36:28-30: Then you shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; you shall be My people, and I will be your God. I will deliver you from all your uncleannesses. I will call for the grain and multiply it, and bring no famine upon you. And I will multiply the fruit of your trees and the increase of your fields, so that you need never again bear the reproach of famine among the nations. Acts 6:1-6: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, there arose a complaint against the Hebrews by the Hellenists, because their widows were neglected in the daily distribution. Then the twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not desirable that we should leave the word of God and serve tables. Therefore, brethren, seek out from among you seven men of good reputation, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business; but we will give ourselves continually to prayer and to the ministry of the word.” And the saying pleased the whole multitude. And they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, and Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas, a proselyte from Antioch, whom they set before the apostles; and when they had prayed, they laid hands on them. Acts 11:28: Then one of them, named Agabus, stood up and showed by the Spirit that there was going to be a great famine throughout all the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius Caesar. Amos 8:11: “Behold, the days are coming,” says the Lord GOD, “That I will send a famine on the land, Not a famine of bread, Nor a thirst for water, But of hearing the words of the LORD.
Who is the other Comforter in John 14?

He reads John 14:16 that the Father will give another Comforter, and says the first Comforter is Jesus and the other is the Spirit of truth who abides forever, so there is no time when it stops. He says Jesus was with them and would be in them, and that when we quarrel over the Holy Ghost we are quarreling over Jesus.
Who is the other Comforter in John 14?

How many will raise your hand and say, “Jesus, I want to be like you. My goal is to be like you. Not like the pope, not like the preacher, but like you. Yeah, that was it was a cry in my heart as a young Christian. And we used to sing this song to be like Jesus. All I asked is to be like him. So meek and lowly, sweet and holy. All I ask that was a real cry for me. I wanted not to be just your everyday Christian, the shooting star talking about God on fire one day and and then three months goes by and you’re back to your old life. I wanted to grow and be like that song meant a lot to me. And we should have that desire because the Holy Ghost puts it in us. Now John 14:16 the father shall give you another comforter. Okay. Another comforter. Then who is the first comforter? Can you guess who the other comforter is? Jesus. Who’s there? Jesus is a comforter, but he’s going to send another comforter. Do you guys ever look at the word like this? See, that’s why you need teachers. See, they need to stir up our thinking. Are you with me? So, there was a previous comforter and obviously it’s who? Jesus Christ. But there’s another one coming. Now, watch this. Watch this closely. This is powerful. That this comforter may abide with you how long? Forever. That gets rid of dispensationalism right there. There’s not a time where the comforter is going to be with us, the baptism of the Holy Ghost, and then it’s going to stop. It’s going to be here how long? Forever. You, your children, and to those a far off. This is a forever thing. Are you with me? Hallelujah. Even the spirit of truth. Now, who is the truth, the way, and the life? Jesus. Jesus is that spirit of truth. God is a God of truth and God is a spirit. God is that spirit of truth. Jesus is that spirit of truth. You can’t separate these three. And yet God uses the terminology so we can understand them. Now, how long is he going to abide with us? Forever. Okay. And he’s a spirit of truth. You know, if you go around lying, don’t tell me you’re filled with the Holy Ghost. His first name is Holy. He’s a Holy Spirit. He’s a Holy Ghost, which means spirit. And he’s a Holy Spirit of truth. You got your opinions. Your opinions may not be truths at all. Don’t tell me the Holy Ghost tells you things when it’s not truth because he is the spirit of truth. Amen. Jesus is truth. Now watch this. Are you ready? You know him. Know who? The spirit of truth. The comforter. Now, who did they know at this point? Jesus. They didn’t know the Holy Ghost. They didn’t know anything about the Holy Ghost. I’ll show you that in a minute. They had no idea about this Holy Ghost. But he says, “You know him. You know him. He dwells with you.” Who is dwelling and living with them? Jesus. Jesus is living with them. Amen. Now, he is with you and shall be what? In you. And that’s what Ezekiel said. This new spirit, God’s spirit, the spirit of Christ is going to be in us. So Jesus was with them. But when he died in that fleshly body or he he laid down his life in that fleshly body, he picked it up again and he ascended into heaven with that fleshly body void of blood, a non-deing body. Then he came back as the comforter who is the what? Holy Ghost. Wow. So when we quarrel over the Holy Ghost, we’re quarreling over Jesus. We’re fighting about Jesus. And we’re fighting stupid battles, foolish battles. And this is why we need to get this word out. American Christians need to grow up. And I’ve been telling a lot of people in the last three years, you need to grow up. You need to get out of the baby stage. You need to get out of the children’s stage. You need to get into the young men’s stage of growth. You need to get with a program. Hallelujah. They get mad at me and everything else, but it doesn’t matter. They really need to grow up. I have to tell my kids, it’s time to grow up. There’s a time to grow up. Jesus is going to come back as the comforter and be in us. And when we say he’s not involved anymore because there was a dispensation back there where there was a Holy Ghost poured out and tongues and all this stuff happened, but now it’s not going on. No miracles, no. You’re telling me that Jesus is not active in the church. And I’m telling you, you’re a liar. He is active in his church. He is the one that builds the church. Amen. I will not leave you comfortless. I will come to you. Comforter. Another comforter. He won’t leave you comfortless. He will come to you. So who is the comforter that was coming? Jesus Christ. I won’t leave you comfortless. I will come to you. And he promised the comforter would come.
Who is the other Comforter in John 14?

John 14:16-18: And I will pray the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may abide with you forever— the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him; but you know Him, for He dwells with you and will be in you. I will not leave you orphans; I will come to you.
What is the baptism of the Holy Ghost according to John 7:38?

He reads John 7:38 that streams of living water will flow from within the believer and says the baptism of the Holy Ghost is an abiding power that is not only in us but flows out of us with outward signs. He says it is an active presence that results in an outward expression of God.
What is the baptism of the Holy Ghost according to John 7:38?

Who’s the comforter? Jesus himself. Comes back in spirit form. His body is in the heavenlies. The one that died on the cross. But he comes back with his spirit. God is a spirit. John 7:38, “Whoever believes in me, as the scripture has said, streams of living water will flow from within him.” Within him. King James says, “Out of your belly shall flow rivers of water.” The Amplified says, “Out of your innermost being.” See, it’s within us. And this is what the baptism of the Holy Ghost is. Yes, we are the temple of God. And the spirit of God abides in us. But the baptism of the Holy Ghost is that abiding power that not only is in us, but it flows out of us with indications that we have it like we are his people and he’s our God. We walk in his statutes and the commandments. I don’t have a famine of the word. I’m delivered from my cleanliness. See, it’s an outward demonstration of a power within. Not just his presence in us. It’s an active presence that results in an outward expression of God. And this is what the Pentecostals and charismatics experienced back there and didn’t have the scriptural understanding to tell people what happened. Now, the third divine nature of Christ, remember his first one was there was no sin in him. So, if we’re going to take on the nature of Christ, we’re going to set a goal to stop sinning. The second divine nature we talked about is no man could take his life.
What is the baptism of the Holy Ghost according to John 7:38?
John 7:38: He who believes in Me, as the Scripture has said, out of his heart will flow rivers of living water.”
What is the third divine nature of Christ in Joel 2:28?

He says Jesus could not be killed by anyone; he laid down his life, and Jesus is Emmanuel, God with us, God in the flesh. He says the third divine nature is that God pours out his Spirit, my spirit, on all flesh, as promised in Joel 2:28 and fulfilled in Acts.
What is the third divine nature of Christ in Joel 2:28?

He had to lay it down. The Roman soldiers couldn’t do it. The Roman government couldn’t do it. The Jewish leaders couldn’t do it. So, when we blame the Jews and the Roman Empire, we’re really not telling the truth. Only Jesus could give up his life and pick it back up again. No one had the power and authority to take it. Jesus was not just another human being. He was God in the flesh. And these people that argue with me, I’ll say, “Listen, what’s another name for Jesus? Isn’t it Emmanuel?” “Yeah, it’s Emanuel.” I What does Emanuel mean? God with us. I go, “Duh. Jesus was God. Amen. You don’t want to listen to anything else. His name’s Emanuel, God with us. Any idiot can figure that out. Jesus was God in the flesh. God himself came and died on that cross. In a human body called Jesus Christ, the Messiah. So this third divine nature of Christ, we’re going to go to Joel 2:28 and it’s repeated in Acts 21:16 where it’s fulfilled. In Joel 2:28, we have the promise. In Acts 21:16, we have the performance of that promise. All right? And this is what it says. I will pour out my spirit. Whose spirit? My spirit. It’s not a third person. It’s his spirit upon how many? All flesh.
What is the third divine nature of Christ in Joel 2:28?

Joel 2:28-29: “And it shall come to pass afterward That I will pour out My Spirit on all flesh; Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your old men shall dream dreams, Your young men shall see visions. And also on My menservants and on My maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days. Acts 2:16-18: But this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel: ‘And it shall come to pass in the last days, says God, That I will pour out of My Spirit on all flesh; Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your young men shall see visions, Your old men shall dream dreams. And on My menservants and on My maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days; And they shall prophesy.
Do dreams and visions mean God is speaking?

He says dreams and visions from God have a condition, a goal and an end result, and that God gives them when he is about to do, correct or change something. He tells people who bring him dreams with none of these that they just had a pizza nightmare, and says the Holy Ghost gives the interpretation himself.
Do dreams and visions mean God is speaking?

And I have that box pulsating because here is the third divine nature of Jesus Christ. Right in those words. All right. But before we get there, here’s the results of that spirit, the signs. Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy. Your old man will dream dreams. Your young man will see visions. Now, people get all hyped up at that and they would read interpreting dream books and all the rest. Listen, if you really understand your Bible, people that dream dreamed and had visions simply had got a message from God. There was a condition going on. All right. There was a situation and then there was a goal. This this vision or this dream, whether it’s Daniel, whether it’s Joseph, whether it’s Isaiah about the Messiah, there was a goal. All right? And then the end result. And when and people come to me with their visions and dreams and I just tell them, you had a pizza nightmare. Why? There’s no goal, there’s no condition, and there’s no end result. It’s just you flattering yourself. Anybody can eat pizza before they go to bed at night and they have a nightmare. Are you there? And God don’t go around throwing out dreams and visions, you know, like a dime store or the dollar store now. It’s a dime store when I was a kid, but it’s a dollar store now. God only gives dreams and visions when he’s about to do something, correct something, change something and it’s a goal. I do I have so many people coming to me with dreams, especially if I talk on this. I I’m trying to prevent that from happening is why I’m explaining it. And sure enough, you know, I I talk about dreams and vision, the Holy Ghost, and boy, they come next time. Oh, I had this dream blah blah blah. I said, that’s not a dream. That’s a nightmare. It has no message. So stop reading books on how to interpret dreams. The Holy Ghost don’t need some human being writing a book on how to interpret dreams. The Holy Ghost gives you a dream. He’ll give you interpretation. Good grief. The thought that you have to come to me to ask for the interpretation. You think I’m Joseph or something? Are you there? Here it is.

He says that as a young Christian he found out he had many wrongs in him once the light shined, and that the Holy Ghost puts that spirit in us and burns it out like fire.

He says Emmanuel means God with us, so Jesus was God in the flesh, and God himself came and died on the cross in a human body called Jesus Christ the Messiah.

He says Christians in America don’t have joy, and they only smile when everything goes their way, unlike Peter who could smile in prison and sleep in perfect peace the night before his death.

He says a good wife or husband needs a spouse who is turned into a different person, not one who can prophesy, and that his kids want a dad, not a bell-ringing message.

He says we admit we are wrong, ask Jesus to forgive and cleanse, and turn from it, and that if you stumble you get up and repent again, which is the divine nature that keeps us getting up and getting life.

p: In “What God’s Spoken Word Does to the Gentiles,” Pastor David G. Kincer teaches Isaiah 34-35: God’s anger on the Gentiles and Edom (Esau) who changed his word, a coming global encounter, how other religions and groups distort who Jesus is, why the Bible is complete and true, and Isaiah 35 where the desert blossoms like a rose, the church strengthens weak hands, and the redeemed walk the highway of holiness with everlasting joy.

items.t: What God’s Word Does to the Gentiles
items.d: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer continues through Isaiah to show how God deals with the Gentiles, including religionists who change His word like Esau, and says the church’s part is to speak the gospel…
p: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer continues through Isaiah to show how God deals with the Gentiles, including religionists who change His word like Esau, and says the church’s part is to speak the gospel to them. Using Isaiah 35 he says God’s “vengeance” is the desert blossoming like a rose, the highway of holiness and everlasting joy for the redeemed.
Who are the Gentiles in Isaiah 34, and what is the sword on Edom? (Isaiah 34:1-5, Isaiah 2:17)

He says “the Gentiles used in the Bible is pagan heathen nations… non-Jew, ungodly people,” and that Isaiah 34:1 invites them to come near and hear. He says Edom is Esau, who “despised his birthright” and sold it for a bowl of soup, and that God will deal with people who have heard of God and “changed the things of God.” He says today he will address the Gentiles from the religionist side, because God will humble the pride that creates our own doctrines.

Remember, the Gentiles used in the Bible is pagan, heathen nations, Gentiles, which means non-Jew, ungodly people. That he’s going to address now. A brief review, it’s not on your sheet, it’s on the other sheet. Brief review: Isaiah addresses the Gentiles in Isaiah 34:1, “Come near, you Gentiles.” He’s he’s inviting them to come close to hear, so somebody’s got to be speaking the word, and heed, or obey the word. “You people, let the earth hear, and all that is in it, the world and all things that come forth from it, for the in indignation, the anger, the wrath of the Lord is against all Gentiles.” Now, that sounds like he’s a bull, snort and smoke out of his nose, his horns down, ready to just destroy these people, all right? And then he says in verse 5, “My sword shall come down on Edom, the people of my curse, for judgment.” And you remember, Edom is Esau, and Esau despised his birthright. He was ungodly. The Bible says despised his birthright, didn’t want anything to do with the birthright, sold it for a bowl of soup. And uh uh so so God’s going to address people that have heard of God. Esau knew about God, he heard of God, and he knew he had a birthright, he he knew he had an inheritance, but he didn’t care about it. So he changed the things of God. In Isaiah 21:17 it says, “The loftiness of man shall be brought low, and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day. The idols he shall utterly abolish.” Now, we talked about the Gentiles being the humanist, the atheist and so forth, but today we’re going to address it from the religionist side, okay. Idols is a area of religion that God does not approve of, and it’s idols, it’s more than one religion, okay? He’s going to, in that day he’s going to humble people. they We get prideful, we get cocky in our religion, uh okay and we even create our own doctrines and our own way of worshiping God, and God’s going to deal with them in that day.

He says putting in your own opinions is “adding to the word,” and taking verses out of the Bible is “taken away from the word.” He says if people follow us after we alter it, “we’re leading them to destruction.”

He says “they change the scriptures” and that “all roads lead to the same God” is a statement a lot of leaders make “not understanding it comes directly from” another religion, not the Bible. His view is stated as he spoke it and is not verified here.
How does he explain the Trinity?

He says Jesus is God, God the Father, God the Son and God the Holy Ghost, and asks “how many gods?” and answers “one.” He says “we’re not talking about three gods,” though we may use the word Trinity.
Does he say Paul wrote some things as his own opinion?

He says in 1 Corinthians Paul wrote “I write this, not the Lord,” giving his own permission, but that the rest God was telling him to write, so the writers wrote “as the Holy Spirit gave him the inspiration.”
He says love is not “that fear feeling” but “that principle of doing nothing and speaking nothing to hurt others.” He says you don’t have to have vibes or feelings, “you just do it.”
Does he say our sin hurts God?
He says God is not “up on the throne worried” and that “your bad choices hurt you and they hurt others.” He says God’s plan cannot be rattled: “he knows what he’s doing, he knows where he’s going.”
Why does he say chapter breaks do not change the subject?
He says “a chapter does not separate necessarily a subject. Chapters are put in there by man,” so Isaiah 35 continues the subject of God’s visitation on the Gentiles from Isaiah 34.
What does he say the desert is a picture of in the Bible?

He says the desert “is always referred to as a place where you get tested and humbled during life’s difficulties.” He says God led Israel 40 years in the wilderness to “know what was in their heart, not to seduce them with sin.”
Does he say every bad thing that happens is because of sin?

He says no: “it’s not our own choice, it’s not God, and it’s not sin” in every case. He cites the tower that fell, saying “it wasn’t their sin that the tower fell,” and that an accident can “just happen.”
Does he say we should look down on people of other beliefs?
He says no: “we got no right looking down on the Mormons,” or anybody. He says if we have truth, “the key to their survival is us speaking it, sharing it.”
What does he say about people moving from church to church?

He says in America “Christianity is not growing, all we’re doing is moving from one church to another,” and cites a drop from 86% to 78% saying “we are not saving souls in America.” These are his figures as spoken, without a source.

items.t: What Happens to Your Identity When You Die?
items.d: A short clip: everyone will stand before Christ’s judgment seat. Earthly identities pass away in the resurrection change; righteousness and how we treated our temple will matter.
p: A short clip: everyone will stand before Christ’s judgment seat. Earthly identities pass away in the resurrection change; righteousness and how we treated our temple will matter.

items.t: What is Grace? A Different Perspective!
items.d: A short clip: grace is being under the influence of Christ. God gives a new heart and Spirit, sin loses dominion, and Joseph shows grace at work before the law.
p: A short clip: grace is being under the influence of Christ. God gives a new heart and Spirit, sin loses dominion, and Joseph shows grace at work before the law.
Being under the influence of Christ; our appearance, speech and behavior show whose influence we are under.

items.d: In this message a speaker at Vine Cluster Church teaches that the church is a people called out of darkness, built on Jesus Christ as its foundation, and given authority and a calling that angels and…
p: In this message a speaker at Vine Cluster Church teaches that the church is a people called out of darkness, built on Jesus Christ as its foundation, and given authority and a calling that angels and principalities watch. He goes through what the church does when it gathers (praise, prayer, ministering to the Lord, fasting), the qualities it should show the world, and closes with Philippians 3: the goal is to know Christ now.
What does it mean that the church is called out of darkness, and why do believers in China risk prison to gather? (1 Peter 2:9)

He says the church “is a people that’s called out of sin and to his light, and the light exposes us,” and you can’t live as a Christian thinking you can stay in darkness. He points to churches in China where people put their lives on the line just to gather, and says “we should have that same desire in America. It’s scriptural, it’s important.”
What does it mean that the church is called out of darkness, and why do believers in China risk prison to gather? (1 Peter 2:9)

1 Peter 2:9, “Who has called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.” He’s called you more than just gathering. He’s called us out of darkness. he The church is a people that’s called out of sin and to his light, and the light exposes us. How do we know? With these lights on you can see things. I can see Christina, she’s got a stain on her jacket. Just kidding. And people, the Bible says that people don’t like the light because it exposes them. That’s right. That God has called us out of darkness, I mean, these scriptures make it plain. You can’t live your life as a Christian thinking that you you can stay in darkness. No way. Why are the churches in China risking their lives, risking prison, to gather? The unofficial church. Mr. Kincer, our pastor, is over there right now cuz he wants to see what’s happening, he wants to be a part. You know, those people are are putting their lives on the line just to gather. You know, they could all stay home. They’re not taking the excuse, “I’m just going to stay home and live for Jesus.” They’re putting everything on the line together. And why? Is it ignorance because they’re just ignorant people? No, they have something inside of them that wants to gather with God’s people, and we should have that same desire in America. It’s scriptural, it’s important.

What is the foundation of the church? (Matthew 16:18, 1 Corinthians 3:11, Isaiah 28:16)

He says that in Matthew 16:18 Jesus “talking about himself. He’s going to build the church on himself,” not on Peter, John, James or the apostles. He says “Jesus is the rock,” the word has not changed in 2,000 years, and he wants “a sure foundation” rather than a philosophy that can be proven wrong.
What is the foundation of the church? (Matthew 16:18, 1 Corinthians 3:11, Isaiah 28:16)

You know, I’ve read the scripture several times and you always think he’s talking about Peter. No, he’s talking about himself. He’s going to build the church on himself. tg: Bible Morality Banned by Wimps and Born by Warriors
p: In this short message, Part 4 of his Bible morality series, the speaker says what is added to faith after the Holy Spirit is virtue, moral excellent behavior with the courage to do it, from 2 Peter 1. He says a justice system should punish those who harm others, reads Romans 13, Proverbs 21:11 and Isaiah 5:20, compares today’s opponents to the Pharisees, and speaks about religious freedom and the Bible in early America.
What does he say is added after the Holy Spirit? (2 Peter 1:4–9)

He says “virtue moral excellent behavior with valor is going to be what we’re going to add to the Holy Spirit,” citing 2 Peter 1. He says “virtue is moral excellent behavior with the courage to do it,” and that adding it to faith keeps you from being “barren nor unfruitful.”

items.t: What Overcomes You Makes You a Slave
items.d: A short message comparing Israel’s bondage in Egypt to slavery to sin. Whoever commits sin is a slave of sin, but the Son sets you free now, not only for heaven; worship and prayer are tools that bring us to…
p: A short message comparing Israel’s bondage in Egypt to slavery to sin. Whoever commits sin is a slave of sin, but the Son sets you free now, not only for heaven; worship and prayer are tools that bring us to Christ, and the world’s promise of freedom only makes slaves.
How long did God plan for Israel to reach the promised land?
He says the total time God planned was two years; Joseph brought his family to Egypt, and the Egyptians later made the Israelites their slaves.
How long did God plan for Israel to reach the promised land?

The total time that God planned for Israel to come out of Egypt to the promised land was 2. Years so back when Joseph became second in command he was put in second in command by Pharaoh Joseph brought his family uh from a land they brought his father Jacob who is Israel and his brothers and they all lived in the land of Goshen in Egypt they forgot about Joseph and all the Egypt now has the Israelites as their slaves.
Does deliverance have to take a lifetime?
No. God is not on a forever plan; He wants to bring you out of Satan and sin in a short period of time.
Does deliverance have to take a lifetime?

But the plan was to bring them out of Egypt to the promised land uh in two years okay so when we think about our lives we don’t need to take forever our whole lifetime to be delivered from Satan and sin you know God’s not on a forever plan okay he wants to do things quickly in your life God wants to uh bring you out of all that in a short period of time Exodus chapter 1:13 the Egyptians made the children of Israel serve with rigor they made their lives bitter with hard bondage in mortar and brick and all manner of service in the field Deuteronomy 5:15 you were a slave in Egypt and I redeemed you and brought you out so I’m just reiterating here what I already said but the children of Israel were slaves they were under in in bondage to the Egyptians.
Does deliverance have to take a lifetime?

All their service in which they made them serve was with rigor. Deuteronomy 5:15: And remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out from there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm; therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

Forever. The Son, Jesus; not just for heaven but from sin now. Worship, prayer, praise and fasting are tools God uses to bring you to Christ.

No; they are tools God uses to bring you to Jesus Christ, who sets you free.

No, it is Christ that saves you; be careful not to give credit to ourselves.
How does the world sell sin?
Advertisements say this is freedom and fun; come on, just pay the money.
Yes; Israel believed in God and prayed, and we can be enslaved as Christians, so we need God to bring us out.

He’s not coming back for a church that’s hanging on for the rapture. He’s coming up for a victorious church. A strong church. A church that’s like Daniel. So we have the people that oppose Jesus and Bible morality. We have strong Christians. And we have them standing up against the prince of princes which is Jesus. And by him the daily sacrifice was taken away. The horns host the army, the people that follow him cast truth to the ground. And that’s what Obama did when he said that same-sex marriage is okay. He cast truth to the ground. When the Democratic Party said it’s okay, they cast truth to the ground. They’re the little horns that we need to stand up against. Can I hear an amen? Now, and I put in this 2,300 days. He says, “How long before this daily sacrifice, truth to the ground, you know, prince of princes and all that. items.t: What the Last Days is All About Part 2
items.d: The kings of the north and south were fulfilled in history, then Rome ruled. The abomination of desolation came, but the people who know their God shall be strong. Daniel’s people are everyone written in the…
p: The kings of the north and south were fulfilled in history, then Rome ruled. The abomination of desolation came, but the people who know their God shall be strong. Daniel’s people are everyone written in the book—the fruit-bearing people who received the kingdom.
Who are the kings of north and south?
Historical kings—marriage alliances and murders fulfilled in 240 BC.
Who are the kings of north and south?

Here we have the king of the south, Tommy, the king of the north. These guys are united. And the king’s daughter, this is Tommy number two. Veroni, his daughter was given to the king of the north. Okay? So they would unify and not war with each other. But it didn’t work. Baroni got killed and her son got killed. By the northern government. And so, and it says, “But it won’t stand out of her roots.” Now, what’s our roots? Our family, right? Okay. Out of her roots, shall one stand up with an army and defeat the king of the north and carry captives into Egypt with vessels of gold and silver. And this happened in 240 BC. Berenice’s brother got mad because they killed his sister and her child and he brought an army and he conquered the king of the north just like the messenger said before it happened. You can read this in history. Are you with me exactly how it said? So the southern kingdom is named. It’s not a mystery. What’s the southern kingdom? What’s the southern kingdom? Say it. Egypt. You don’t have to get into spiritual. Oh Lord, who’s the spirit? Who’s the It’s Egypt, dummy. It says it right here. Oh, but it’s got to be in the last days. We don’t know. No, it’s Egypt. Okay, everybody understand that? Verse 10. The king of the south shall fight with and defeat the multitudes of the king of the north. That happened again in 217 BC. That happened just like the messenger said it would. Verse 12, the north king defeats the south king again. Antiochus III, including Israel. Now the northern king has Israel and they never let Israel go back. Even after e the southern kingdom got their nation back, Palestine never went back to the southern kingdom. It stayed in the northern kingdom just like the messenger said. Are you there folks? This is history. Now, if you were a Jew living in Daniel’s time, you wouldn’t have figured this out. But when that Greek kingdom come to power, you go, “Wow, this is what Daniel said.” So when Alexander came into Palestine conquering the world, the priests went out and met him and said, “You’re the one that Daniel talked about.” And because they admitted that this was scriptural, Alexander didn’t destroy Jerusalem because they knew the scriptures. Are you there? Or did you know this stuff? The northern king defeats the southern king including Israel. Now in 189 BC Salucus fell to Rome. This green empire is now under Roman authority. Just Rome didn’t take over the whole. They just beat him and they took a certain part of it and slowly took the rest. All right. So now we have this little kingdom up here and the Romans and Tommy. All right. In 149 BC, Cassander fell to Rome. Now there only one Greek kingdom left and that’s Egypt. Just like the messenger said in 63 BC Israel as I said before ma was made a province of Rome.

Daniel 11:5-6: “Also the king of the South shall become strong, as well as one of his princes; and he shall gain power over him and have dominion. His dominion shall be a great dominion. And at the end of some years they shall join forces, for the daughter of the king of the South shall go to the king of the North to make an agreement; but she shall not retain the power of her authority, and neither he nor his authority shall stand; but she shall be given up, with those who brought her, and with him who begot her, and with him who strengthened her in those times.

Now all four Greek kingdoms are under Rome. Who is the fourth kingdom to come? Do you get it? Do you get it? Who has the little horn speaking great things against God, against the scriptures, against the King of Kings, going to take away the daily sacrifice, going to fulfill the abomination of desolation? This is the empire. Is that good? And you can read this. It’s It’s very good a very good uh history. Now things get a little tricky. That part was easy. Now it gets tricky. And to prepare you for the trickiness, I want to remind you, as I did before, Isaiah prophesies and talks about King Ahaz, a king of Judah, talking all about him, how bad he was, and everything else. And boom, out of nowhere, he says, “The Lord shall give a sign. A virgin shall conceive and bear a son and call his name Emanuel.” Then goes back into talking about Ahaz. Just boom. Are you with me? Had nothing to do with Ahaz, but of prophecy about the end time and Jesus Christ. Now, another one. I could give you a lot of them. Hosea 11, he’s talking about Israel. And then out of nowhere, he says, “I’ve called my son out of Israel.” And literally, it took me years to figure this out as a young Christian. Every time I read that, I thought he was talking about Israel coming out of Egypt from the land of bondage and going into Canaan land. Then he goes back to talking about something else. But see, if you understand that, then I can help you get through this trickiness. Are you with me? Now, how many of you know in these last days, we’re not going to stand understand everything in detail. The end, the last days shall be at the time appointed. And this is why I say he isn’t coming in a minute. There is a what? Time appointed. And the church has got to be victorious. And the transgressors have got to come to fullness before it’s going to happen the first time or the second time. Are you with me? Do you understand that? Now there’s a transition. He is talking about the end time. And then he says, “At the time appointed, the king of the north shall return and come against the king of the south.” I showed you how the king of the north slowly possessed all the other kingdoms and finally the kingdom of the south. All right, the Roman Empire. But he’s talking about the end time here. The first end time. Do you understand that? The first end time was when Jesus came. Do you have that? In the last days, I will pour out my spirit on all. Jesus came in the beginning of the last days. And we are still in those last days. Hallelujah. Now his heart will be against the holy covenant, and he’ll have intelligence with them that forsake it. His army shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and take away the daily sacrifice.

And these armies shall apply the abomination that makes desolate Verse 36, he will speak against the God of gods. That’s what the little horn does, right? We speak against the God of gods. Who’s the God of gods? Jesus. So, we got the opposers of Jesus in the Bible again in the last days. Now look at this. Get this in your corranial vacuum. Anakas IV in 168 BC came against Israel after the Romans turned them back from Egypt and his army defiled the temple. They went in and they stopped the daily sacrifices from being offered. They built a pagan altar over the over the temple altar and put the image of Zeus on it and offered pigs to Zeus. The Sabbath and the feast days were profane. They weren’t allowed to keep them and they kept them with a heathen u flavor. No circumcision was allowed. The Jews were not allowed to circumcise their children. And if they did, it was the penalty of death. Any of these violated, you were killed. So many in Israel stood firm to these shadow laws. Isaiah chapter 1 says, “I don’t want your sacrifices. I don’t want your feast days and your Sabbaths. I want you to do right.”. Why? They were all shadow laws. And the Jews literally died protecting their shadow laws. 80,000 died. 80 more thousand were put into slavery. Then the Roman generals Pompei in 63 BC desecrated the temple. Caressus in 54 BC desecrated the temple and took the golden rod out. And then Titus in 70 AD destroyed Jerusalem and the temple and stopped the sacrifices forever. They tried it again about 134 AD. Didn’t last long. Rome came in and stopped it and it stopped. Why? Because God didn’t mean for us to do animal sacrifices and keep feast days and all that. He wants us to keep Bible morality. Now, this is the irony of it all. The Jews gave their life for the shadow laws. And look what they were doing. I showed you before that the Jews had been worshiping idols all these years. In Jeremiah, they were offering to the queen of heaven. While Daniel was around in Amos, it was the God of Molech. All the time they came out of Israel unto captivity. They had these idols. My people have committed adultery with their idols and caused their sons to pass through the fire to devour them. Molech, you give your child, you cook them, you roast them, you give them to the fire, you kill children. Israel was doing this. Ezekiel was the prophet during the captivity. They have defiled my sanctuary in the same day and have profaneed my Sabbath. Israel profaneed the Sabbath days. Israel profaneed the the temple. But God forbid these Romans come in and do it. When they had slain their children to idols, they came the same day into my sanctuary and act like they’re my believers. Is that going on in America? Yeah. We believe in Jesus. We’ve been baptized. And yet we we kill the un unborn baby. We agree with same-sex marriages and a homosexual lifestyle and all this garbage. We agree with it. Then we come into God’s house. And when they take away our tax exemption and they they they attack us, then we stand up like we’re some wholly righteous people when we have violated God’s word in the first place. Could that be true? But God forbid that outsiders say anything. It’s oh boy, but we pollute it. That’s the irony of this. The Jews had already they already brought in an altar from a foreign nation in the book of Kings and offered sacrifices on it. They’ve already done these polluted things. But God forbid that anyone violates these shadow laws. Now verse 32. Now we’re talking about the end days, right? Watch this. Remember I told you it’s going to be about Jesus, going to be about the wicked, and it’s going to be about a strong people. Look at this. Such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries.

Daniel 11:31: And forces shall be mustered by him, and they shall defile the sanctuary fortress; then they shall take away the daily sacrifices, and place there the abomination of desolation. Daniel 11:36: “Then the king shall do according to his own will: he shall exalt and magnify himself above every god, shall speak blasphemies against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the wrath has been accomplished; for what has been determined shall be done.
The people who know their God shall be strong and do exploits—understand scripture first.

But the people that know their God shall be what? Strong. When? In the last days. People that know their God are a strong people. They don’t give in to immorality. And they do exploits. Exploits is added for your understanding. But exploits is not in the Bible. The word do is. And that word do means to act with effect, act with strength. That’s us folks. We are to put actions behind the word. We are to know our God. And in case you don’t know it, the definition of eternal life is given in the Bible. And it’s not just live forever. This is life eternal that they might know you, the only true God and Jesus Christ whom you have sent. That’s the definition of eternal life. Do you know him? Do you know Jesus? Because if you do, you’re going to be strong, man. Ain’t nobody going to move you from the righteous word of God. See, we don’t have to be divided over how we’re baptized. We don’t have to be divided over whether you believe in tongues or not believe in tongues. Those are not divisional doctrines. They are wise doctrines. If you embrace them, they’re going to make you wise. They’re going to make you more powerful. The laws that are violated in first Corinthians is idolatry. We don’t have anything to do with them. Sexual immorality, drunkenness, and debauchery. And those things, those five things are what we are supposed to back off from. Are you with me? But in America, we divide over the belief in the second coming. You don’t believe the way I believe. I can’t have anything to do with you. That’s not a divisional doctrine cuz nobody knows. They can give all the information that they want, but the bottom line is hell no. We do know that Jesus and his people are powerful in the last days, and the wicked are coming to the fullness of their sin. They that understand among the people shall instruct many. Absolutely. Are we to do that? Yes. But we got to understand the scriptures before we can act on them. Yet they will fall by the sword, the the flame, captivity, and by spoil many days. And I don’t care if you’re a Catholic, Protestant, or a Jew. That’s the way it works. To try and purge them and make them white even to the time of the end. And the period in between is still the last days. Do you got it? We are in the last days. Apostle Paul was in the last days. Plural days. It’s been over 2,000 years. It may be another thousand years. You see that second ending is yet to come. The first one has come, but the second one is yet to come at the time of the end. Now, it’s the first ending. Now, he jumps back to the Greek kingdoms. Rome took over Egypt, setting the stage for Jesus, the abomination of desolation, and all this stuff to happen. Amen. Now the stage is set for Jesus to come. Now we have the same stuff. They that oppose Bible morality in our generation. We should have strong Christians in our generation. Now, here it is. Are you ready for the definition? At that time, what time? The appointed time, the time of the end, the second ending. Your people, Daniel’s people shall be delivered.

Daniel 11:32-33: Those who do wickedly against the covenant he shall corrupt with flattery; but the people who know their God shall be strong, and carry out great exploits. And those of the people who understand shall instruct many; yet for many days they shall fall by sword and flame, by captivity and plundering.
Everyone written in the book—the kingdom given to a people bringing forth fruit.

I sin.” Yes, but you repent of life. You keep turning keeps you written in the book. You don’t say, “I don’t see nothing wrong with same-sex marriage.” You say, “It’s wrong. I voted democratic. items.t: What Will We Do in Heaven?
items.d: Heaven is the abiding place of the righteous until the resurrection—being present with the Lord, fullness of joy, the tree and river of life. There is no marriage there, saints reign, and rewards await the…
p: Heaven is the abiding place of the righteous until the resurrection—being present with the Lord, fullness of joy, the tree and river of life. There is no marriage there, saints reign, and rewards await the faithful.
With living right—he that does right is righteous; those born of God do not sin, which you never hear on radio and TV.

What will we do when we get to heaven? I love that. I asked this question. No one can answer me. Yes. Living right. Yeah. He that doeth right is righteous even as Christ is righteous. Amen. And listen to this. John says, “They that are born of God do not sin, and they cannot sin because they’re born of God.” Wow. How many times you hear that on the radio and TV? Never. He that is born of God doeth not sin, and he cannot sin because he’s born of God. How many want to grow to that place?

1 John 3:7-9: Little children, let no one deceive you. He who practices righteousness is righteous, just as He is righteous. He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has sinned from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that He might destroy the works of the devil. Whoever has been born of God does not sin, for His seed remains in him; and he cannot sin, because he has been born of God.
The abiding place of the righteous until the resurrection—absent from the body, present with the Lord.

Yes. You see, we discourage people. They And I tell these people online, you’re just discouraging people. That’s all you do. You just discourage people from growing, from pursuing God. You’re just a big bunch of discouragers. All right. Heaven now is the abiding place of the righteous until the resurrection. Okay? And then they abide in the new heaven and earth. But you only ask me about heaven. So, we’re going to deal with the abiding place of the dead in this uh segment. Second Corinthians 5’8. To be absent in body is to be where? Present with the Lord. Boy, that sounds good. Wow,. I can handle that. Can you handle that? I mean, man, I don’t have to read nothing else. That sounds good enough to me. When I die, bam, I am in the presence of Jesus Christ. No longer do you just believe by faith that he’s a real person. You see him. You touch him. He is there. That body that he died in was by the father when Stephen saw the heavens open. Hallelujah. And you’re going to see that body when you die. And that’s something to look forward to. But that’s not all. Heaven’s also called paradise. In Luke 23:43, the thief said today, Jesus said to the thief, “You will be with me in paradise.” That’s heaven.
2 Corinthians 5:8: We are confident, yes, well pleased rather to be absent from the body and to be present with the Lord.
The third heaven Paul was caught up to; dust returns to the ground and the spirit to God.

Just another name for heaven, the abiding place of the dead. It’s also called the third heaven in 2 Corinthians 12:2-4. Uh Paul was caught up to the third heaven, paradise, and he saw and heard great things. Ecclesiastes 12:7 says, “Dust returns to the ground from where it came from.” That’s us. Our body rots away, turns into dust. And a spirit returns to who? God who gave it. The spirit is eternal. Your body decays and goes away. But your spirit is eternal. And so is the unbeliever’s spirit eternal. And when they stand before Christ, they’re judged and put in hell. When they die, they’re also in the presence of the Lord, but the Lord is judging them and sending them to hell.

2 Corinthians 12:2-4: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago—whether in the body I do not know, or whether out of the body I do not know, God knows—such a one was caught up to the third heaven. And I know such a man—whether in the body or out of the body I do not know, God knows— how he was caught up into Paradise and heard inexpressible words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter. Ecclesiastes 12:7: Then the dust will return to the earth as it was, And the spirit will return to God who gave it.
Fullness of joy and pleasures forevermore, the tree of life and river of life, no night.

In God’s presence is fullness of joy. Hallelujah. We can smile all the time. Happy is the people whose God is the Lord. Hallelujah. No uh sadness, no sorrow, no pain and all that stuff. The heaven is a place of joy and pleasures forever more. And he doesn’t describe the pleasures, but you do things for pleasures and you like them, right? There’s things up there in heaven while we’re waiting to for the new heaven and earth that you’re going to be pleasurous for. Isn’t that beautiful? Yeah. You’re not just up there sitting on a cloud playing a heart. They used to show that cartoon all the time when I was a young guy. Besides that, Revelations 2:7 says, “We’re going to eat of the tree of life.” Kazam, the tree of life is up there. It was transported somehow under the heavens and you get to eat of the fruit of the tree of life. And not only that, there’s a river of life flowing up there in this spiritual domain. And you get to drink of that river of life and that tree of life. Man, you got life made. Hallelujah. But look out. He has other things planned for you. Revelation 22, no night there, no need of a candle, no need of a sun. God gives them light. And they shall what? Reign forever? Reign over what? There’s activity going on up there, church.

Psalm 16:11: You will show me the path of life; In Your presence is fullness of joy; At Your right hand are pleasures forevermore. Revelation 22:1-5: And he showed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding from the throne of God and of the Lamb. In the middle of its street, and on either side of the river, was the tree of life, which bore twelve fruits, each tree yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations. And there shall be no more curse, but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it, and His servants shall serve Him. They shall see His face, and His name shall be on their foreheads. There shall be no night there: They need no lamp nor light of the sun, for the Lord God gives them light. items.ser: When the Field Won’t Respond · Part 1
p: In “When the Field Won’t Respond Part 1,” Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from Ezekiel 2 on what a Christian is to do when immoral, sinning believers will not listen: do not be afraid of them, do not be dismayed by their looks, speak God’s words rather than your opinions, and take in the judgment Scriptures along with the encouraging ones. He gives examples from a protest he attended, urges Bible studies that ask what God is saying, and says ministers, politicians and church members bend Scripture to keep votes, members and benefits.
What should a Christian do when people who should know better won’t listen?

items.t: Where and What is Hell? — March 23, 2025
items.d: Hell isn’t a physical place on earth; the spiritual realm is real. The rich man in Luke 16 had sight, feeling and memory. Knowing the terror of the Lord, we persuade others, bear fruit of repentance, guard…
p: Hell isn’t a physical place on earth; the spiritual realm is real. The rich man in Luke 16 had sight, feeling and memory. Knowing the terror of the Lord, we persuade others, bear fruit of repentance, guard against pride, and through the new covenant put great distance between us and hell.
Not a crater in Turkmenistan or a place you can dig to—Jesus transitioned to heaven; the spiritual realm is real, as Elisha’s servant saw.

items.t: Where do Some Civil Rulers Get Their Authority to Judge? — September 6, 2020
items.d: Pastor David G. Kincer asks where rulers get authority to make harmful judgments: from above, as Jesus told Pilate. In Judges 19–20 Israel bypassed God’s judicial system after the Gibeah atrocity and lost…
p: Pastor David G. Kincer asks where rulers get authority to make harmful judgments: from above, as Jesus told Pilate. In Judges 19–20 Israel bypassed God’s judicial system after the Gibeah atrocity and lost twice, then won after weeping, fasting and offerings. p: The gospels speak of Jesus’ brothers and sisters, but He never called Mary mother or Joseph father. Pointing to His disciples, He said whoever hears and does God’s word is His brother, sister and mother. We become His family as new creatures, growing day by day.

In Luke 8:43 she had been sick twelve years and spent all her livelihood on physicians; at the end of her rope, she said if she could just touch the hem of His garment she would be healed.

Luke 8:43-44: Now a woman, having a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her livelihood on physicians and could not be healed by any, came from behind and touched the border of His garment. And immediately her flow of blood stopped. John 5:40: But you are not willing to come to Me that you may have life.

He already knew who she was; he stopped and asked because He knew it would be written for you and me and the world.

items.d: One quarter of 1 Corinthians deals with division. The cause is selfish choices and following men—Paul, Apollos, Peter—instead of Christ. The cure is speaking the same thing, preaching Christ crucified in the…
p: One quarter of 1 Corinthians deals with division. The cause is selfish choices and following men—Paul, Apollos, Peter—instead of Christ. The cure is speaking the same thing, preaching Christ crucified in the Spirit’s power, boasting only in Jesus, and growing from milk to meat.
A quarter of 1 Corinthians deals with division—its cause and cure; speak the same thing, like the Marine Corps with one book.

Now today we’re going to look at chapters 1-4. 1/4th of this epistle is dealing with division. The cause of it and the cure of it. He’s dealing with splits. What causes a church to split? What causes a church to be divided? He’s going to give us the cause and he’s going to give us the cure. How many are interested? Yes. And I tell you, this guy is close to Jesus. He was with the apostles. This is the best speaker we can have for this seminar. First, he says in 1 Corinthians 1:10, as we said last week, we introduced this, that you all speak what? The same thing. Boy, that’s a joke in America, isn’t it? Everybody has their own way of believing and talking and everybody wants to be accepted. Then he’s going to tell us why that we need to speak the same thing so that there is no what? Divisions among you. Be perfectly joined in the same mind and in the same judgment. See, be united in the way you understand things and the way you pass judgment on things. Why? Well, because Matthew 12:25, Jesus said, “Every kingdom, every city, every house, or Satan, if they’re divided against themselves, they cannot what? Stand.” You see these soldiers here? You know, the Marine Corps doesn’t give everybody a different book when they come in according to how they feel the Marine Corps should be ran. They give them one book. They all got one rule. They all got to follow that rule. They all got to work together. See, the Marine Corps does it. Corporations do it. But not the American church. You see these guys carrying their buddy off in the field. Their motto is no brother is left behind. We step on one another. We got man they get wounded or they don’t they’re not in the same thought we are in. That’s their problem. So if it can be done in the world, if it can be done in the military, and the twel apostles did it folks, they all 12 spoke the same thing.

1 Corinthians 1:10: Now I plead with you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
Everyone uses their own opinions; church attendance is declining while other continents grow; many reject hell, Satan and Christ’s deity.

In fact, the added apostles, Barnabas, Paul, and some others, they all spoke the same thing. But in America, we got this mentality that we can all use our own opinions, our own belief system. Could that be true? So we see that it can be done in the secular world. It has been done in the spiritual world. And can we do it in America? Yes. Is God big enough to perform this? Yes. It’s just we got to respond. So the reason the American church isn’t standing, see the American church is declining. We’re not moving forward. We’re not gaining ground. We’re not getting souls saved. We’re not getting people mature. We’re not getting people to live committed Christian righteous lives. We’re declining. While South America, Africa, Asia are all increasing. We are declining along with Europe. That’s the bottom line. You see, only 27% of Protestants go to church, for instance. And Jesus said, the Bible says what? Assemble yourself together even the more so as you see the day approaching. So we’re in the last days. We should be what? Coming together more so summoning Jesus, fellowshipping with him. Could that be true? Catholics, only 31% of Catholics go to a church, including Italy where their capital is. See, there’s a big decline. And not only that, we’re not just talking about going to church. We’re talking about their belief system. Uh Christians don’t believe in a virgin birth anymore. They don’t believe there’s a hell or a lake of fire. Many of them don’t believe that Satan is a real being, a real spiritual being. Many of them do not believe that Christ was God. Everybody’s just sort of formulating their own mind. And as many of the modern churches say, whatever you believe is truth. If that’s what you believe, then that’s truth. See, that doesn’t work, does it? In the Bible. And so, we got a decline in America. And one of the reasons is the the American church can’t get united together. And so, we don’t fight the battle and win it. Because Jesus said, “When you’re divided, you can’t what? Stand.” These Marine Corps, if they didn’t get up there united, if one guy says, “Hey, it’s Sunday. I’m not fighting today. Another guy said, “Man, I was up all night. I got to get my sleep.” Or another guy decides, “Hey, I don’t believe in killing.” Would they win a war? No. That’s what Jesus is emphasizing. Can we violate the words of Jesus Christ himself and then act like we’re some kind of successful church even though we are losing ground? See, that’s why I told you last week that song is not true to America. We’re not moving forward and we’re not gaining ground. We need to regroup, get united around the right things, and let Jesus move us forward. Could that be true? Now, this is a this is a teaching that very few people will even think about, let alone teach.
Hebrews 10:25: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the manner of some, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
Selfish choices—judging by appearance; what once was shocking is now accepted; no regard for Jesus and the Bible.

Division in the church world and this is exactly what we need to hear and one quarter of this epistle is given to division. So that means it’s what very important in judges or in John 7:24 judge not according to appearance but judge righteous judgment. He said this after he healed somebody on the Sabbath day and they said you can’t do that. You can’t heal people on the Sabbath day. Can’t do anything on the Sabbath day. He turned to them and he said this statement. And then he says, “You take your child to get circumcised on the Sabbath day. The priests minister every Sabbath day. You get your donkey out of the ditch on the Sabbath day.” All those are good things. So see I can heal on the Sabbath day because evenness, fairness, equaleness spreads out. If you can do that, then I can heal. Do we understand? Okay. Now let me tell you this. Let’s come to America. All right. America says that homosexuality is an acceptable lifestyle and God created him that way. Now using this using this verse and Christ’s approach what that means is okay then adultery is okay. God created me you know to just run around having sex. See incest is okay. I can have sex with my children. I can have sex with my mother. And people go oh God. Well, 50 years ago when we talked about homosexuals marrying and homosexual sex, we go, “Oh, goof.” But we don’t say that now. Are you with me? You see, sexual organs are okay. Sex with animals is okay. Why? Because you got to be even throughout the topic. See, this is why Paul is saying it’s important that we all speak the same thing, have the same knowledge, and unite in them so we can stand and we can have a voice in our nation. The church does not have a voice in this nation. We’re not having an effect on our nation. And it’s one of the main reasons is we’re not united. We can’t agree on basic stuff. And this is what Paul’s telling us. How many agree with Paul? Yeah. Let Paul be the best speaker we got in this nation going on in this first chapter. Here’s a cause. The cause is selfish choices. There. Selfish means you’re only interested in your own interest, your own needs, your own beliefs. And they are more important than other people. And in this case, they’re more important than Jesus Christ and what he believes. Are you with me? See, that’s why it’s a selfish choice. You see, you have no respect, no regard for Jesus Christ and the Bible for what it says. That makes it what? A very selfish choice. And this is the cause of division. It has been declared there are divisions, contentions, quarreling, strife among you. One says, I’m of Paul. I am of Paul. What’s one of the names of God by the way? I am. Why did they fall in the garden? Because the they had a Holy Ghost fit. Why did they fall backwards? Because Jesus said what? I am. He said his name. And his name was so powerful. Those secular people were knocked to the ground and they got right back up and arrested him.
John 7:24: Do not judge according to appearance, but judge with righteous judgment.”
I am of Paul, of Apollos, of Peter, of Christ—only one group got it right; is Christ divided?
